    "id": "src/acp/session.ts",
    "content": "import type { McpServer } from \"@agentclientprotocol/sdk\"\nimport { Session } from \"../session\"\nimport { Provider } from \"../provider/provider\"\nimport type { ACPSessionState } from \"./types\"\n\nexport class ACPSessionManager {\n  private sessions = new Map<string, ACPSessionState>()\n\n  async create(cwd: string, mcpServers: McpServer[], model?: ACPSessionState[\"model\"]): Promise<ACPSessionState> {\n    const session = await Session.create({ title: `ACP Session ${crypto.randomUUID()}` })\n    const sessionId = session.id\n    const resolvedModel = model ?? (await Provider.defaultModel())\n\n    const state: ACPSessionState = {\n      id: sessionId,\n      cwd,\n      mcpServers,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      model: resolvedModel,\n    }\n\n    this.sessions.set(sessionId, state)\n    return state\n  }\n\n  get(sessionId: string) {\n    return this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n  }\n\n  async remove(sessionId: string) {\n    const state = this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n    if (!state) return\n\n    await Session.remove(sessionId).catch(() => {})\n    this.sessions.delete(sessionId)\n  }\n\n  has(sessionId: string) {\n    return this.sessions.has(sessionId)\n  }\n\n  getModel(sessionId: string) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n    if (!session) return\n    return session.model\n  }\n\n  setModel(sessionId: string, model: ACPSessionState[\"model\"]) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n    if (!session) return\n    session.model = model\n    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)\n    return session\n  }\n\n  setMode(sessionId: string, modeId: string) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n    if (!session) return\n    session.modeId = modeId\n    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)\n    return session\n  }\n}\n",

    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { Identifier } from \"../id/id\"\nimport { Plugin } from \"../plugin\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { Wildcard } from \"../util/wildcard\"\n\nexport namespace Permission {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"permission\" })\n\n  function toKeys(pattern: Info[\"pattern\"], type: string): string[] {\n    return pattern === undefined ? [type] : Array.isArray(pattern) ? pattern : [pattern]\n  }\n\n  function covered(keys: string[], approved: Record<string, boolean>): boolean {\n    const pats = Object.keys(approved)\n    return keys.every((k) => pats.some((p) => Wildcard.match(k, p)))\n  }\n\n  export const Info = z\n    .object({\n      id: z.string(),\n      type: z.string(),\n      pattern: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]).optional(),\n      sessionID: z.string(),\n      messageID: z.string(),\n      callID: z.string().optional(),\n      title: z.string(),\n      metadata: z.record(z.string(), z.any()),\n      time: z.object({\n        created: z.number(),\n      }),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"Permission\",\n    })\n  export type Info = z.infer<typeof Info>\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Updated: Bus.event(\"permission.updated\", Info),\n    Replied: Bus.event(\n      \"permission.replied\",\n      z.object({\n        sessionID: z.string(),\n        permissionID: z.string(),\n        response: z.string(),\n      }),\n    ),\n  }\n\n  const state = Instance.state(\n    () => {\n      const pending: {\n        [sessionID: string]: {\n          [permissionID: string]: {\n            info: Info\n            resolve: () => void\n            reject: (e: any) => void\n          }\n        }\n      } = {}\n\n      const approved: {\n        [sessionID: string]: {\n          [permissionID: string]: boolean\n        }\n      } = {}\n\n      return {\n        pending,\n        approved,\n      }\n    },\n    async (state) => {\n      for (const pending of Object.values(state.pending)) {\n        for (const item of Object.values",

    "id": "src/command/index.ts",
    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport PROMPT_INITIALIZE from \"./template/initialize.txt\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Identifier } from \"../id/id\"\n\nexport namespace Command {\n  export const Default = {\n    INIT: \"init\",\n  } as const\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Executed: Bus.event(\n      \"command.executed\",\n      z.object({\n        name: z.string(),\n        sessionID: Identifier.schema(\"session\"),\n        arguments: z.string(),\n        messageID: Identifier.schema(\"message\"),\n      }),\n    ),\n  }\n\n  export const Info = z\n    .object({\n      name: z.string(),\n      description: z.string().optional(),\n      agent: z.string().optional(),\n      model: z.string().optional(),\n      template: z.string(),\n      subtask: z.boolean().optional(),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"Command\",\n    })\n  export type Info = z.infer<typeof Info>\n\n  const state = Instance.state(async () => {\n    const cfg = await Config.get()\n\n    const result: Record<string, Info> = {}\n\n    for (const [name, command] of Object.entries(cfg.command ?? {})) {\n      result[name] = {\n        name,\n        agent: command.agent,\n        model: command.model,\n        description: command.description,\n        template: command.template,\n        subtask: command.subtask,\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (result[Default.INIT] === undefined) {\n      result[Default.INIT] = {\n        name: Default.INIT,\n        description: \"create/update AGENTS.md\",\n        template: PROMPT_INITIALIZE.replace(\"${path}\", Instance.worktree),\n      }\n    }\n\n    return result\n  })\n\n  export async function get(name: string) {\n    return state().then((x) => x[name])\n  }\n\n  export async function list() {\n    return state().then((x) => Object.values(x))\n  }\n}\n",

    "content": "// Setup tiktoken WASM path BEFORE any other imports\nimport \"./util/tiktoken-setup\"\n\nimport yargs from \"yargs\"\nimport { hideBin } from \"yargs/helpers\"\nimport { RunCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/run\"\nimport { GenerateCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/generate\"\nimport { Log } from \"./util/log\"\nimport { AuthCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/auth\"\nimport { AgentCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/agent\"\nimport { UpgradeCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/upgrade\"\nimport { ModelsCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/models\"\nimport { UI } from \"./cli/ui\"\nimport { Installation } from \"./installation\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"./util/error\"\nimport { FormatError } from \"./cli/error\"\nimport { ServeCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/serve\"\nimport { DebugCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/debug\"\nimport { StatsCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/stats\"\nimport { McpCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/mcp\"\nimport { GithubCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/github\"\nimport { ExportCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/export\"\nimport { AttachCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/tui/attach\"\nimport { TuiThreadCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/tui/thread\"\nimport { TuiSpawnCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/tui/spawn\"\nimport { AcpCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/acp\"\nimport { MemoryCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/memory\"\nimport { RoomCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/room\"\nimport { EOL } from \"os\"\nimport { WebCommand } from \"./cli/cmd/web\"\n\nprocess.on(\"unhandledRejection\", (e) => {\n  Log.Default.error(\"rejection\", {\n    e: e instanceof Error ? e.message : e,\n  })\n})\n\nprocess.on(\"uncaughtException\", (e) => {\n  Log.Default.error(\"exception\", {\n    e: e instanceof Error ? e.message : e,\n  })\n})\n\nconst cli = yargs(hideBin(process.argv))\n  .scriptName(\"codesurf\")\n  .help(\"help\", \"show help\")\n  .alias(\"help\", \"h\")\n  .version(\"version\", \"show version number\", Installation.VERSION)\n  .alias(\"version\", \"v\")\n  .option(\"print-logs\", {\n    describe: \"print logs to stderr\",\n    type: \"boolean\",\n  })\n  .option(\"log-level\", {\n    describe: \"log level\",\n    type: \"string\",\n    choices: [\"DEBUG\", \"INFO\", \"WARN\", \"ERROR\"],\n  })\n  .middleware(async (opts) => {\n  ",

    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport { randomBytes } from \"crypto\"\n\nexport namespace Identifier {\n  const prefixes = {\n    session: \"ses\",\n    message: \"msg\",\n    permission: \"per\",\n    user: \"usr\",\n    part: \"prt\",\n  } as const\n\n  export function schema(prefix: keyof typeof prefixes) {\n    return z.string().startsWith(prefixes[prefix])\n  }\n\n  const LENGTH = 26\n\n  // State for monotonic ID generation\n  let lastTimestamp = 0\n  let counter = 0\n\n  export function ascending(prefix: keyof typeof prefixes, given?: string) {\n    return generateID(prefix, false, given)\n  }\n\n  export function descending(prefix: keyof typeof prefixes, given?: string) {\n    return generateID(prefix, true, given)\n  }\n\n  function generateID(prefix: keyof typeof prefixes, descending: boolean, given?: string): string {\n    if (!given) {\n      return create(prefix, descending)\n    }\n\n    if (!given.startsWith(prefixes[prefix])) {\n      throw new Error(`ID ${given} does not start with ${prefixes[prefix]}`)\n    }\n    return given\n  }\n\n  function randomBase62(length: number): string {\n    const chars = \"0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\"\n    let result = \"\"\n    const bytes = randomBytes(length)\n    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {\n      result += chars[bytes[i] % 62]\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export function create(prefix: keyof typeof prefixes, descending: boolean, timestamp?: number): string {\n    const currentTimestamp = timestamp ?? Date.now()\n\n    if (currentTimestamp !== lastTimestamp) {\n      lastTimestamp = currentTimestamp\n      counter = 0\n    }\n    counter++\n\n    let now = BigInt(currentTimestamp) * BigInt(0x1000) + BigInt(counter)\n\n    now = descending ? ~now : now\n\n    const timeBytes = Buffer.alloc(6)\n    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n      timeBytes[i] = Number((now >> BigInt(40 - 8 * i)) & BigInt(0xff))\n    }\n\n    return prefixes[prefix] + \"_\" + timeBytes.toString(\"hex\") + randomBase62(LENGTH - 12)\n  }\n}\n",

    "content": "/**\n * Global SkillSystem singleton instance\n * Similar to Config.state, provides a single shared instance across the application\n */\n\nimport { SkillSystem } from \"./skill-system\"\nimport type { SkillMetadata, LoadedSkill } from \"./types\"\n\nexport namespace SkillInstance {\n  let system: SkillSystem | null = null\n  let initPromise: Promise<SkillSystem> | null = null\n  let initialized = false\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize the skill system (async, happens once)\n   */\n  async function ensureInitialized() {\n    if (initialized && system) return system\n\n    if (initPromise) return initPromise\n\n    initPromise = (async () => {\n      console.log(\"[SkillInstance] Initializing skill system...\")\n      system = new SkillSystem({\n        debug: true,\n      })\n      await system.initialize()\n      initialized = true\n      console.log(\"[SkillInstance] Skill system initialized\")\n      return system\n    })()\n\n    return initPromise\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the global skill system instance (async)\n   */\n  export async function get() {\n    return ensureInitialized()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List all discovered skills (sync - returns empty array if not initialized yet)\n   */\n  export function list(): SkillMetadata[] {\n    if (!initialized || !system) {\n      // Start initialization in background if not started\n      ensureInitialized().catch(console.error)\n      return []\n    }\n    return system.getAllSkills()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get active skills (sync)\n   */\n  export function getActive(): LoadedSkill[] {\n    if (!initialized || !system) return []\n    return system.getActiveSkills()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if initialized\n   */\n  export function isReady(): boolean {\n    return initialized && system !== null\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Reload the skill system (re-discover skills)\n   */\n  export async function reload() {\n    const sys = await ensureInitialized()\n    await sys.reload()\n    return sys\n  }\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "src/skills/index.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System\n *\n * A complete implementation of Claude Code's skill system with progressive disclosure\n *\n * @example\n * \`\`\`ts\n * import { SkillSystem } from './skills'\n *\n * const system = new SkillSystem({ debug: true })\n * await system.initialize()\n *\n * const { activated, context } = await system.processRequest(\n *   \"Create a React component with TypeScript\"\n * )\n *\n * console.log(context) // Inject this into your LLM prompt\n * \`\`\`\n */\n\nexport { SkillSystem } from \"./skill-system\"\nexport { SkillLoader } from \"./skill-loader\"\nexport { SkillMatcher, calculateSimpleSimilarity, extractTriggerPhrases } from \"./skill-matcher\"\nexport { SkillExecutor, isValidTool, getAllToolNames } from \"./skill-executor\"\nexport { SkillInstance } from \"./instance\"\n\nexport type {\n  // Core types\n  ToolName,\n  SkillFrontmatter,\n  SkillMetadata,\n  LoadedSkill,\n\n  // Matching\n  SkillMatch,\n  SkillMatchOptions,\n\n  // Execution\n  SkillExecutionContext,\n  SkillLoadOptions,\n\n  // Configuration\n  SkillSystemConfig,\n  SkillSystemStats,\n  SkillSystemEvents,\n} from \"./types\"\n",

    "id": "src/skills/skill-matcher.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Skill Matcher\n *\n * Intelligently matches skills to user requests based on description analysis\n */\n\nimport type { SkillMetadata, SkillMatch, SkillMatchOptions } from './types'\n\n/**\n * Common stop words to filter out during matching\n */\nconst STOP_WORDS = new Set([\n  'a', 'an', 'the', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for',\n  'of', 'with', 'by', 'from', 'as', 'is', 'was', 'are', 'been', 'be',\n  'have', 'has', 'had', 'do', 'does', 'did', 'will', 'would', 'should',\n  'could', 'may', 'might', 'must', 'can', 'this', 'that', 'these', 'those',\n])\n\n/**\n * Extract keywords from text\n */\nfunction extractKeywords(text: string): string[] {\n  return text\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[^\\w\\s-]/g, ' ')\n    .split(/\\s+/)\n    .filter(word => word.length > 2 && !STOP_WORDS.has(word))\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate Jaccard similarity between two sets\n */\nfunction jaccardSimilarity(set1: Set<string>, set2: Set<string>): number {\n  const intersection = new Set([...set1].filter(x => set2.has(x)))\n  const union = new Set([...set1, ...set2])\n\n  return union.size === 0 ? 0 : intersection.size / union.size\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate keyword overlap score\n */\nfunction keywordOverlap(requestKeywords: string[], descriptionKeywords: string[]): number {\n  const requestSet = new Set(requestKeywords)\n  const descSet = new Set(descriptionKeywords)\n\n  return jaccardSimilarity(requestSet, descSet)\n}\n\n/**\n * Check for exact phrase matches\n */\nfunction phraseMatches(request: string, description: string): number {\n  const requestLower = request.toLowerCase()\n  const descLower = description.toLowerCase()\n\n  // Extract potential key phrases (2-3 word sequences)\n  const phrases = requestLower.match(/\\b\\w+\\s+\\w+(?:\\s+\\w+)?\\b/g) || []\n\n  const matches = phrases.filter(phrase => descLower.includes(phrase))\n  return matches.length / Math.max(phrases.length, 1)\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate context similarity based on additional hints\n */\nfunction contextScore(\n  request: string,\n  descripti",

    "content": "ds(text1)\n  const keywords2 = extractKeywords(text2)\n  return keywordOverlap(keywords1, keywords2)\n}\n\n/**\n * Utility: Extract trigger phrases from skill description\n */\nexport function extractTriggerPhrases(description: string): string[] {\n  const triggers: string[] = []\n  const patterns = [\n    /activate\\s+(?:when|for|if)\\s+([^.]+)/gi,\n    /use\\s+(?:when|for|if)\\s+([^.]+)/gi,\n    /invoke\\s+(?:when|for|if)\\s+([^.]+)/gi,\n    /helpful\\s+for\\s+([^.]+)/gi,\n  ]\n\n  for (const pattern of patterns) {\n    let match\n    while ((match = pattern.exec(description)) !== null) {\n      triggers.push(match[1].trim())\n    }\n  }\n\n  return triggers\n}\n",

    "id": "src/skills/examples/usage.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Usage Examples\n *\n * Demonstrates how to use the skill system in various scenarios\n */\n\nimport { SkillSystem } from '../skill-system'\n\n/**\n * Example 1: Basic usage with automatic skill activation\n */\nasync function basicUsage() {\n  console.log('\\n=== Example 1: Basic Usage ===\\n')\n\n  const system = new SkillSystem({\n    debug: true,\n    minConfidenceThreshold: 0.6,\n  })\n\n  // Initialize (discovers all skills)\n  await system.initialize()\n\n  // Process a user request - skills auto-activate\n  const result = await system.processRequest(\n    'Create a React component with hooks and TypeScript'\n  )\n\n  console.log('\\nMatched Skills:')\n  result.matches.forEach(match => {\n    console.log(`  - ${match.skill.frontmatter.name} (${Math.round(match.confidence * 100)}%)`)\n    console.log(`    Reason: ${match.reason}`)\n  })\n\n  console.log('\\nActivated Skills:', result.activated.map(s => s.frontmatter.name))\n  console.log('\\nEstimated Tokens:', result.activated.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.estimatedTokens, 0))\n\n  // Get the LLM context to inject into your prompt\n  const llmContext = system.generatePrompt()\n  console.log('\\n=== LLM Context ===')\n  console.log(llmContext.substring(0, 500) + '...')\n}\n\n/**\n * Example 2: Explicit skill activation\n */\nasync function explicitActivation() {\n  console.log('\\n=== Example 2: Explicit Activation ===\\n')\n\n  const system = new SkillSystem()\n  await system.initialize()\n\n  // Manually activate a specific skill\n  const skill = await system.activateSkill(\n    'react-components',\n    'User explicitly requested React skill'\n  )\n\n  if (skill) {\n    console.log(`Activated: ${skill.frontmatter.name}`)\n    console.log(`Tokens: ~${skill.estimatedTokens}`)\n    console.log(`Has Reference: ${skill.reference ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`)\n    console.log(`Has Examples: ${skill.examples ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`)\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Example 3: Event listening\n */\nasync function eventListening() {\n  console.log('\\n=== Example 3: Event Listening ===\\n')\n\n  co",

    "id": "src/skills/types.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Type Definitions\n *\n * Replicates the skill loading and execution system used by Claude Code\n * with progressive disclosure for optimal token efficiency.\n */\n\n/**\n * Valid tool names that can be restricted in skill execution\n */\nexport type ToolName =\n  | \"Read\"\n  | \"Write\"\n  | \"Edit\"\n  | \"Glob\"\n  | \"Grep\"\n  | \"Bash\"\n  | \"WebFetch\"\n  | \"WebSearch\"\n  | \"Task\"\n  | \"SlashCommand\"\n  | \"Skill\"\n  | \"TodoWrite\"\n  | \"AskUserQuestion\"\n  | \"NotebookEdit\"\n  | \"KillShell\"\n  | \"BashOutput\"\n\n/**\n * YAML frontmatter from SKILL.md\n * This is the lightweight metadata loaded during discovery phase\n */\nexport interface SkillFrontmatter {\n  /** Unique identifier for the skill */\n  name: string\n\n  /**\n   * Description including BOTH:\n   * - What the skill does\n   * - When to activate it\n   */\n  description: string\n\n  /**\n   * Optional: Restricts which tools can be used during skill execution\n   * If undefined, all tools are allowed\n   */\n  allowedTools?: ToolName[]\n\n  /**\n   * Optional: Additional metadata\n   */\n  [key: string]: unknown\n}\n\n/**\n * Represents a skill in discovery phase (lightweight)\n * Only frontmatter is loaded - content remains on disk\n */\nexport interface SkillMetadata {\n  /** Parsed frontmatter */\n  frontmatter: SkillFrontmatter\n\n  /** Absolute path to skill directory */\n  path: string\n\n  /** Absolute path to SKILL.md file */\n  skillFilePath: string\n\n  /** Source location (project, user, or plugin) */\n  source: \"project\" | \"user\" | \"plugin\"\n\n  /** Whether supporting files exist */\n  hasReference: boolean\n  hasExamples: boolean\n  hasScripts: boolean\n  hasTemplates: boolean\n}\n\n/**\n * Fully loaded skill with all content\n * Only loaded when skill is activated\n */\nexport interface LoadedSkill extends SkillMetadata {\n  /** Full content from SKILL.md (below frontmatter) */\n  content: string\n\n  /** Content from reference.md if exists */\n  reference?: string\n\n  /** Content from examples.md if exists */\n  examples?: string\n\n  /** List of script",

    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Main Orchestrator\n *\n * Combines loader, matcher, and executor into a complete skill system\n */\n\nimport { EventEmitter } from \"events\"\nimport { SkillLoader } from \"./skill-loader\"\nimport { SkillMatcher } from \"./skill-matcher\"\nimport { SkillExecutor } from \"./skill-executor\"\nimport type {\n  SkillSystemConfig,\n  SkillSystemStats,\n  SkillMatch,\n  SkillMatchOptions,\n  SkillLoadOptions,\n  SkillSystemEvents,\n  LoadedSkill,\n  SkillMetadata,\n} from \"./types\"\n\n/**\n * SkillSystem - Complete skill management system\n *\n * Orchestrates skill discovery, matching, loading, and execution\n * with progressive disclosure for token optimization.\n *\n * Usage:\n * \`\`\`ts\n * const system = new SkillSystem({ debug: true })\n * await system.initialize()\n *\n * // Automatic skill activation\n * const context = await system.processRequest(\"Create a React component\")\n *\n * // Use the context to inject into LLM prompt\n * const prompt = system.generatePrompt()\n * \`\`\`\n */\nexport class SkillSystem extends EventEmitter {\n  private loader: SkillLoader\n  private matcher: SkillMatcher\n  private executor: SkillExecutor\n  private initialized = false\n  private config: Required<SkillSystemConfig>\n  private stats = {\n    totalActivations: 0,\n    confidenceScores: [] as number[],\n  }\n\n  constructor(config: SkillSystemConfig = {}) {\n    super()\n\n    this.config = {\n      projectSkillsPath: config.projectSkillsPath || \".claude/skills\",\n      userSkillsPath: config.userSkillsPath || \"~/.claude/skills\",\n      loadPluginSkills: config.loadPluginSkills ?? false,\n      pluginSkillsPaths: config.pluginSkillsPaths || [],\n      minConfidenceThreshold: config.minConfidenceThreshold ?? 0.6,\n      maxActiveSkills: config.maxActiveSkills ?? 3,\n      debug: config.debug ?? false,\n    }\n\n    this.loader = new SkillLoader(this.config)\n    this.matcher = new SkillMatcher(this.config.debug)\n    this.executor = new SkillExecutor(this.config)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize the skill system (discover al",

    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Skill Executor\n *\n * Manages skill activation, execution context, and tool restrictions\n */\n\nimport type {\n  LoadedSkill,\n  SkillExecutionContext,\n  ToolName,\n  SkillSystemConfig,\n} from './types'\n\n/**\n * All available tools in Claude Code\n */\nconst ALL_TOOLS: ToolName[] = [\n  'Read',\n  'Write',\n  'Edit',\n  'Glob',\n  'Grep',\n  'Bash',\n  'WebFetch',\n  'WebSearch',\n  'Task',\n  'SlashCommand',\n  'Skill',\n  'TodoWrite',\n  'AskUserQuestion',\n  'NotebookEdit',\n  'KillShell',\n  'BashOutput',\n]\n\n/**\n * SkillExecutor - Manages skill execution and tool restrictions\n *\n * Responsibilities:\n * - Activate/deactivate skills\n * - Manage execution context\n * - Enforce tool restrictions\n * - Track token usage\n * - Generate context for LLM\n */\nexport class SkillExecutor {\n  private activeSkills: Map<string, LoadedSkill> = new Map()\n  private restrictedTools: Set<ToolName> = new Set()\n  private config: Required<SkillSystemConfig>\n  private debug: boolean\n\n  constructor(config: SkillSystemConfig = {}) {\n    this.config = {\n      projectSkillsPath: config.projectSkillsPath || '.claude/skills',\n      userSkillsPath: config.userSkillsPath || '~/.claude/skills',\n      loadPluginSkills: config.loadPluginSkills ?? false,\n      pluginSkillsPaths: config.pluginSkillsPaths || [],\n      minConfidenceThreshold: config.minConfidenceThreshold ?? 0.6,\n      maxActiveSkills: config.maxActiveSkills ?? 3,\n      debug: config.debug ?? false,\n    }\n    this.debug = this.config.debug\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Activate a skill\n   */\n  activateSkill(\n    skill: LoadedSkill,\n    userRequest: string,\n    source: 'automatic' | 'explicit' = 'automatic'\n  ): SkillExecutionContext {\n    // Check if we've hit max active skills\n    if (\n      this.activeSkills.size >= this.config.maxActiveSkills &&\n      !this.activeSkills.has(skill.frontmatter.name)\n    ) {\n      this.log(\n        `Cannot activate skill \"${skill.frontmatter.name}\": ` +\n        `max active skills (${this.config.maxActiveSkil",

    "id": "src/skills/skill-loader.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Claude Code Skill System - Skill Loader\n *\n * Handles discovery and progressive loading of skills with token optimization\n */\n\nimport { readdir, readFile, stat } from \"fs/promises\"\nimport { join, resolve } from \"path\"\nimport { homedir } from \"os\"\nimport yaml from \"yaml\"\nimport type {\n  SkillFrontmatter,\n  SkillMetadata,\n  LoadedSkill,\n  SkillSystemConfig,\n  SkillLoadOptions,\n  ToolName,\n} from \"./types\"\n\n/**\n * Parses YAML frontmatter from markdown content\n */\nfunction extractFrontmatter(content: string): {\n  frontmatter:     "content": "killName}`)\n\n      // Load SKILL.md content\n      const skillContent = await readFile(metadata.skillFilePath, \"utf-8\")\n      const { body } = extractFrontmatter(skillContent)\n\n      const loaded: LoadedSkill = {\n        ...metadata,\n        content: body,\n        estimatedTokens: estimateTokens(body),\n      }\n\n      // Load reference.md if requested and exists\n      if (options.loadReference !== false && metadata.hasReference) {\n        const refPath = join(metadata.path, \"reference.md\")\n        const refContent = await readFile(refPath, \"utf-8\")\n        loaded.reference = refContent\n        loaded.estimatedTokens += estimateTokens(refContent)\n      }\n\n      // Load examples.md if requested and exists\n      if (options.loadExamples !== false && metadata.hasExamples) {\n        const examplesPath = join(metadata.path, \"examples.md\")\n        const examplesContent = await readFile(examplesPath, \"utf-8\")\n        loaded.examples = examplesContent\n        loaded.estimatedTokens += estimateTokens(examplesContent)\n      }\n\n      // List scripts if requested and exist\n      if (options.loadScripts !== false && metadata.hasScripts) {\n        const scriptsDir = join(metadata.path, \"scripts\")\n        const scriptFiles = await readdir(scriptsDir)\n        loaded.scripts = scriptFiles.map((f) => join(scriptsDir, f))\n      }\n\n      // List templates if requested and exist\n      if (options.loadTemplates !== false && metadata.hasTemplates) {\n        const templatesDir = join(metadata.path, \"templates\")\n        const templateFiles = await readdir(templatesDir)\n        loaded.templates = templateFiles.map((f) => join(templatesDir, f))\n      }\n\n      // Check token limit\n      if (options.maxTokens && loaded.estimatedTokens > options.maxTokens) {\n        this.log(\n          `Skill ${skillName} exceeds token limit: ${loaded.estimatedTokens} > ${options.maxTokens}`,\n          \"warn\",\n        )\n      }\n\n      this.loadedSkills.set(skillName, loaded)\n      this.log(`Loaded skill ${skillName",

  {
    "id": "src/skills/demo.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Simple working demo of the skill system\n */\n\nimport { SkillSystem } from './skill-system'\nimport { join, dirname } from 'path'\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url'\n\nconst __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))\n\nasync function demo() {\n  console.log('='.repeat(80))\n  console.log('SKILL SYSTEM DEMO')\n  console.log('='.repeat(80))\n\n  const skillsPath = join(__dirname, 'examples', 'example-skills')\n\n  const system = new SkillSystem({\n    projectSkillsPath: skillsPath,\n    userSkillsPath: '/nonexistent',\n    minConfidenceThreshold: 0.05, // Lower threshold for demo\n    debug: true,\n  })\n\n  console.log('\\n[1] INITIALIZING...\\n')\n  await system.initialize()\n\n  const stats = system.getStats()\n  console.log(`\\n✅ Found ${stats.totalSkills} skills`)\n\n  console.log('\\n[2] PROCESSING REQUEST: \"Create a React component with TypeScript\"\\n')\n  const result = await system.processRequest('Create a React component with TypeScript')\n\n  console.log(`\\n✅ Activated ${result.activated.length} skills`)\n  result.activated.forEach(skill => {\n    console.log(`   - ${skill.frontmatter.name} (~${skill.estimatedTokens} tokens)`)\n  })\n\n  console.log('\\n[3] GENERATED CONTEXT (first 500 chars):\\n')\n  const context = system.generatePrompt()\n  console.log(context.substring(0, 500) + '...\\n')\n\n  console.log('='.repeat(80))\n}\n\ndemo().catch(console.error)\n",

    "content": "/**\n * Transcription Service\n *\n * Real-time speech-to-text for LiveKit rooms using Web Speech API\n * Optional Deepgram integration for better accuracy\n */\n\nimport type {\n  TranscriptionConfig,\n  TranscriptionResult,\n  TranscriptionEvents,\n  TranscriptionError,\n} from \"./types\"\n\n/**\n * Speech recognition service for transcribing audio\n */\nexport class TranscriptionService {\n  private config: TranscriptionConfig\n  private recognition?: SpeechRecognition\n  private isTranscribing = false\n  private eventHandlers: Partial<TranscriptionEvents> = {}\n\n  constructor(config?: Partial<TranscriptionConfig>) {\n    this.config = {\n      provider: config?.provider || \"browser\",\n      language: config?.language || \"en-US\",\n      interimResults: config?.interimResults ?? true,\n      continuousMode: config?.continuousMode ?? true,\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // Transcription Control\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  /**\n   * Start transcription\n   */\n  async startTranscription(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.isTranscribing) {\n      throw this.createError(\"Transcription already started\", \"browser\")\n    }\n\n    if (this.config.provider === \"browser\") {\n      await this.startBrowserRecognition()\n    } else if (this.config.provider === \"deepgram\") {\n      throw this.createError(\"Deepgram provider not yet implemented\", \"deepgram\")\n    } else if (this.config.provider === \"openai\") {\n      throw this.createError(\"OpenAI provider not yet implemented\", \"openai\")\n    }\n\n    this.isTranscribing = true\n    this.emit(\"started\")\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Stop transcription\n   */\n  async stopTranscription(): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.isTranscribing) return\n\n    if (this.recognition) {\n      this.recognition.stop()\n      this.recognition = undefined\n    }\n\n    this.isTranscribing = false\n    this.emit(\"stopped\")\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if currently transcribing\n   */\n  isActive(): boolean {\n ",

    "id": "src/livekit/index.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * OpenCode LiveKit Integration\n *\n * Room-based voice collaboration with AI assistance\n */\n\nexport { RoomManager } from \"./room-manager\"\nexport { TranscriptionService, createTranscriptionService } from \"./transcription\"\nexport { OpenCodeRoomAgent, createRoomAgent } from \"./room-agent\"\nexport { ToolBridge, createToolBridge } from \"./tool-bridge\"\n\nexport type {\n  // Configuration\n  LiveKitConfig,\n  RoomOptions,\n  RoomConnectionState,\n  AudioConfig,\n  MicrophoneState,\n\n  // Participants and Tracks\n  Participant,\n  AudioTrack,\n  DataTrack,\n\n  // Transcription\n  TranscriptionConfig,\n  TranscriptionResult,\n\n  // Room Agent\n  RoomAgentConfig,\n  AgentCapabilities,\n  ConversationNote,\n  ConversationTodo,\n\n  // Tool Bridge\n  Tool,\n  ToolParameter,\n  ToolRegistry,\n  ToolRequest,\n  ToolResponse,\n  ToolPermission,\n\n  // Messages\n  DataChannelMessage,\n  ToolRequestMessage,\n  ToolResponseMessage,\n  ToolDiscoveryMessage,\n  AgentStatusMessage,\n  TranscriptionMessage,\n\n  // Events\n  RoomEvents,\n  TranscriptionEvents,\n  AgentEvents,\n\n  // Errors\n  LiveKitError,\n  ToolExecutionError,\n  TranscriptionError,\n} from \"./types\"\n",

    "id": "src/livekit/room-manager.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * LiveKit Room Manager\n *\n * Simplified room connection and audio management for OpenCode\n * Uses @livekit/rtc-node for Node.js/Bun compatibility\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  type RemoteParticipant,\n  type RemoteTrack,\n  type RemoteTrackPublication,\n  RoomEvent,\n  ConnectionState,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport type {\n  LiveKitConfig,\n  RoomOptions,\n  RoomConnectionState,\n  AudioConfig,\n  MicrophoneState,\n  Participant,\n  AudioTrack,\n  DataChannelMessage,\n  RoomEvents,\n  LiveKitError,\n} from \"./types\"\n\n/**\n * Manages LiveKit room connections and audio\n */\nexport class RoomManager {\n  private room?: Room\n  private localAudioTrack?: LocalAudioTrack\n  private config: LiveKitConfig\n  private audioConfig: AudioConfig\n  private microphoneState: MicrophoneState\n  private eventHandlers: Partial<RoomEvents> = {}\n\n  constructor(config: LiveKitConfig) {\n    this.config = config\n    this.audioConfig = {\n      echoCancellation: true,\n      noiseSuppression: true,\n      autoGainControl: true,\n      sampleRate: 48000,\n      channelCount: 1,\n    }\n    this.microphoneState = {\n      enabled: false,\n      volume: 1.0,\n      muted: false,\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // Connection Management\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  /**\n   * Connect to LiveKit server and join a room\n   */\n  async connect(options: RoomOptions): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const token = await this.generateToken(options)\n\n      this.room = new Room()\n      this.setupEventListeners()\n\n      await this.room.connect(this.config.serverUrl, token, {\n        autoSubscribe: options.autoSubscribe ?? true,\n        dynacast: options.dynacast ?? true,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      throw this.createError(\"Failed to connect to LiveKit room\", \"CONNECT_FAILED\", error)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Disconnect from current room\n   */\n  async disconnect(): Prom",

ConversationTodo[\"priority\"] {\n    if (/urgent|asap|critical|immediately/i.test(text)) return \"high\"\n    if (/soon|important/i.test(text)) return \"medium\"\n    return \"low\"\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Extract hashtags or keywords as tags\n   */\n  private extractTags(text: string): string[] {\n    const tags: string[] = []\n\n    // Extract hashtags\n    const hashtagMatches = text.match(/#(\\w+)/g)\n    if (hashtagMatches) {\n      tags.push(...hashtagMatches.map((tag) => tag.slice(1)))\n    }\n\n    return tags\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // Event Handling\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  /**\n   * Setup internal event handlers\n   */\n  private setupEventHandlers(): void {\n    // Handle room events\n    this.roomManager.on(\"participantJoined\", (participant) => {\n      console.log(`Participant joined: ${participant.name}`)\n    })\n\n    this.roomManager.on(\"participantLeft\", (participant) => {\n      console.log(`Participant left: ${participant.name}`)\n    })\n\n    this.roomManager.on(\"dataReceived\", (message, participant) => {\n      console.log(`Data received from ${participant.name}:`, message)\n      // TODO: Handle tool requests and other data messages\n    })\n\n    // Handle transcription events\n    this.transcription.on(\"final\", (result) => {\n      this.onSpeech(result.text, result.speaker)\n    })\n\n    this.transcription.on(\"interim\", (result) => {\n      // Could show interim results in UI\n      console.log(`Interim: ${result.text}`)\n    })\n\n    this.transcription.on(\"error\", (error) => {\n      this.emit(\"error\", error)\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register event handler\n   */\n  on<K extends keyof AgentEvents>(event: K, handler: AgentEvents[K]): void {\n    this.eventHandlers[event] = handler as any\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Unregister event handler\n   */\n ",

    "id": "src/livekit/types.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * LiveKit Integration Types\n *\n * Core type definitions for OpenCode's simplified LiveKit room-based voice collaboration\n */\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Configuration\n// ============================================================================\n\nexport interface LiveKitConfig {\n  serverUrl: string\n  apiKey: string\n  apiSecret: string\n  defaultRoomName?: string\n}\n\nexport interface RoomOptions {\n  name: string\n  participantName?: string\n  autoSubscribe?: boolean\n  dynacast?: boolean\n  adaptiveStream?: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface RoomConnectionState {\n  connected: boolean\n  roomName?: string\n  participantId?: string\n  participantCount: number\n  audioEnabled: boolean\n  connectionError?: string\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Audio Configuration\n// ============================================================================\n\nexport interface AudioConfig {\n  echoCancellation: boolean\n  noiseSuppression: boolean\n  autoGainControl: boolean\n  sampleRate: number\n  channelCount: number\n}\n\nexport interface MicrophoneState {\n  enabled: boolean\n  volume: number\n  muted: boolean\n  deviceId?: string\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Participant Types\n// ============================================================================\n\nexport interface Participant {\n  id: string\n  identity: string\n  name?: string\n  metadata?: Record<string, any>\n  isAgent: boolean\n  isSpeaking: boolean\n  audioTracks: AudioTrack[]\n  dataTracks: DataTrack[]\n  joinedAt: number\n}\n\nexport interface AudioTrack {\n  sid: string\n  participantId: string\n  enabled: boolean\n  volume: number\n}\n\nexport interface DataTrack {\n  sid: string\n  participantId: string\n  label?: string\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Transcription Types\n// ===============================================================",

    "id": "src/livekit/tool-bridge.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Tool Bridge\n *\n * Bidirectional tool sharing between OpenCode and external agents in LiveKit rooms\n * Uses JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over LiveKit data channels\n */\n\nimport type { RoomManager } from \"./room-manager\"\nimport type {\n  Tool,\n  ToolRegistry,\n  ToolRequest,\n  ToolResponse,\n  ToolPermission,\n  ToolRequestMessage,\n  ToolResponseMessage,\n  ToolDiscoveryMessage,\n  DataChannelMessage,\n  Participant,\n} from \"./types\"\n\n/**\n * Manages bidirectional tool access between agents\n */\nexport class ToolBridge {\n  private roomManager: RoomManager\n  private registry: ToolRegistry\n  private permissions: Map<string, ToolPermission> = new Map()\n  private pendingRequests: Map<\n    string,\n    {\n      resolve: (value: any) => void\n      reject: (error: Error) => void\n      timeout: NodeJS.Timeout\n    }\n  > = new Map()\n\n  // Configuration\n  private readonly REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 30000 // 30 seconds\n  private readonly MAX_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE = 60\n\n  // Rate limiting\n  private requestCounts: Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: number }> = new Map()\n\n  constructor(roomManager: RoomManager) {\n    this.roomManager = roomManager\n    this.registry = {\n      local: [],\n      external: new Map(),\n    }\n\n    this.setupEventHandlers()\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // Local Tool Management\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  /**\n   * Register OpenCode tools to expose to external agents\n   */\n  async exposeTools(tools: Tool[]): Promise<void> {\n    this.registry.local = tools\n\n    // Announce tools to room\n    await this.announceTools()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a single tool\n   */\n  async exposeTool(tool: Tool): Promise<void> {\n    const existing = this.registry.local.findIndex((t) => t.name === tool.name)\n    if (existing >= 0) {\n      this.registry.local[existing] = tool\n    } else {\n      this.registry.local.push(tool)\n    }\n\n    await this.announceTools()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Unregister",

clearTimeout(timeout)\n        this.pendingRequests.delete(request.id)\n        reject(error)\n      })\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Handle incoming data channel message\n   */\n  private async handleDataMessage(\n    message: DataChannelMessage,\n    participant: Participant,\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    switch (message.type) {\n      case \"tool.discovery\":\n        this.handleToolDiscovery(message.payload, participant)\n        break\n\n      case \"tool.request\":\n        const response = await this.handleToolRequest(message.payload, participant)\n        await this.sendToolResponse(participant.id, response)\n        break\n\n      case \"tool.response\":\n        this.handleToolResponse(message.payload)\n        break\n\n      default:\n        console.warn(\"Unknown message type:\", message)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Handle tool discovery announcement\n   */\n  private handleToolDiscovery(\n    payload: ToolDiscoveryMessage[\"payload\"],\n    participant: Participant,\n  ): void {\n    const tools: Tool[] = payload.tools.map((toolDef) => ({\n      name: toolDef.name,\n      description: toolDef.description,\n      parameters: toolDef.parameters,\n      execute: async (params: Record<string, any>) => {\n        return await this.executeExternalTool(payload.agentId, toolDef.name, params)\n      },\n    }))\n\n    this.registry.external.set(payload.agentId, tools)\n    console.log(`Discovered ${tools.length} tools from agent: ${payload.agentId}`)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Send tool response\n   */\n  private async     "id": "src/format/index.ts",
    "content": "import { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { File } from \"../file\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport path from \"path\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\n\nimport * as Formatter from \"./formatter\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { mergeDeep } from \"remeda\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\n\nexport namespace Format {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"format\" })\n\n  export const Status = z\n    .object({\n      name: z.string(),\n      extensions: z.string().array(),\n      enabled: z.boolean(),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"FormatterStatus\",\n    })\n  export type Status = z.infer<typeof Status>\n\n  const state = Instance.state(async () => {\n    const enabled: Record<string, boolean> = {}\n    const cfg = await Config.get()\n\n    const formatters: Record<string, Formatter.Info> = {}\n    for (const item of Object.values(Formatter)) {\n      formatters[item.name] = item\n    }\n    for (const [name, item] of Object.entries(cfg.formatter ?? {})) {\n      if (item.disabled) {\n        delete formatters[name]\n        continue\n      }\n      const result: Formatter.Info = mergeDeep(formatters[name] ?? {}, {\n        command: [],\n        extensions: [],\n        ...item,\n      })\n      result.enabled = async () => true\n      result.name = name\n      formatters[name] = result\n    }\n\n    return {\n      enabled,\n      formatters,\n    }\n  })\n\n  async function isEnabled(item: Formatter.Info) {\n    const s = await state()\n    let status = s.enabled[item.name]\n    if (status === undefined) {\n      status = await item.enabled()\n      s.enabled[item.name] = status\n    }\n    return status\n  }\n\n  async function getFormatter(ext: string) {\n    const formatters = await state().then((x) => x.formatters)\n    const result = []\n    for (const item of Object.values(formatters)) {\n      log.info(\"checking\", { name: item.name, ext })\n      if (!item.extensions.includes(ext)) continue\n      if (!(await isEnabled(item))) continue\n      log.info(\"enabled\", { name: item.name, ext })\n      result.pu",

    "id": "src/raid/raid-orchestrator.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * RAID Orchestrator - AI-powered document sharding and query orchestration\n * Handles intelligent document routing, parallel shard processing, and answer fusion\n */\n\nimport OpenAI from \"openai\"\nimport { get_encoding } from \"@dqbd/tiktoken\"\nimport type { RaidConfig, RaidShard, RaidQueryProgress } from \"./raid-types\"\nimport type { RaidKnowledgeBase } from \"./raid-kb\"\n\nconst encoding = get_encoding(\"cl100k_base\")\n\ninterface ShardWithScore {\n  shard: RaidShard\n  score: number\n  reasoning: string\n}\n\ninterface ShardAnswer {\n  shardId: string\n  answer: string\n  confidence: number\n  sources: string[]\n}\n\n/**\n * RAID Orchestrator - manages document sharding and query orchestration\n */\nexport class RaidOrchestrator {\n  private client: OpenAI\n  private config: RaidConfig\n  private kb: RaidKnowledgeBase\n\n  constructor(config: RaidConfig, kb: RaidKnowledgeBase) {\n    this.config = config\n    this.kb = kb\n    this.client = new OpenAI({\n      apiKey: config.apiKey,\n      baseURL: config.baseUrl,\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shard a document into overlapping chunks\n   */\n  async shardDocument(documentId: string, content: string): Promise<RaidShard[]> {\n    const tokens = encoding.encode(content)\n    const totalTokens = tokens.length\n    const shardSize = this.config.maxTokensPerShard\n    const overlap = this.config.overlapTokens\n    const shards: RaidShard[] = []\n\n    let startToken = 0\n    let shardIndex = 0\n\n    while (startToken < totalTokens) {\n      const endToken = Math.min(startToken + shardSize, totalTokens)\n      const shardTokens = tokens.slice(startToken, endToken)\n      const shardContent = new TextDecoder().decode(encoding.decode(shardTokens))\n\n      shards.push({\n        id: `${documentId}-shard-${shardIndex}`,\n        content: shardContent,\n        startToken,\n        endToken,\n        documentId,\n      })\n\n      shardIndex++\n      startToken = endToken - overlap\n\n      // Prevent infinite loop for very small documents\n      if (endToken >= totalTokens) break\n    }\n\n  ",

orchestrateQuery(\n    query: string,\n    documentIds?: string[],\n    onProgress?: (progress: RaidQueryProgress) => void,\n  ): Promise<string> {\n    try {\n      onProgress?.({\n        type: \"routing\",\n        message: \"Finding relevant documents...\",\n      })\n\n      // Get relevant documents\n      let documents\n      if (documentIds && documentIds.length > 0) {\n        documents = documentIds\n          .map((id) => this.kb.getDocument(id))\n          .filter((doc): doc is NonNullable<typeof doc> => doc !== null)\n      } else {\n        // Search for relevant documents\n        const searchResults = this.kb.search(query, { maxResults: 5 })\n        documents = searchResults.map((r) => r.document)\n      }\n\n      if (documents.length === 0) {\n        return \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\"\n      }\n\n      onProgress?.({\n        type: \"routing\",\n        message: `Found ${documents.length} relevant document(s), preparing shards...`,\n      })\n\n      // Shard all documents and collect shards\n      const allShards: RaidShard[] = []\n      for (const doc of documents) {\n        const docShards = await this.shardDocument(doc.id, doc.content)\n        allShards.push(...docShards)\n      }\n\n      onProgress?.({\n        type: \"routing\",\n        message: `Created ${allShards.length} shards, routing query...`,\n      })\n\n      // Route query to best shards\n      const routedShards = await this.routeQuery(query, allShards, this.config.maxConcurrentShards)\n\n      onProgress?.({\n     "id": "src/raid/raid-config.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * RAID Configuration Management\n * Loads and validates RAID system configuration from environment and defaults\n */\n\nimport { join } from \"node:path\"\nimport { homedir } from \"node:os\"\nimport type { RaidConfig } from \"./raid-types\"\n\n/**\n * Default RAID configuration values\n */\nconst DEFAULTS = {\n  globalKbPath: join(homedir(), \".opencode\", \"raid\"),\n  enableAutoIndexing: true,\n  maxConcurrentShards: 5,\n  baseUrl: \"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\n  shardModel: \"gpt-4o-mini\",\n  orchModel: \"gpt-4o\",\n  maxTokensPerShard: 4000,\n  numShards: 10,\n  overlapTokens: 200,\n} as const\n\n/**\n * Load RAID configuration from environment and defaults\n */\nexport function loadRaidConfig(projectRoot?: string): RaidConfig {\n  const root = projectRoot ?? process.cwd()\n  const globalKb = process.env.RAID_GLOBAL_KB_PATH ?? DEFAULTS.globalKbPath\n\n  return {\n    projectRoot: root,\n    globalKbPath: globalKb,\n    dbPath: join(root, \".opencode\", \"raid.db\"),\n    enableAutoIndexing:\n      process.env.RAID_AUTO_INDEX === \"false\" ? false : DEFAULTS.enableAutoIndexing,\n    maxConcurrentShards: parseInt(\n      process.env.RAID_MAX_CONCURRENT ?? String(DEFAULTS.maxConcurrentShards),\n      10,\n    ),\n    baseUrl: process.env.RAID_BASE_URL ?? process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL ?? DEFAULTS.baseUrl,\n    apiKey: process.env.RAID_API_KEY ?? process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY ?? \"\",\n    shardModel: process.env.RAID_SHARD_MODEL ?? DEFAULTS.shardModel,\n    orchModel: process.env.RAID_ORCH_MODEL ?? DEFAULTS.orchModel,\n    maxTokensPerShard: parseInt(\n      process.env.RAID_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SHARD ?? String(DEFAULTS.maxTokensPerShard),\n      10,\n    ),\n    numShards: parseInt(process.env.RAID_NUM_SHARDS ?? String(DEFAULTS.numShards), 10),\n    overlapTokens: parseInt(process.env.RAID_OVERLAP_TOKENS ?? String(DEFAULTS.overlapTokens), 10),\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Validate RAID configuration\n */\nexport function validateRaidConfig(config: RaidConfig): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {\n  const errors: string[] = []\n\n  if (!config.projectRoot)",

    "id": "src/raid/raid-kb.ts [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * RAID Knowledge Base - SQLite-backed document storage with FTS\n * Handles document CRUD operations, full-text search, and metadata management\n */\n\nimport { Database } from \"bun:sqlite\"\nimport { mkdir } from \"node:fs/promises\"\nimport { dirname } from \"node:path\"\nimport { get_encoding } from \"@dqbd/tiktoken\"\nimport matter from \"gray-matter\"\nimport type {\n  RaidDocument,\n  RaidSearchOptions,\n  RaidSearchResult,\n  RaidStats,\n  RaidConfig,\n  RaidDocumentMetadata,\n} from \"./raid-types\"\n\nconst encoding = get_encoding(\"cl100k_base\")\n\n/**\n * RAID Knowledge Base - manages documents in SQLite with FTS\n */\nexport class RaidKnowledgeBase {\n  private db: Database\n  private config: RaidConfig\n\n  constructor(config: RaidConfig) {\n    this.config = config\n    this.db = this.initDatabase(config.dbPath)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize SQLite database with schema\n   */\n  private initDatabase(dbPath: string): Database {\n    // Ensure directory exists\n    mkdir(dirname(dbPath), { recursive: true }).catch(() => {})\n\n    const db = new Database(dbPath, { create: true })\n    db.run(\"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL\")\n    db.run(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n\n    // Create documents table\n    db.run(`\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        content TEXT NOT NULL,\n        file_path TEXT,\n        tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n        keywords TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n        source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('project', 'global')),\n        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        token_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n        shard_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n        content_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text',\n        extracted_keywords TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n        summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n        file_size INTEGER,\n        last_modified INTEGER,\n        file_type TEXT\n      )\n    `)\n\n    // Create FTS virtual table for full-text search\n    db.run(`\n      CREATE VIRTUAL ",

    "content": "er } = {},\n  ): RaidDocument[] {\n    const { source, limit = 100, offset = 0 } = options\n\n    let sql = \"SELECT * FROM documents\"\n    const params: any[] = []\n\n    if (source) {\n      sql += \" WHERE source = ?\"\n      params.push(source)\n    }\n\n    sql += \" ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\"\n    params.push(limit, offset)\n\n    const rows = this.db.query(sql).all(...params) as any[]\n\n    return rows.map((row) => this.rowToDocument(row))\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Delete document by ID\n   */\n  deleteDocument(id: string): boolean {\n    this.db.run(\"DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = ?\", [id])\n    return true // Bun SQLite doesn't return changes count easily\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Delete all documents from a source\n   */\n  deleteAllDocuments(source?: \"project\" | \"global\"): number {\n    let sql = \"DELETE FROM documents\"\n\n    if (source) {\n      sql += \" WHERE source = ?\"\n      this.db.run(sql, [source])\n    } else {\n      this.db.run(sql, [])\n    }\n\n    return 0 // Bun SQLite doesn't return changes count easily\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get knowledge base statistics\n   */\n  getStats(): RaidStats {\n    const total = this.db\n      .query(\"SELECT COUNT(*) as count, SUM(token_count) as tokens FROM documents\")\n      .get() as any\n\n    const project = this.db\n      .query(\"SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM documents WHERE source = 'project'\")\n      .get() as any\n\n    const global = this.db\n      .query(\"SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM documents WHERE source = 'global'\")\n      .get() as any\n\n    const keywords = this.db\n      .query(\n        `\n      SELECT json_each.value as keyword, COUNT(*) as count\n      FROM documents, json_each(documents.keywords)\n      GROUP BY keyword\n      ORDER BY count DESC\n      LIMIT 20\n    `,\n      )\n      .all() as any[]\n\n    const totalDocs = total.count || 0\n    const totalTokens = total.tokens || 0\n\n    return {\n      totalDocuments: totalDocs,\n      projectDocuments: project.count || 0,\n      globalDocuments: global.count || 0,\n      totalTokens,\n      avgTokensPerDocumen",

    "id": "src/raid/raid-types.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * TypeScript type definitions for RAID system\n */\n\nexport interface RaidConfig {\n  projectRoot: string\n  globalKbPath: string\n  dbPath: string\n  enableAutoIndexing: boolean\n  maxConcurrentShards: number\n  baseUrl: string\n  apiKey: string\n  shardModel: string\n  orchModel: string\n  maxTokensPerShard: number\n  numShards: number\n  overlapTokens: number\n}\n\nexport interface RaidDocument {\n  id: string\n  title: string\n  content: string\n  filePath?: string\n  tags: string[]\n  keywords: string[]\n  source: \"project\" | \"global\"\n  createdAt: Date\n  updatedAt: Date\n  tokenCount: number\n  shardIds: string[]\n  metadata: RaidDocumentMetadata\n}\n\nexport interface RaidDocumentMetadata {\n  contentType: \"markdown\" | \"code\" | \"text\" | \"other\"\n  extractedKeywords: string[]\n  summary: string\n  fileSize?: number\n  lastModified?: Date\n  fileType?: string\n}\n\nexport interface RaidSearchOptions {\n  maxResults?: number\n  includeContent?: boolean\n  sourceFilter?: \"project\" | \"global\" | \"both\"\n  tagsFilter?: string[]\n  contentTypeFilter?: (\"markdown\" | \"code\" | \"text\" | \"other\")[]\n}\n\nexport interface RaidSearchResult {\n  document: RaidDocument\n  relevanceScore: number\n  snippets: string[]\n  highlightedContent?: string\n}\n\nexport interface RaidIngestionProgress {\n  type: \"start\" | \"processing\" | \"indexing\" | \"complete\" | \"error\"\n  progress?: number\n  message: string\n  error?: string\n}\n\nexport interface RaidStats {\n  totalDocuments: number\n  projectDocuments: number\n  globalDocuments: number\n  totalTokens: number\n  avgTokensPerDocument: number\n  topKeywords: Array<{ keyword: string; count: number }>\n  lastUpdated: Date\n}\n\nexport interface RaidShard {\n  id: string\n  content: string\n  startToken: number\n  endToken: number\n  documentId?: string\n}\n\nexport interface RaidQueryProgress {\n  type: \"routing\" | \"querying\" | \"fusing\" | \"complete\" | \"error\"\n  message: string\n  shardsQueried?: number\n  totalShards?: number\n  error?: string\n}\n",

    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport * as path from \"path\"\nimport * as fs from \"fs/promises\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\n\nexport namespace Patch {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"patch\" })\n\n  // Schema definitions\n  export const PatchSchema = z.object({\n    patchText: z.string().describe(\"The full patch text that describes all changes to be made\"),\n  })\n\n  export type PatchParams = z.infer<typeof PatchSchema>\n\n  // Core types matching the Rust implementation\n  export interface ApplyPatchArgs {\n    patch: string\n    hunks: Hunk[]\n    workdir?: string\n  }\n\n  export type Hunk = \n    | { type: \"add\"; path: string; contents: string }\n    | { type: \"delete\"; path: string }\n    | { type: \"update\"; path: string; move_path?: string; chunks: UpdateFileChunk[] }\n\n  export interface UpdateFileChunk {\n    old_lines: string[]\n    new_lines: string[]\n    change_context?: string\n    is_end_of_file?: boolean\n  }\n\n  export interface ApplyPatchAction {\n    changes: Map<string, ApplyPatchFileChange>\n    patch: string\n    cwd: string\n  }\n\n  export type ApplyPatchFileChange =\n    | { type: \"add\"; content: string }\n    | { type: \"delete\"; content: string }\n    | { type: \"update\"; unified_diff: string; move_path?: string; new_content: string }\n\n  export interface AffectedPaths {\n    added: string[]\n    modified: string[]\n    deleted: string[]\n  }\n\n  export enum ApplyPatchError {\n    ParseError = \"ParseError\",\n    IoError = \"IoError\",\n    ComputeReplacements = \"ComputeReplacements\",\n    ImplicitInvocation = \"ImplicitInvocation\",\n  }\n\n  export enum MaybeApplyPatch {\n    Body = \"Body\",\n    ShellParseError = \"ShellParseError\",\n    PatchParseError = \"PatchParseError\",\n    NotApplyPatch = \"NotApplyPatch\",\n  }\n\n  export enum MaybeApplyPatchVerified {\n    Body = \"Body\",\n    ShellParseError = \"ShellParseError\",\n    CorrectnessError = \"CorrectnessError\",\n    NotApplyPatch = \"NotApplyPatch\",\n  }\n\n  // Parser implementation\n  function parsePatchHeader(lines: string[], startIdx: number): { filePath: s",

    "id": "src/patch/index.ts [chunk 3/3]",
    "content": "    try {\n        parsePatch(argv[0])\n        return {\n          type: MaybeApplyPatchVerified.CorrectnessError,\n          error: new Error(ApplyPatchError.ImplicitInvocation),\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // Not a patch, continue\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const result = maybeParseApplyPatch(argv)\n    \n    switch (result.type) {\n      case MaybeApplyPatch.Body:\n        const { args } = result\n        const effectiveCwd = args.workdir ? path.resolve(cwd, args.workdir) : cwd\n        const changes = new Map<string, ApplyPatchFileChange>()\n        \n        for (const hunk of args.hunks) {\n          const resolvedPath = path.resolve(effectiveCwd, hunk.type === \"update\" && hunk.move_path ? hunk.move_path : hunk.path)\n          \n          switch (hunk.type) {\n            case \"add\":\n              changes.set(resolvedPath, {\n                type: \"add\",\n                content: hunk.contents,\n              })\n              break\n              \n            case \"delete\":\n              // For delete, we need to read the current content\n              const deletePath = path.resolve(effectiveCwd, hunk.path)\n              try {\n                const content = await fs.readFile(deletePath, \"utf-8\")\n                changes.set(resolvedPath, {\n                  type: \"delete\",\n                  content,\n                })\n              } catch (error) {\n                return {\n                  type: MaybeApplyPatchVerified.CorrectnessError,\n                  error: new Error(`Failed to read file for deletion: ${deletePath}`),\n                }\n              }\n              break\n              \n            case \"update\":\n              const updatePath = path.resolve(effectiveCwd, hunk.path)\n              try {\n                const fileUpdate = deriveNewContentsFromChunks(updatePath, hunk.chunks)\n                changes.set(resolvedPath, {\n                  type: \"update\",\n                  unified_diff: fileUpdate.unified_diff,\n                  move_path: hunk.move_path ? path",

    "content": "import { Plugin } from \"../plugin\"\nimport { Share } from \"../share/share\"\nimport { Format } from \"../format\"\nimport { LSP } from \"../lsp\"\nimport { FileWatcher } from \"../file/watcher\"\nimport { File } from \"../file\"\nimport { Flag } from \"../flag/flag\"\nimport { Project } from \"./project\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Command } from \"../command\"\nimport { Instance } from \"./instance\"\n\nexport async function InstanceBootstrap() {\n  if (Flag.OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_NO_BOOTSTRAP) return\n  await Plugin.init()\n  Share.init()\n  Format.init()\n  await LSP.init()\n  FileWatcher.init()\n  File.init()\n\n  Bus.subscribe(Command.Event.Executed, async (payload) => {\n    if (payload.properties.name === Command.Default.INIT) {\n      await Project.setInitialized(Instance.project.id)\n    }\n  })\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "test-render.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test script to verify plugin rendering works\n */\n\nimport { Plugin } from \"./src/plugin\"\nimport { UIRegistry } from \"./src/ui/registry\"\nimport { Instance } from \"./src/project/instance\"\n\nasync function main() {\n  console.log(\"🔍 Testing plugin render...\\n\")\n\n  await Instance.provide({\n    directory: process.cwd(),\n    async fn() {\n      // Load plugins\n      const plugins = await Plugin.list()\n      console.log(`✅ Loaded ${plugins.length} plugins\\n`)\n\n      // Check what ui.render hooks exist\n      console.log(\"Checking ui.render hooks:\")\n      for (const plugin of plugins) {\n        const hasRender = !!(plugin as any)[\"ui.render\"]\n        console.log(`  Plugin has ui.render: ${hasRender}`)\n      }\n      console.log()\n\n      // Try to render the component\n      console.log(\"Attempting to render context-panel...\")\n      const result = await UIRegistry.renderComponent(\"context-panel\", {\n        sessionID: \"test-session\",\n        theme: { text: \"#fff\", textMuted: \"#888\" },\n      })\n\n      console.log(\"\\nRender result:\")\n      console.log(\"  Type:\", result.type)\n      console.log(\"  Has component:\", !!result.component)\n      console.log(\"  Has content:\", !!result.content)\n      console.log(\"  Error:\", result.error)\n      if (result.content) {\n        console.log(\"  Content:\", result.content)\n      }\n    },\n  })\n}\n\nmain().catch(console.error)\n",

    "id": "generate-sdk.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\n\nconst sdkDir = \"../sdk/stainless\"\nprocess.chdir(sdkDir)\n\nconsole.log(\"=== Generating Stainless SDK ===\")\nconsole.log(\"Working directory:\", process.cwd())\n\n// Clean up old go SDK\nawait $`rm -rf go`\n\n// Generate OpenAPI spec\nconsole.log(\"\\n1. Generating OpenAPI spec...\")\nawait $`bun run --conditions=node ../../opencode/src/index.ts generate > openapi.json`\nconsole.log(\"✓ OpenAPI spec generated\")\n\n// Generate Go SDK using Stainless\nconsole.log(\"\\n2. Generating Go SDK with Stainless...\")\nawait $`stl builds create --branch main --pull --allow-empty --+target go`\n\n// Move Go SDK to packages/sdk/go\nconsole.log(\"\\n3. Moving Go SDK to packages/sdk/go...\")\nawait $`rm -rf ../go`\nawait $`mv opencode-go/ ../go`\nawait $`rm -rf ../go/.git`\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n✓ SDK generation complete!\")\nconsole.log(\"✓ Go SDK available at packages/sdk/go\")\n",

  {
    "id": "test-lg-speakers.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test with explicit LG HDR 5K speaker output\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  RoomEvent,\n  AudioSource,\n  LocalAudioTrack,\n  TrackPublishOptions,\n  AudioFrame,\n  AudioStream,\n  RemoteAudioTrack,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url:     "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Debug: Check if we're publishing with correct track source\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  RoomEvent,\n  AudioSource,\n  LocalAudioTrack,\n  TrackPublishOptions,\n  AudioFrame,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n  participantName: \"Source Debug\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: config.participantName,\n    name: config.participantName,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ roomJoin: true, room: config.roomName, canPublish: true, canSubscribe: true })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  let micProcess: ReturnType<typeof spawn> | null = null\n\n  try {\n    const token = await generateToken()\n    const room = new Room()\n\n    console.log(\"🔍 Track Source Debug\")\n    console.log(\"=\".repeat(50))\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished, (publication, participant) => {\n      if (participant.identity === config.participantName) {\n        console.log(\"\\n📤 OUR TRACK PUBLISHED:\")\n        console.log(`   Name: ${publication.name}`)\n        console.log(`   SID: ${publication.sid}`)\n        console.log(`   Kind: ${publication.kind} (1=audio)`)\n        console.log(`   Source: ${publication.source}`)\n        console.log(`   Muted: ${publication.muted}`)\n\n        // Check what source values mean\n        console.log(\"\\n📋 Source Type Reference:\")\n        console.log(\"   0 = SOURCE_UNKNOWN\")\n        console.log(\"   1 = SOURCE_CAMERA\")\n        console.log(\"   2 = SOURCE_MICROPHONE ⬅️  AGENT EXPECTS THIS!\")\n        console.log(\"   3 = SOURCE_SCREENSHARE\")\n\n        if (publication.source !== 2) {\n          console.log(\"\\n⚠️  WARNING: Track source is NOT microphone!\")\n          console",

    "content": "import { \n  index_codebase_local, \n  fast_semantic_search,\n  manage_search_cache \n} from \"./tool/fast-semantic-search\"\n\nconst ctx = { sessionID: \"test-session\" } as any\n\nasync function testFullIndex() {\n  console.log(\"🚀 Testing Full Codebase Indexing\\n\")\n  \n  // Test 1: Index ALL files (default 200)\n  console.log(\"📦 Step 1: Creating full index (200 files max)...\")\n  const indexResult = await index_codebase_local.execute({}, ctx)\n  console.log(indexResult)\n  console.log(\"\\n\" + \"=\".repeat(80) + \"\\n\")\n  \n  // Test 2: Check cache health\n  console.log(\"💊 Step 2: Checking cache health...\")\n  const healthResult = await manage_search_cache.execute(\n    { action: \"health\" },\n    ctx\n  )\n  console.log(healthResult)\n  console.log(\"\\n\" + \"=\".repeat(80) + \"\\n\")\n  \n  // Test 3: Multiple searches to test different queries\n  const queries = [\n    \"plugin system architecture\",\n    \"livekit audio streaming\",\n    \"session management\",\n    \"tool execution\",\n    \"file operations\"\n  ]\n  \n  for (const query of queries) {\n    console.log(`🔍 Searching: \"${query}\"...`)\n    const result = await fast_semantic_search.execute(\n      { query, top_k: 3 },\n      ctx\n    )\n    console.log(result)\n    console.log(\"\\n\" + \"-\".repeat(80) + \"\\n\")\n  }\n  \n  // Test 4: Final cache stats\n  console.log(\"📊 Final cache statistics...\")\n  const statsResult = await manage_search_cache.execute(\n    { action: \"stats\" },\n    ctx\n  )\n  console.log(statsResult)\n  \n  console.log(\"\\n✅ Full indexing test completed!\")\n}\n\ntestFullIndex().catch(console.error)\n",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Standalone KB/RAID System Test\n * Tests the core functionality without requiring full test framework\n * Run: bun test-kb-system.ts\n */\n\nimport { RaidKnowledgeBase } from \"./src/raid/raid-kb\"\nimport { loadRaidConfig, validateRaidConfig } from \"./src/raid/raid-config\"\nimport { unlink } from \"node:fs/promises\"\nimport type { RaidConfig } from \"./src/raid/raid-types\"\nimport { randomUUID } from \"crypto\"\n\nconst testDbPath = \"/tmp/test-raid-kb.db\"\n\n// Test configuration\nconst testConfig: RaidConfig = {\n  projectRoot: \"/tmp/test-project\",\n  globalKbPath: \"/tmp/test-global-kb\",\n  dbPath: testDbPath,\n  enableAutoIndexing: false,\n  maxConcurrentShards: 5,\n  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || \"test-key\",\n  baseUrl: \"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\n  shardModel: \"gpt-4o-mini\",\n  orchModel: \"gpt-4o\",\n  numShards: 10,\n  maxTokensPerShard: 4000,\n  overlapTokens: 200,\n}\n\n// Test results tracking\nlet passed = 0\nlet failed = 0\nconst failures: string[] = []\n\nfunction assert(condition: boolean, message: string) {\n  if (condition) {\n    passed++\n    console.log(`✅ ${message}`)\n  } else {\n    failed++\n    failures.push(message)\n    console.log(`❌ ${message}`)\n  }\n}\n\nfunction assertEqual(actual: any, expected: any, message: string) {\n  if (actual === expected) {\n    passed++\n    console.log(`✅ ${message}`)\n  } else {\n    failed++\n    failures.push(`${message} - Expected: ${expected}, Got: ${actual}`)\n    console.log(`❌ ${message} - Expected: ${expected}, Got: ${actual}`)\n  }\n}\n\nasync function cleanup() {\n  try {\n    await unlink(testDbPath)\n    await unlink(`${testDbPath}-shm`)\n    await unlink(`${testDbPath}-wal`)\n  } catch {}\n}\n\nasync function runTests() {\n  console.log(\"🧪 KB/RAID System Test Suite\\n\")\n  console.log(\"=\".repeat(60))\n\n  await cleanup()\n\n  // Test 1: Configuration\n  console.log(\"\\n📋 Test Group: Configuration\")\n  console.log(\"-\".repeat(60))\n\n  try {\n    const config = loadRaidConfig()\n    const validation = validateRaidConfig(config)\n\n    assert(con",

    "content": "ts = kb.getStats()\n    assertEqual(stats.totalDocuments, 2, \"Document count decreased after deletion\")\n  } catch (e) {\n    assert(false, `Document deletion failed: ${e}`)\n  }\n\n  // Test 9: Clear by Source\n  console.log(\"\\n🧹 Test Group: Clear by Source\")\n  console.log(\"-\".repeat(60))\n\n  try {\n    kb.deleteAllDocuments(\"project\")\n    const stats = kb.getStats()\n    assertEqual(stats.projectDocuments, 0, \"Project documents cleared\")\n    assertEqual(stats.globalDocuments, 1, \"Global documents remain\")\n  } catch (e) {\n    assert(false, `Clear by source failed: ${e}`)\n  }\n\n  // Test 10: Performance Check\n  console.log(\"\\n⚡ Test Group: Performance\")\n  console.log(\"-\".repeat(60))\n\n  try {\n    const startIngest = Date.now()\n    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n      await kb.upsertDocument({\n        id: randomUUID(),\n        title: `Perf Test Doc ${i}`,\n        content: `This is performance test document number ${i}. `.repeat(10),\n        tags: [\"perf\"],\n        source: \"project\",\n      })\n    }\n    const ingestTime = Date.now() - startIngest\n    console.log(\n      `   ⏱️  Ingested 10 docs in ${ingestTime}ms (${(ingestTime / 10).toFixed(1)}ms/doc)`,\n    )\n    assert(ingestTime < 5000, \"Bulk ingestion completes in reasonable time\")\n\n    const startSearch = Date.now()\n    for (let i = 0;     "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test agent interaction - verify agent receives and responds to our audio\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  RoomEvent,\n  AudioSource,\n  LocalAudioTrack,\n  TrackPublishOptions,\n  AudioFrame,\n  AudioStream,\n  RemoteAudioTrack,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport { exec, spawn } from \"child_process\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n  participantName: \"Audio Test User\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: config.participantName,\n    name: config.participantName,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ roomJoin: true, room: config.roomName, canPublish: true, canSubscribe: true })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  let micProcess: ReturnType<typeof spawn> | null = null\n  const audioPlayers = new Map<string, any>()\n\n  try {\n    const token = await generateToken()\n    const room = new Room()\n\n    console.log(\"🎤 Agent Interaction Test\")\n    console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.Connected, () => {\n      console.log(\"✅ Connected to room\")\n      console.log(`   Participants: ${room.remoteParticipants.size}`)\n      \n      // List existing participants and their tracks\n      for (const [identity, participant] of room.remoteParticipants) {\n        console.log(`   - ${identity}: ${participant.trackPublications.size} tracks`)\n        for (const [sid, pub] of participant.trackPublications) {\n          console.log(`     * ${pub.name} (${pub.kind})`)\n        }\n      }\n    })\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (participant) => {\n      console.log(`\\n👤 NEW participant: ${participant.identity}`)\n    })\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished, (publication, participant) => {\n      console.log(`\\n📤 ${participant.identity} PUB",

    "id": "test-plugin-render-fresh.tsx",
    "content": "/**\n * Test: Verify context-panel plugin renders without \"No renderer found\" error\n * This simulates how the TUI loads and renders the plugin\n */\n\nimport { render } from \"@opentui/solid\"\nimport { ContextPanelPlugin } from \"./examples/plugin-sidebar-context/index.tsx\"\n\nasync function testPluginRender() {\n  console.log(\"=== Testing Context Panel Plugin Render ===\\n\")\n\n  // 1. Load the plugin\n  console.log(\"1. Loading plugin...\")\n  const plugin = await ContextPanelPlugin()\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Plugin loaded\")\n\n  // 2. Simulate ui.render call\n  console.log(\"\\n2. Calling ui.render...\")\n  const output: any = {}\n\n  const mockClient = {\n    sessions: {\n      retrieve: async () => ({\n        data: {\n          context: {\n            tokens: 1000,\n            tokenLimit: 200000,\n            system: 100,\n            assistant: 500,\n            user: 300,\n            tool: 100,\n            cost: 0.0015,\n          },\n        },\n      }),\n    },\n  }\n\n  await plugin[\"ui.render\"](\n    {\n      componentId: \"context-panel\",\n      context: {\n        client: mockClient,\n        sessionID: \"test-session-123\",\n      },\n    },\n    output,\n  )\n\n  if (!output.component) {\n    console.error(\"   ✗ No component returned!\")\n    process.exit(1)\n  }\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Component function returned\")\n\n  // 3. Try to render the component\n  console.log(\"\\n3. Rendering component...\")\n  try {\n    const Component = output.component\n\n    // Render in a test container\n    const result = render(() => <Component />, document.createElement(\"div\"))\n\n    console.log(\"   ✓ Component rendered successfully!\")\n    console.log(\"\\n=== TEST PASSED ===\")\n    console.log(\"The plugin should work in the TUI now.\")\n\n    // Cleanup\n    if (typeof result === \"function\") result()\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"   ✗ Render failed:\", err)\n    console.error(\"\\nError details:\", err instanceof Error ? err.stack : String(err))\n    process.exit(1)\n  }\n}\n\ntestPluginRender().catch((err) => {\n  console.error(\"Test failed:\", err)\n ",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test ACTUAL Plugin Loading and Rendering\n * This loads the real compiled plugin and renders it in TUI context\n */\n\nimport { render } from \"@opentui/solid\"\nimport { Show, onMount, createSignal } from \"solid-js\"\nimport { Instance } from \"./src/project/instance\"\nimport { Plugin } from \"./src/plugin\"\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n=== Testing ACTUAL Plugin Load and Render ===\\n\")\n\nawait Instance.provide({\n  directory: process.cwd(),\n  async fn() {\n    const plugins = await Plugin.list()\n    console.log(`✓ Loaded ${plugins.length} plugins`)\n\n    // Find the context panel plugin\n    const contextPlugin = plugins.find((p: any) => p[\"ui.render\"])\n    if (!contextPlugin) {\n      console.error(\"✗ No plugin with ui.render found\")\n      process.exit(1)\n    }\n\n    console.log(\"✓ Found plugin with ui.render\")\n\n    // Mock client and sessionID\n    const mockClient = {\n      sessions: {\n        retrieve: async () => ({\n          data: {\n            context: {\n              tokens: 1000,\n              tokenLimit: 200000,\n              system: 200,\n              assistant: 300,\n              user: 400,\n              tool: 100,\n              cost: 0.0123,\n            },\n          },\n        }),\n      },\n    }\n\n    function TestPluginRender() {\n      const [Component, setComponent] = createSignal<any>(null)\n      const [error, setError] = createSignal<string | null>(null)\n\n      onMount(async () => {\n        try {\n          const output: any = {}\n          const uiRender = (contextPlugin as any)[\"ui.render\"]\n\n          console.log(\"About to call ui.render with componentId: context-panel\")\n\n          await uiRender(\n            {\n              componentId: \"context-panel\",\n              context: {\n                client: mockClient,\n                sessionID: \"test-session\",\n              },\n            },\n            output,\n          )\n\n          console.log(\"✓ Plugin ui.render called\")\n          console.log(\"  input.componentId was: context-panel\")\n          console.log(\" ",
