    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Verify two-way audio by checking if remote participant receives our audio\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  RoomEvent,\n  AudioSource,\n  LocalAudioTrack,\n  TrackPublishOptions,\n  AudioFrame,\n  AudioStream,\n  RemoteAudioTrack,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n  participantName: \"Audio Tester\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: config.participantName,\n    name: config.participantName,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ roomJoin: true, room: config.roomName, canPublish: true, canSubscribe: true })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  let micProcess: ReturnType<typeof spawn> | null = null\n\n  try {\n    const token = await generateToken()\n    const room = new Room()\n\n    console.log(\"🔧 Two-Way Audio Verification Test\")\n    console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n\n    // Track events\n    room.on(RoomEvent.Connected, () => {\n      console.log(\"✅ Connected to room\")\n      console.log(`   Participants: ${room.remoteParticipants.size}`)\n    })\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (participant) => {\n      console.log(`👤 Participant joined: ${participant.identity}`)\n      console.log(`   Name: ${participant.name}`)\n      console.log(`   Tracks: ${participant.trackPublications.size}`)\n    })\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished, (publication, participant) => {\n      console.log(`📤 Track PUBLISHED by ${participant.identity}:`)\n      console.log(`   Name: ${publication.name}`)\n      console.log(`   SID: ${publication.sid}`)\n      console.log(`   Kind: ${publication.kind}`)\n      console.log(`   Source: ${publication.source}`)\n    })\n\n    room.on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribe",

    "id": "test-plugin-load-diagnostic.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Diagnostic: Check what happens when we load the plugins\n */\n\nconsole.log(\"=== Plugin Load Diagnostic ===\\n\")\n\n// Test 1: Load context plugin\nconsole.log(\"1. Loading context-panel plugin...\")\ntry {\n  const contextPlugin = await import(\"./examples/plugin-sidebar-context/index.tsx\")\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Module loaded\")\n  console.log(\"   Exports:\", Object.keys(contextPlugin))\n\n  const plugin = await contextPlugin.ContextPanelPlugin()\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Plugin initialized\")\n  console.log(\"   Hooks:\", Object.keys(plugin))\n\n  // Test ui.render\n  const output: any = {}\n  await plugin[\"ui.render\"](\n    {\n      componentId: \"context-panel\",\n      context: { client: {}, sessionID: \"test\" },\n    },\n    output,\n  )\n\n  console.log(\"   ✓ ui.render called\")\n  console.log(\"   Output type:\", output.type)\n  console.log(\"   Output component:\", typeof output.component)\n\n  // Try to inspect the component function\n  if (output.component) {\n    console.log(\"   Component function source (first 200 chars):\")\n    console.log(\"   \", output.component.toString().substring(0, 200))\n  }\n} catch (err) {\n  console.error(\"   ✗ Error:\", err)\n  if (err instanceof Error) {\n    console.error(\"   Stack:\", err.stack)\n  }\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n2. Loading sidebar-tabs plugin...\")\ntry {\n  const tabsPlugin = await import(\"./examples/plugin-sidebar-tabs/index.tsx\")\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Module loaded\")\n  console.log(\"   Exports:\", Object.keys(tabsPlugin))\n\n  const plugin = await tabsPlugin.SidebarTabsPlugin()\n  console.log(\"   ✓ Plugin initialized\")\n  console.log(\"   Hooks:\", Object.keys(plugin))\n} catch (err) {\n  console.error(\"   ✗ Error:\", err)\n  if (err instanceof Error) {\n    console.error(\"   Stack:\", err.stack)\n  }\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n=== Diagnostic Complete ===\")\n",

    "id": "src/project/instance.ts",
    "content": "import { Log } from \"@/util/log\"\nimport { Context } from \"../util/context\"\nimport { Project } from \"./project\"\nimport { State } from \"./state\"\n\ninterface Context {\n  directory: string\n  worktree: string\n  project: Project.Info\n}\nconst context = Context.create<Context>(\"instance\")\nconst cache = new Map<string, Context>()\n\nexport const Instance = {\n  async provide<R>(input: {\n    directory: string\n    init?: () => Promise<any>\n    fn: () => R\n  }): Promise<R> {\n    let existing = cache.get(input.directory)\n    if (!existing) {\n      const project = await Project.fromDirectory(input.directory)\n      existing = {\n        directory: input.directory,\n        worktree: project.worktree,\n        project,\n      }\n    }\n    return context.provide(existing, async () => {\n      if (!cache.has(input.directory)) {\n        cache.set(input.directory, existing)\n        await input.init?.()\n      }\n      return input.fn()\n    })\n  },\n  get directory() {\n    return context.use().directory\n  },\n  get worktree() {\n    return context.use().worktree\n  },\n  get project() {\n    return context.use().project\n  },\n  state<S>(init: () => S, dispose?: (state: Awaited<S>) => Promise<void>): () => S {\n    return State.create(() => Instance.directory, init, dispose)\n  },\n  async dispose() {\n    Log.Default.info(\"disposing instance\", { directory: Instance.directory })\n    await State.dispose(Instance.directory)\n  },\n  async disposeAll() {\n    for (const [_key, value] of cache) {\n      await context.provide(value, async () => {\n        await Instance.dispose()\n      })\n    }\n    cache.clear()\n  },\n}\n",

    "id": "src/project/state.ts",
    "content": "import { Log } from \"@/util/log\"\n\nexport namespace State {\n  interface Entry {\n    state: any\n    dispose?: (state: any) => Promise<void>\n  }\n\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"state\" })\n  const recordsByKey = new Map<string, Map<any, Entry>>()\n\n  export function create<S>(\n    root: () => string,\n    init: () => S,\n    dispose?: (state: Awaited<S>) => Promise<void>,\n  ) {\n    return () => {\n      const key = root()\n      let entries = recordsByKey.get(key)\n      if (!entries) {\n        entries = new Map<string, Entry>()\n        recordsByKey.set(key, entries)\n      }\n      const exists = entries.get(init)\n      if (exists) return exists.state as S\n      const state = init()\n      entries.set(init, {\n        state,\n        dispose,\n      })\n      return state\n    }\n  }\n\n  export async function dispose(key: string) {\n    const entries = recordsByKey.get(key)\n    if (!entries) return\n\n    log.info(\"waiting for state disposal to complete\", { key })\n\n    let disposalFinished = false\n\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      if (!disposalFinished) {\n        log.warn(\n          \"state disposal is taking an unusually long time - if it does not complete in a reasonable time, please report this as a bug\",\n          { key },\n        )\n      }\n    }, 10000).unref()\n\n    const tasks: Promise<void>[] = []\n    for (const entry of entries.values()) {\n      if (!entry.dispose) continue\n\n      const task = Promise.resolve(entry.state)\n        .then((state) => entry.dispose!(state))\n        .catch((error) => {\n          log.error(\"Error while disposing state:\", { error, key })\n        })\n\n      tasks.push(task)\n    }\n    entries.delete(key)\n    await Promise.all(tasks)\n    disposalFinished = true\n    log.info(\"state disposal completed\", { key })\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "test-diagnostic.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Diagnostic: Check what the agent sees\n */\n\nimport { Room, RoomEvent } from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: \"diagnostic\",\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ roomJoin: true, room: config.roomName, canSubscribe: true })\n  \n  const room = new Room()\n  \n  console.log(\"🔍 LiveKit Room Diagnostic\")\n  console.log(\"=\".repeat(50))\n  \n  room.on(RoomEvent.Connected, () => {\n    console.log(\"\\n✅ Connected to room:\", room.name)\n    console.log(`   Participants: ${room.remoteParticipants.size}`)\n    \n    for (const [identity, participant] of room.remoteParticipants) {\n      console.log(`\\n👤 ${identity}:`)\n      console.log(`   Is Agent: ${participant.metadata?.includes('agent') ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`)\n      console.log(`   Tracks: ${participant.trackPublications.size}`)\n      \n      for (const [sid, pub] of participant.trackPublications) {\n        console.log(`   📍 Track:`)\n        console.log(`      Name: ${pub.name}`)\n        console.log(`      SID: ${pub.sid}`)\n        console.log(`      Kind: ${pub.kind === 0 ? 'VIDEO' : 'AUDIO'}`)\n        console.log(`      Source: ${pub.source} ${pub.source === 1 ? '(MICROPHONE)' : ''}`)\n        console.log(`      Muted: ${pub.muted}`)\n        console.log(`      Subscribed: ${pub.subscribed}`)\n      }\n    }\n  })\n  \n  room.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (p) => {\n    console.log(`\\n➕ Participant joined: ${p.identity}`)\n  })\n  \n  room.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished, (pub, p) => {\n    console.log(`\\n📤 ${p.identity} published:`)\n    console.log(`   ${pub.name} (${pub.kind === 0 ? 'VIDEO' : 'AUDIO'}) source=${pub.source}`)\n  })\n  \n  room.on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, (track, pub, p) ",

    "id": "test-canvas-components.tsx",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test Canvas Components Independently\n *\n * This tests that our Canvas components work correctly within a TUI renderer context.\n */\n\nimport { render } from \"@opentui/solid\"\nimport { VStack, HStack, Text, For, createSignal } from \"./src/plugin-ui\"\n\n// Test 1: Basic components\nfunction TestBasicComponents() {\n  return (\n    <VStack gap={1}>\n      <Text fg=\"#00ff00\">✓ VStack works</Text>\n      <HStack gap={2}>\n        <Text fg=\"#ff0000\">✓ HStack</Text>\n        <Text fg=\"#0000ff\">✓ works</Text>\n      </HStack>\n    </VStack>\n  )\n}\n\n// Test 2: With signals\nfunction TestWithSignals() {\n  const [count, setCount] = createSignal(0)\n\n  setTimeout(() => setCount(count() + 1), 100)\n  setTimeout(() => setCount(count() + 1), 200)\n\n  return (\n    <VStack gap={1}>\n      <Text fg=\"#ffff00\">Count: {count()}</Text>\n    </VStack>\n  )\n}\n\n// Test 3: With For loop\nfunction TestWithFor() {\n  const items = () => [\"one\", \"two\", \"three\"]\n\n  return (\n    <VStack gap={1}>\n      <Text fg=\"#ffffff\">Items:</Text>\n      <For each={items()}>{(item) => <Text fg=\"#00ffff\"> - {item}</Text>}</For>\n    </VStack>\n  )\n}\n\n// Test 4: Complete component (like plugin would use)\nfunction TestCompleteComponent() {\n  const [data] = createSignal({\n    tokens: 1500,\n    limit: 200000,\n    percentage: 1,\n  })\n\n  return (\n    <VStack gap={0}>\n      <Text fg=\"#6b7280\">Tokens: {data().tokens}</Text>\n      <Text fg=\"#6b7280\">Usage: {data().percentage}%</Text>\n    </VStack>\n  )\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n=== Testing Canvas Components ===\\n\")\n\n// Test each component\nconsole.log(\"Test 1: Basic Components\")\ntry {\n  render(() => <TestBasicComponents />)\n  console.log(\"✓ Basic components rendered successfully\\n\")\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(\n    \"✗ Basic components failed:\",\n    error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n    \"\\n\",\n  )\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"Test 2: With Signals\")\ntry {\n  render(() => <TestWithSignals />)\n  setTimeout(() => {\n    console.log(\"✓ Signals work\\n\")\n  }, 300)\n} catch (err",

    projectID = id\n\n          await Bun.write(\n            path.join(dir, \"project\", projectID + \".json\"),\n            JSON.stringify({\n              id,\n              vcs: \"git\",\n   {
    "id": "test-plugin-component.tsx",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test Plugin Component Rendering\n *\n * This tests that plugin components can be rendered correctly\n * using the same pattern as PluginComponent.tsx\n */\n\nimport { render } from \"@opentui/solid\"\nimport { createSignal, Show } from \"solid-js\"\nimport type {} from \"./src/plugin-ui\"\n\n// Simulate what a plugin returns\nfunction createMockPluginComponent() {\n  const ContextPanel = () => {\n    const [count, setCount] = createSignal(0)\n\n    setTimeout(() => setCount(count() + 1), 100)\n\n    return (\n      <box flexDirection=\"column\" gap={0}>\n        <text fg=\"#00ff00\">✓ Plugin component works!</text>\n        <text fg=\"#6b7280\">Count: {count()}</text>\n      </box>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return ContextPanel\n}\n\n// Simulate what PluginComponent does\nfunction PluginComponentTest() {\n  const [ComponentFn, setComponentFn] = createSignal<(() => any) | null>(null)\n\n  // Simulate loading the plugin\n  setTimeout(() => {\n    const pluginComponent = createMockPluginComponent()\n    setComponentFn(() => pluginComponent)\n  }, 50)\n\n  return (\n    <Show when={ComponentFn()} fallback={<text fg=\"#ffff00\">Loading plugin...</text>}>\n      {(() => {\n        const Component = ComponentFn()!\n        return <Component />\n      })()}\n    </Show>\n  )\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n=== Testing Plugin Component Rendering ===\\n\")\n\ntry {\n  render(() => <PluginComponentTest />)\n\n  setTimeout(() => {\n    console.log(\"✓ Plugin component rendered successfully\")\n    console.log(\"✓ Component function called within render tree\")\n    console.log(\"✓ Canvas components working inside plugin\")\n    process.exit(0)\n  }, 300)\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(\"✗ Plugin component failed:\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error)\n  process.exit(1)\n}\n",

i < samples.length; i++) {\n    const normalized = samples[i] / 32768.0 // Normalize to -1.0 to 1.0\n    sum += normalized * normalized\n  }\n  return Math.sqrt(sum / samples.length)\n}\n\nfunction rmsToDb(rms: number): number {\n  if (rms === 0) return -100\n  return 20 * Math.log10(rms)\n}\n\nfunction createLevelMeter(db: number): string {\n  // Convert dB to visual meter (-60 dB to 0 dB range)\n  const normalized = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (db + 60) / 60))\n  const bars = Math.floor(normalized * 40)\n  const meter = \"█\".repeat(bars) + \"░\".repeat(40 - bars)\n\n  let color = \"\"\n  if (db > -10)\n    color = \"🔴\" // Too loud\n  else if (db > -20)\n    color = \"🟢\" // Good\n  else if (db > -40)\n    color = \"🟡\" // Quiet\n  else color = \"⚪\" // Very quiet/silence\n\n  return `${color} ${meter} ${db.toFixed(1)} dB`\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  let micProcess: ReturnType<typeof spawn> | null = null\n\n  try {\n    const token = await generateToken()\n    const room = new Room()\n\n    console.log(\"\ud83d",

    "id": "generate-go-sdk.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\n\nconst sdkDir = \"../sdk/stainless\"\nconst originalDir = process.cwd()\n\ntry {\n  process.chdir(sdkDir)\n  console.log(\"=== Generating Stainless SDK (Go) ===\")\n  console.log(\"Working directory:\", process.cwd())\n\n  // Generate Go SDK using Stainless\n  console.log(\"\\n1. Generating Go SDK with Stainless...\")\n  await $`stl builds create --branch main --pull --allow-empty --+target go`\n\n  // Move Go SDK to packages/sdk/go\n  console.log(\"\\n2. Moving Go SDK to packages/sdk/go...\")\n  await $`rm -rf ../go`\n  await $`mv opencode-go/ ../go`\n  await $`rm -rf ../go/.git`\n\n  console.log(\"\\n✓ SDK generation complete!\")\n  console.log(\"✓ Go SDK available at packages/sdk/go\")\n  console.log(\"\\nNote: TypeScript SDK is generated separately by Stainless and published to npm\")\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(\"Error generating SDK:\", error)\n  process.exit(1)\n} finally {\n  process.chdir(originalDir)\n}\n",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test Real Plugin Scenario\n *\n * This simulates the exact flow of:\n * 1. PluginComponent loading a plugin\n * 2. Plugin returning a component function\n * 3. Component using Canvas components with signals and lifecycle hooks\n */\n\nimport { render } from \"@opentui/solid\"\nimport { createSignal, Show, onMount, onCleanup, For } from \"solid-js\"\nimport type {} from \"./src/plugin-ui\"\n\n// Simulate the EXACT plugin structure from plugin-sidebar-context\nconst mockPlugin = {\n  \"ui.render\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n    if (input.componentId === \"test-panel\") {\n      // This is EXACTLY what the plugin does\n      const TestPanel = () => {\n        const [data, setData] = createSignal({\n          count: 0,\n          items: [\"one\", \"two\", \"three\"],\n        })\n\n        onMount(() => {\n          console.log(\"✓ Plugin onMount called\")\n          const interval = setInterval(() => {\n            setData({ ...data(), count: data().count + 1 })\n          }, 100)\n          onCleanup(() => {\n            console.log(\"✓ Plugin onCleanup called\")\n            clearInterval(interval)\n          })\n        })\n\n        return (\n          <box flexDirection=\"column\" gap={0}>\n            <text fg=\"#00ff00\">✓ Plugin Panel Working</text>\n            <text fg=\"#6b7280\">Count: {data().count}</text>\n            <box flexDirection=\"row\" gap={1}>\n              <For each={data().items}>{(item) => <text fg=\"#00ffff\">{item}</text>}</For>\n            </box>\n          </box>\n        )\n      }\n\n      output.component = TestPanel\n      output.type = \"component\"\n    }\n  },\n}\n\n// Simulate EXACTLY what PluginComponent does\nfunction SimulatePluginComponent() {\n  const [ComponentFn, setComponentFn] = createSignal<(() => any) | null>(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = createSignal(true)\n\n  async function loadComponent() {\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const output: any = {}\n      await mockPlugin[\"ui.render\"](\n        {\n          componentId: \"test-panel\",\n          context: {},",

    "content": "         mode: \"all\",\n          permission: agentPermission,\n          options: {},\n          tools: {},\n          builtIn: false,\n        }\n      const {\n        name,\n        model,\n        prompt,\n        tools,\n        description,\n        temperature,\n        top_p,\n        mode,\n        permission,\n        ...extra\n      } = value\n      item.options = {\n        ...item.options,\n        ...extra,\n      }\n      if (model) item.model = Provider.parseModel(model)\n      if (prompt) item.prompt = prompt\n      if (tools)\n        item.tools = {\n          ...item.tools,\n          ...tools,\n        }\n      item.tools = {\n        ...defaultTools,\n        ...item.tools,\n      }\n      if (description) item.description = description\n      if (temperature != undefined) item.temperature = temperature\n      if (top_p != undefined) item.topP = top_p\n      if (mode) item.mode = mode\n      // just here for consistency & to prevent it from being added as an option\n      if (name) item.name = name\n\n      if (permission ?? cfg.permission) {\n        item.permission = mergeAgentPermissions(cfg.permission ?? {}, permission ?? {})\n      }\n    }\n    return result\n  })\n\n  export async function get(agent: string) {\n    return state().then((x) => x[agent])\n  }\n\n  export async function list() {\n    return state().then((x) => Object.values(x))\n  }\n\n  export async function generate(input: { description: string }) {\n    const log = Log.create({ service: \"agent.generate\" })\n    const defaultModel = await Provider.defaultModel()\n    const model = await Provider.getModel(defaultModel.providerID, defaultModel.modelID)\n    const system = SystemPrompt.header(defaultModel.providerID)\n    system.push(PROMPT_GENERATE)\n    const existing = await list()\n\n    try {\n      const result = await generateObject({\n        temperature: 0.3,\n        prompt: [\n          ...system.map(\n            (item): ModelMessage => ({\n              role: \"system\",\n              content: item,\n            }),\n          ),\n     ",

    "content": "import type { Hooks, PluginInput, Plugin as PluginInstance } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { createOpencodeClient } from \"@opencode-ai/sdk\"\nimport { Server } from \"../server/server\"\nimport { BunProc } from \"../bun\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { Flag } from \"../flag/flag\"\n\nexport namespace Plugin {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"plugin\" })\n\n  const state = Instance.state(async () => {\n    // Type cast needed due to incompatibility between Hono's fetch and standard fetch\n    const appFetch = Server.App().fetch as any\n    const client = createOpencodeClient({\n      baseUrl: \"http://localhost:4096\",\n      fetch: appFetch,\n    })\n    const config = await Config.get()\n    const hooks = []\n    const input: PluginInput = {\n      client,\n      project: Instance.project,\n      worktree: Instance.worktree,\n      directory: Instance.directory,\n      $: Bun.$,\n    }\n    const plugins = [...(config.plugin ?? [])]\n    if (!Flag.OPENCODE_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PLUGINS) {\n      plugins.push(\"opencode-copilot-auth@0.0.4\")\n      plugins.push(\"opencode-anthropic-auth@0.0.2\")\n    }\n    for (let plugin of plugins) {\n      try {\n        log.info(\"loading plugin\", { path: plugin })\n        if (!plugin.startsWith(\"file://\")) {\n          const [pkg, version] = plugin.split(\"@\")\n          if (!pkg || pkg.trim() === \"\") {\n            log.error(\"invalid plugin format\", { plugin })\n            continue\n          }\n          plugin = await BunProc.install(pkg, version ?? \"latest\")\n        }\n        const mod = await import(plugin)\n        if (!mod || typeof mod !== \"object\") {\n          log.error(\"invalid plugin module\", { plugin })\n          continue\n        }\n\n        for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries<PluginInstance>(mod)) {\n          if (typeof fn !== \"function\") {\n            log.warn(\"skipping non-function export\", { plugin, name })\n            continue\n",

    "content": "import { experimental_createMCPClient, type Tool } from \"ai\"\nimport { StreamableHTTPClientTransport } from \"@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js\"\nimport { SSEClientTransport } from \"@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/sse.js\"\nimport { StdioClientTransport } from \"@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"../util/error\"\nimport z from \"zod/v4\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { withTimeout } from \"@/util/timeout\"\n\nexport namespace MCP {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"mcp\" })\n\n  export const Failed = NamedError.create(\n    \"MCPFailed\",\n    z.object({\n      name: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n\n  type Client = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof experimental_createMCPClient>>\n\n  export const Status = z\n    .discriminatedUnion(\"status\", [\n      z\n        .object({\n          status: z.literal(\"connected\"),\n        })\n        .meta({\n          ref: \"MCPStatusConnected\",\n        }),\n      z\n        .object({\n          status: z.literal(\"disabled\"),\n        })\n        .meta({\n          ref: \"MCPStatusDisabled\",\n        }),\n      z\n        .object({\n          status: z.literal(\"failed\"),\n          error: z.string(),\n        })\n        .meta({\n          ref: \"MCPStatusFailed\",\n        }),\n    ])\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"MCPStatus\",\n    })\n  export type Status = z.infer<typeof Status>\n  type MCPClient = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof experimental_createMCPClient>>\n\n  const state = Instance.state(\n    async () => {\n      const cfg = await Config.get()\n      const config = cfg.mcp ?? {}\n      const clients: Record<string, Client> = {}\n      const status: Record<string, Status> = {}\n\n      await Promise.all(\n        Object.entries(config).map(async ([key, mcp]) => {\n          const result = await create(key, mcp).catch(() => undefined)\n          if (!result) return\n\n          status[key] = result.status\n\n          if (result.mcpClient) {\n            clients[key] ",

    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport { Global } from \"../global\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport path from \"path\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"../util/error\"\nimport { readableStreamToText } from \"bun\"\n\nexport namespace BunProc {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"bun\" })\n\n  export async function run(\n    cmd: string[],\n    options?: Bun.SpawnOptions.OptionsObject<any, any, any>,\n  ) {\n    log.info(\"running\", {\n      cmd: [which(), ...cmd],\n      ...options,\n    })\n    const result = Bun.spawn([which(), ...cmd], {\n      ...options,\n      stdout: \"pipe\",\n      stderr: \"pipe\",\n      env: {\n        ...process.env,\n        ...options?.env,\n        BUN_BE_BUN: \"1\",\n      },\n    })\n    const code = await result.exited\n    const stdout = result.stdout\n      ? typeof result.stdout === \"number\"\n        ? result.stdout\n        : await readableStreamToText(result.stdout)\n      : undefined\n    const stderr = result.stderr\n      ? typeof result.stderr === \"number\"\n        ? result.stderr\n        : await readableStreamToText(result.stderr)\n      : undefined\n    log.info(\"done\", {\n      code,\n      stdout,\n      stderr,\n    })\n    if (code !== 0) {\n      throw new Error(`Command failed with exit code ${result.exitCode}`)\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export function which() {\n    return process.execPath\n  }\n\n  export const InstallFailedError = NamedError.create(\n    \"BunInstallFailedError\",\n    z.object({\n      pkg: z.string(),\n      version: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n\n  export async function install(pkg: string, version = \"latest\") {\n    const mod = path.join(Global.Path.cache, \"node_modules\", pkg)\n    const pkgjson = Bun.file(path.join(Global.Path.cache, \"package.json\"))\n    const parsed = await pkgjson.json().catch(async () => {\n      const result = { dependencies: {} }\n      await Bun.write(pkgjson.name!, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2))\n      return result\n    })\n    if (parsed.dependencies[pkg] === version) return mod\n\n    // Build command arguments\n    const args = [\"add\", \"-",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Local Audio Only - Agent in room but audio handled locally\n * No audio tracks published to LiveKit - just data channel communication\n */\n\nimport { Room, RoomEvent } from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\nimport { WebSocket } from \"ws\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n  participantName: \"Local Audio User\",\n  // OpenAI Realtime WebSocket (if using OpenAI directly)\n  openaiApiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || \"\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: config.participantName,\n    name: config.participantName,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ \n    roomJoin: true, \n    room: config.roomName, \n    canPublish: false,  // We won't publish audio tracks\n    canSubscribe: true,\n  })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  console.log(\"🎙️  Local Audio Mode\")\n  console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n  console.log(\"Agent in LiveKit room, but audio is local\")\n  console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n\n  // Connect to LiveKit room (but don't publish audio)\n  const token = await generateToken()\n  const room = new Room()\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.Connected, () => {\n    console.log(\"\\n✅ Connected to LiveKit room\")\n    console.log(`   Participants: ${room.remoteParticipants.size}`)\n    \n    for (const [identity, participant] of room.remoteParticipants) {\n      console.log(`   - ${identity}`)\n    }\n  })\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.DataReceived, (payload, participant) => {\n    try {\n      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(payload)\n      console.log(`\\n📨 Data from ${participant?.identity}: ${text}`)\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"Error decoding data:\", err)\n    }\n  })\n\n  await room.connect(config.url, token, { \n    autoSubscribe:",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Direct Agent Communication - No audio published to LiveKit\n * Agent handles audio internally via its own VAD/STT/TTS pipeline\n */\n\nimport { Room, RoomEvent } from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n  participantName: \"User\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity: config.participantName,\n    name: config.participantName,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({\n    roomJoin: true,\n    room: config.roomName,\n    canPublish: false,  // DON'T publish audio - let agent handle it\n    canSubscribe: true,\n  })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  console.log(\"🤖 Direct Agent Mode\")\n  console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n  console.log(\"Agent handles audio directly (no WebRTC tracks)\")\n  console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n\n  const token = await generateToken()\n  const room = new Room()\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.Connected, () => {\n    console.log(\"\\n✅ Connected to room\")\n    console.log(`   Participants: ${room.remoteParticipants.size}`)\n    \n    for (const [identity, participant] of room.remoteParticipants) {\n      console.log(`   - ${identity}${participant.metadata?.includes('agent') ? ' (AGENT)' : ''}`)\n    }\n    \n    console.log(\"\\n💡 Your Cartesia agent should:\")\n    console.log(\"   - Use HyperX mic (:11) via Deepgram STT\")\n    console.log(\"   - Process speech with Groq LLM\")\n    console.log(\"   - Play audio via Cartesia TTS\")\n    console.log(\"   - No WebRTC audio overhead\")\n    console.log(\"\\n⏳ Listening for agent data...\")\n  })\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (participant) => {\n    const isAgent = participant.metadata?.includes('agent')\n    console.log(`\\n${isAgent ? '🤖' : '👤'} ${participant.identity} joined${i",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\nimport pkg from \"./package.json\"\nimport { Script } from \"@opencode-ai/script\"\n\nconst binaries: Record<string, string> = {}\nconst platforms = [\n  \"darwin-arm64\",\n  \"darwin-x64\",\n  \"darwin-x64-baseline\",\n  \"linux-arm64\",\n  \"linux-x64\",\n  \"linux-x64-baseline\",\n  \"windows-x64\",\n]\n\n// Use the version from the already-published platform packages\nconst platformVersion = \"0.0.0-dev-codesurf-202511042145\"\n\nfor (const platform of platforms) {\n  binaries[`${pkg.name}-ai-${platform}`] = platformVersion\n}\n\nawait $`mkdir -p ./dist/${pkg.name}`\nawait $`cp -r ./bin ./dist/${pkg.name}/bin`\nawait $`cp ./script/preinstall.mjs ./dist/${pkg.name}/preinstall.mjs`\nawait $`cp ./script/postinstall.mjs ./dist/${pkg.name}/postinstall.mjs`\nawait $`cp ./README.md ./dist/${pkg.name}/README.md`\n\nawait Bun.file(`./dist/${pkg.name}/package.json`).write(\n  JSON.stringify(\n    {\n      name: pkg.name + \"-ai\",\n      description: \"CodeSurf - AI-powered code analysis and exploration tool. Built on OpenCode.\",\n      keywords: [\"ai\", \"code\", \"analysis\", \"codesurf\", \"opencode\", \"coding-assistant\"],\n      repository: {\n        type: \"git\",\n        url: \"https://github.com/sst/opencode\",\n      },\n      bin: {\n        [pkg.name]: `./bin/${pkg.name}`,\n        surf: `./bin/surf`,\n      },\n      scripts: {\n        preinstall: \"bun ./preinstall.mjs || node ./preinstall.mjs\",\n        postinstall: \"bun ./postinstall.mjs || node ./postinstall.mjs\",\n      },\n      version: platformVersion,\n      optionalDependencies: binaries,\n    },\n    null,\n    2,\n  ),\n)\n\nconsole.log(\"Main package created at dist/\" + pkg.name)\nconsole.log(\"Optional dependencies:\", binaries)\n",

    "id": "test-echo-check.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Check if our audio is visible to other participants\n */\n\nimport {\n  Room,\n  RoomEvent,\n} from \"@livekit/rtc-node\"\nimport { AccessToken } from \"livekit-server-sdk\"\n\nconst config = {\n  url: process.env.LIVEKIT_URL || \"\",\n  roomName: process.env.LIVEKIT_DEFAULT_ROOM || \"test-room\",\n  apiKey: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY || \"\",\n  apiSecret: process.env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET || \"\",\n}\n\nasync function generateToken(identity: string): Promise<string> {\n  const token = new AccessToken(config.apiKey, config.apiSecret, {\n    identity,\n    name: identity,\n  })\n  token.addGrant({ roomJoin: true, room: config.roomName, canPublish: true, canSubscribe: true })\n  return await token.toJwt()\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  const token = await generateToken(\"Observer\")\n  const room = new Room()\n\n  console.log(\"👁️  Observer: Watching room for audio tracks\")\n  console.log(\"=\" .repeat(50))\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, (participant) => {\n    console.log(`\\n👤 Participant joined: ${participant.identity}`)\n  })\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.TrackPublished, (publication, participant) => {\n    console.log(`\\n📤 TRACK PUBLISHED by ${participant.identity}:`)\n    console.log(`   Name: ${publication.name}`)\n    console.log(`   SID: ${publication.sid}`)\n    console.log(`   Kind: ${publication.kind === 1 ? 'AUDIO' : 'VIDEO'}`)\n    console.log(`   Source: ${publication.source} ${publication.source === 1 ? '(MICROPHONE ✅)' : ''}`)\n    console.log(`   Muted: ${publication.muted}`)\n  })\n\n  room.on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, (track, publication, participant) => {\n    console.log(`\\n📥 SUBSCRIBED to ${participant.identity}:`)\n    console.log(`   Track: ${publication.name}`)\n    console.log(`   Kind: ${track.kind === 1 ? 'AUDIO' : 'VIDEO'}`)\n    console.log(`   ✅ This track is available to all participants`)\n  })\n\n  await room.connect(config.url, token, { autoSubscribe: true, dynacast: true })\n  console.log(\"✅ Observer connected\")\n  console.log(\"\\nMonitoring room... Press Ctrl+C to",

    "id": "test-mic-selection.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/**\n * Test with explicit microphone selection\n */\n\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\n\nconsole.log(\"🎤 Testing Microphone Selection\\n\")\n\n// Test different microphones\nconst mics = [\n  { name: \"Immersed\", index: \":0\" },\n  { name: \"Insta360 Link 2C\", index: \":1\" },\n  { name: \"Oz Microphone\", index: \":2\" },\n  { name: \"Pickle Microphone\", index: \":3\" },\n  { name: \"MX Brio\", index: \":8\" },\n  { name: \"MacBook Pro Microphone\", index: \":10\" },\n  { name: \"HyperX QuadCast S\", index: \":11\" },\n]\n\nfor (const mic of mics) {\n  console.log(`Testing: ${mic.name} (${mic.index})`)\n  \n  const proc = spawn(\"ffmpeg\", [\n    \"-f\", \"avfoundation\",\n    \"-i\", mic.index,\n    \"-t\", \"0.5\",\n    \"-f\", \"null\",\n    \"-\"\n  ])\n  \n  proc.stderr?.on(\"data\", () => {})\n  \n  const exitCode = await new Promise<number>((resolve) => {\n    proc.on(\"exit\", (code) => resolve(code || 0))\n  })\n  \n  if (exitCode === 0) {\n    console.log(`   ✅ Working\\n`)\n  } else {\n    console.log(`   ❌ Failed\\n`)\n  }\n}\n\nconsole.log(\"\\n💡 Recommendation:\")\nconsole.log(\"   For LiveKit, use: :10 (MacBook Pro Microphone)\")\nconsole.log(\"   Or: :11 (HyperX QuadCast S)\")\n",

    "id": "script/schema.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n\nimport { z } from \"zod\"\nimport { Config } from \"../src/config/config\"\n\nconst file = process.argv[2]\nconsole.log(file)\n\nconst result = z.toJSONSchema(Config.Info, {\n  io: \"input\", // Generate input shape (treats optional().default() as not required)\n  /**\n   * We'll use the `default` values of the field as the only value in `examples`.\n   * This will ensure no docs are needed to be read, as the configuration is\n   * self-documenting.\n   *\n   * See https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/draft-bhutton-json-schema-validation-00#rfc.section.9.5\n   */\n  override(ctx) {\n    const schema = ctx.jsonSchema\n\n    // Preserve strictness: set additionalProperties: false for objects\n    if (schema && typeof schema === \"object\" && schema.type === \"object\" && schema.additionalProperties === undefined) {\n      schema.additionalProperties = false\n    }\n\n    // Add examples and default descriptions for string fields with defaults\n    if (schema && typeof schema === \"object\" && \"type\" in schema && schema.type === \"string\" && schema?.default) {\n      if (!schema.examples) {\n        schema.examples = [schema.default]\n      }\n\n      schema.description = [schema.description || \"\", `default: \\`${schema.default}\\``]\n        .filter(Boolean)\n        .join(\"\\n\\n\")\n        .trim()\n    }\n  },\n}) as Record<string, unknown> & {\n  allowComments?: boolean\n  allowTrailingCommas?: boolean\n}\n\n// used for json lsps since config supports jsonc\nresult.allowComments = true\nresult.allowTrailingCommas = true\n\nawait Bun.write(file, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2))\n",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n\nimport solidPlugin from \"../node_modules/@opentui/solid/scripts/solid-plugin\"\nimport path from \"path\"\nimport fs from \"fs\"\nimport { $, Glob } from \"bun\"\nimport { fileURLToPath } from \"url\"\n\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(__filename)\nconst dir = path.resolve(__dirname, \"..\")\n\nprocess.chdir(dir)\n\nimport pkg from \"../package.json\"\nimport { Script } from \"@opencode-ai/script\"\n\nconst singleFlag = process.argv.includes(\"--single\")\n\nconst allTargets = [\n  [\"windows\", \"x64\"],\n  [\"linux\", \"arm64\"],\n  [\"linux\", \"x64\"],\n  [\"linux\", \"x64-baseline\"],\n  [\"darwin\", \"x64\"],\n  [\"darwin\", \"x64-baseline\"],\n  [\"darwin\", \"arm64\"],\n]\n\nconst targets = singleFlag\n  ? allTargets.filter(([os, arch]) => os === process.platform && arch === process.arch)\n  : allTargets\n\nawait $`rm -rf dist`\n\nconst binaries: Record<string, string> = {}\nfor (const [os, arch] of targets) {\n  console.log(`building ${os}-${arch}`)\n  const name = `${pkg.name}-ai-${os}-${arch}`\n  await $`mkdir -p dist/${name}/bin`\n\n  const opentui = `@opentui/core-${os === \"windows\" ? \"win32\" : os}-${arch.replace(\"-baseline\", \"\")}`\n  const opentuiDir = path.join(dir, \"../../node_modules\", opentui)\n  await $`mkdir -p ${opentuiDir}`\n  await $`npm pack ${opentui}@${pkg.dependencies[\"@opentui/core\"]}`.cwd(\n    path.join(dir, \"../../node_modules\"),\n  )\n  const opentuiPattern = `${opentui.replace(\"@opentui/\", \"opentui-\")}-${pkg.dependencies[\"@opentui/core\"]}.tgz`\n  await $`tar -xf ../../node_modules/${opentuiPattern} -C ../../node_modules/${opentui} --strip-components=1`\n\n  const watcher = `@parcel/watcher-${os === \"windows\" ? \"win32\" : os}-${arch.replace(\"-baseline\", \"\")}${os === \"linux\" ? \"-glibc\" : \"\"}`\n  const watcherDir = path.join(dir, \"../../node_modules\", watcher)\n  await $`mkdir -p ${watcherDir}`\n  await $`npm pack ${watcher}`.cwd(path.join(dir, \"../../node_modules\")).quiet()\n  const watcherFiles = fs\n    .readdirSync(path.join(dir, \"../../node_modules\"))\n    .fil",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\nimport pkg from \"../package.json\"\nimport { Script } from \"@opencode-ai/script\"\n\nconst dir = new URL(\"..\", import.meta.url).pathname\nprocess.chdir(dir)\n\nconst { binaries } = await import(\"./build.ts\")\n{\n  const name = `${pkg.name}-ai-${process.platform}-${process.arch}`\n  console.log(`smoke test: running dist/${name}/bin/opencode --version`)\n  await $`./dist/${name}/bin/opencode --version`\n}\n\nawait $`mkdir -p ./dist/${pkg.name}`\nawait $`cp -r ./bin ./dist/${pkg.name}/bin`\nawait $`cp ./script/preinstall.mjs ./dist/${pkg.name}/preinstall.mjs`\nawait $`cp ./script/postinstall.mjs ./dist/${pkg.name}/postinstall.mjs`\nawait $`cp ./README.md ./dist/${pkg.name}/README.md`\nawait Bun.file(`./dist/${pkg.name}/package.json`).write(\n  JSON.stringify(\n    {\n      name: pkg.name + \"-ai\",\n      bin: {\n        [pkg.name]: `./bin/${pkg.name}`,\n      },\n      scripts: {\n        preinstall: \"bun ./preinstall.mjs || node ./preinstall.mjs\",\n        postinstall: \"bun ./postinstall.mjs || node ./postinstall.mjs\",\n      },\n      version: Script.version,\n      optionalDependencies: binaries,\n    },\n    null,\n    2,\n  ),\n)\nfor (const [name] of Object.entries(binaries)) {\n  await $`cd dist/${name} && chmod -R 777 . && bun publish --access public --tag ${Script.channel}`\n}\nawait $`cd ./dist/${pkg.name} && bun publish --access public --tag ${Script.channel}`\n\nif (!Script.preview) {\n  const major = Script.version.split(\".\")[0]\n  const majorTag = `latest-${major}`\n  for (const [name] of Object.entries(binaries)) {\n    await $`cd dist/${name} && npm dist-tag add ${name}@${Script.version} ${majorTag}`\n  }\n  await $`cd ./dist/${pkg.name} && npm dist-tag add ${pkg.name}-ai@${Script.version} ${majorTag}`\n}\n\nif (!Script.preview) {\n  for (const key of Object.keys(binaries)) {\n    await $`cd dist/${key}/bin && zip -r ../../${key}.zip *`\n  }\n\n  // Calculate SHA values\n  const arm64Sha = await $`sha256sum ./dist/opencode-linux-arm64.zip | cut -d' ' -f1`\n    .text()\n ",

    "content": "import { tool } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\nimport { pipeline } from \"@xenova/transformers\"\n\ninterface EmbeddedContent {\n  id: string\n  content: string\n  embedding: number[]\n  metadata?: Record<string, any>\n}\n\n// Global cache for embeddings, query cache, and model\nlet cachedIndex: EmbeddedContent[] | null = null\nlet cacheTimestamp = 0\nconst CACHE_TTL = 300000 // 5 minutes\nconst MAX_CACHE_SIZE_MB = 100 // Maximum cache size in MB\n\n// Query embedding cache (avoids repeated API/model calls for same queries)\nconst queryEmbeddingCache = new Map<string, number[]>()\nconst QUERY_CACHE_MAX = 100\n\n// Lazy-loaded local embedding model\nlet embeddingModel: any = null\n\nfunction getCacheSizeMB(data: EmbeddedContent[]): number {\n  const sizeBytes = JSON.stringify(data).length\n  return sizeBytes / 1024 / 1024\n}\n\nfunction canCacheIndex(data: EmbeddedContent[]): boolean {\n  const sizeMB = getCacheSizeMB(data)\n  if (sizeMB > MAX_CACHE_SIZE_MB) {\n    console.log(\n      `[FastSearch] Index too large to cache (${sizeMB.toFixed(2)}MB > ${MAX_CACHE_SIZE_MB}MB)`,\n    )\n    return false\n  }\n  return true\n}\n\nasync function getEmbeddingModel() {\n  if (!embeddingModel) {\n    console.log(\"[FastSearch] Loading local embedding model (first time only)...\")\n    const startTime = performance.now()\n    // Using a smaller, faster model optimized for semantic search\n    embeddingModel = await pipeline(\"feature-extraction\", \"Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\")\n    console.log(`[FastSearch] Model loaded in ${(performance.now() - startTime).toFixed(0)}ms`)\n  }\n  return embeddingModel\n}\n\nasync function generateLocalEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[]> {\n  const model = await getEmbeddingModel()\n  const output = await model(text, { pooling: \"mean\", normalize: true })\n  return Array.from(output.data)\n}\n\nfunction cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number {\n  if (a.length !== b.length) return 0\n\n  let dotProduct = 0\n  let magnitudeA = 0\n  let magnitudeB = 0\n\n  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {\n    dotProd",

    "id": "src/auth/index.ts",
    "content": "import path from \"path\"\nimport { Global } from \"../global\"\nimport fs from \"fs/promises\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\n\nexport namespace Auth {\n  export const Oauth = z\n    .object({\n      type: z.literal(\"oauth\"),\n      refresh: z.string(),\n      access: z.string(),\n      expires: z.number(),\n      enterpriseUrl: z.string().optional(),\n    })\n    .meta({ ref: \"OAuth\" })\n\n  export const Api = z\n    .object({\n      type: z.literal(\"api\"),\n      key: z.string(),\n    })\n    .meta({ ref: \"ApiAuth\" })\n\n  export const WellKnown = z\n    .object({\n      type: z.literal(\"wellknown\"),\n      key: z.string(),\n      token: z.string(),\n    })\n    .meta({ ref: \"WellKnownAuth\" })\n\n  export const Info = z.discriminatedUnion(\"type\", [Oauth, Api, WellKnown]).meta({ ref: \"Auth\" })\n  export type Info = z.infer<typeof Info>\n\n  const filepath = path.join(Global.Path.data, \"auth.json\")\n\n  export async function get(providerID: string) {\n    const file = Bun.file(filepath)\n    return file\n      .json()\n      .catch(() => ({}))\n      .then((x) => x[providerID] as Info | undefined)\n  }\n\n  export async function all(): Promise<Record<string, Info>> {\n    const file = Bun.file(filepath)\n    return file.json().catch(() => ({}))\n  }\n\n  export async function set(key: string, info: Info) {\n    const file = Bun.file(filepath)\n    const data = await all()\n    await Bun.write(file, JSON.stringify({ ...data, [key]: info }, null, 2))\n    await fs.chmod(file.name!, 0o600)\n  }\n\n  export async function remove(key: string) {\n    const file = Bun.file(filepath)\n    const data = await all()\n    delete data[key]\n    await Bun.write(file, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2))\n    await fs.chmod(file.name!, 0o600)\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "src/util/queue.ts",
    "content": "export class AsyncQueue<T> implements AsyncIterable<T> {\n  private queue: T[] = []\n  private resolvers: ((value: T) => void)[] = []\n\n  push(item: T) {\n    const resolve = this.resolvers.shift()\n    if (resolve) resolve(item)\n    else this.queue.push(item)\n  }\n\n  async next(): Promise<T> {\n    if (this.queue.length > 0) return this.queue.shift()!\n    return new Promise((resolve) => this.resolvers.push(resolve))\n  }\n\n  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {\n    while (true) yield await this.next()\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "src/util/binary.ts",
    "content": "export namespace Binary {\n  export function search<T>(array: T[], id: string, compare: (item: T) => string): { found: boolean; index: number } {\n    let left = 0\n    let right = array.length - 1\n\n    while (left <= right) {\n      const mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2)\n      const midId = compare(array[mid])\n\n      if (midId === id) {\n        return { found: true, index: mid }\n      } else if (midId < id) {\n        left = mid + 1\n      } else {\n        right = mid - 1\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { found: false, index: left }\n  }\n\n  export function insert<T>(array: T[], item: T, compare: (item: T) => string): T[] {\n    const id = compare(item)\n    let left = 0\n    let right = array.length\n\n    while (left < right) {\n      const mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2)\n      const midId = compare(array[mid])\n\n      if (midId < id) {\n        left = mid + 1\n      } else {\n        right = mid\n      }\n    }\n\n    array.splice(left, 0, item)\n    return array\n  }\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "src/util/error.ts",
    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\n\nexport abstract class NamedError extends Error {\n  abstract schema(): z.core.$ZodType\n  abstract toObject(): { name: string; data: any }\n\n  static create<Name extends string, Data extends z.core.$ZodType>(name: Name, data: Data) {\n    const schema = z\n      .object({\n        name: z.literal(name),\n        data,\n      })\n      .meta({\n        ref: name,\n      })\n    const result = class extends NamedError {\n      public static readonly Schema = schema\n\n      public override readonly name = name as Name\n\n      constructor(\n        public readonly data: z.input<Data>,\n        options?: ErrorOptions,\n      ) {\n        super(name, options)\n        this.name = name\n      }\n\n      static isInstance(input: any): input is InstanceType<typeof result> {\n        return typeof input === \"object\" && \"name\" in input && input.name === name\n      }\n\n      schema() {\n        return schema\n      }\n\n      toObject() {\n        return {\n          name: name,\n          data: this.data,\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    Object.defineProperty(result, \"name\", { value: name })\n    return result\n  }\n\n  public static readonly Unknown = NamedError.create(\n    \"UnknownError\",\n    z.object({\n      message: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n}\n",

    "content": "/**\n * Setup tiktoken WASM file path for Bun compiled binaries\n * This must be imported before any tiktoken usage\n */\n\nimport fs from \"node:fs\"\nimport path from \"node:path\"\nimport { fileURLToPath } from \"node:url\"\n\n// Setup WASM file location for tiktoken in compiled binary\nfunction setupTiktokenWasm() {\n  try {\n    // Get the directory where the binary is located\n    const binaryDir = path.dirname(process.execPath)\n    const wasmSource = path.join(binaryDir, \"tiktoken_bg.wasm\")\n\n    // Check if we're in a compiled binary and the WASM file exists next to it\n    if (!fs.existsSync(wasmSource)) {\n      return // Not in a compiled binary or WASM not found\n    }\n\n    // Tiktoken looks in __dirname of its module file\n    // In a compiled Bun binary, we need to patch the require/import resolution\n    // The tiktoken module will look for the WASM relative to its own location\n\n    // Monkey-patch the fs.readFileSync to intercept tiktoken's WASM load\n    const originalReadFileSync = fs.readFileSync\n    ;(fs as any).readFileSync = function (filepath: any, options?: any) {\n      // If tiktoken is trying to load its WASM file, redirect to our location\n      if (typeof filepath === \"string\" && filepath.includes(\"tiktoken_bg.wasm\")) {\n        // Redirect to our WASM file location\n        const redirected = wasmSource\n        // Debug logging (can be removed after verification)\n        if (process.env.DEBUG_TIKTOKEN) {\n          console.log(`[tiktoken-setup] Redirecting WASM load from ${filepath} to ${redirected}`)\n        }\n        filepath = redirected\n      }\n      return originalReadFileSync.call(fs, filepath, options)\n    }\n\n    // Also check if the WASM file is readable\n    const wasmBytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmSource)\n    // Uncomment for debugging:\n    // console.log(`[tiktoken-setup] Successfully loaded WASM file (${wasmBytes.length} bytes) from ${wasmSource}`)\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Silently fail - might not be needed in dev environment\n    console.warn(\"Warning: Cou",

    "id": "src/util/filesystem.ts",
    "content": "import { exists } from \"fs/promises\"\nimport { dirname, join, relative } from \"path\"\n\nexport namespace Filesystem {\n  export function overlaps(a: string, b: string) {\n    const relA = relative(a, b)\n    const relB = relative(b, a)\n    return !relA || !relA.startsWith(\"..\") || !relB || !relB.startsWith(\"..\")\n  }\n\n  export function contains(parent: string, child: string) {\n    return !relative(parent, child).startsWith(\"..\")\n  }\n\n  export async function findUp(target: string, start: string, stop?: string) {\n    let current = start\n    const result = []\n    while (true) {\n      const search = join(current, target)\n      if (await exists(search)) result.push(search)\n      if (stop === current) break\n      const parent = dirname(current)\n      if (parent === current) break\n      current = parent\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export async function* up(options: { targets: string[]; start: string; stop?: string }) {\n    const { targets, start, stop } = options\n    let current = start\n    while (true) {\n      for (const target of targets) {\n        const search = join(current, target)\n        if (await exists(search)) yield search\n      }\n      if (stop === current) break\n      const parent = dirname(current)\n      if (parent === current) break\n      current = parent\n    }\n  }\n\n  export async function globUp(pattern: string, start: string, stop?: string) {\n    let current = start\n    const result = []\n    while (true) {\n      try {\n        const glob = new Bun.Glob(pattern)\n        for await (const match of glob.scan({\n          cwd: current,\n          absolute: true,\n          onlyFiles: true,\n          followSymlinks: true,\n          dot: true,\n        })) {\n          result.push(match)\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // Skip invalid glob patterns\n      }\n      if (stop === current) break\n      const parent = dirname(current)\n      if (parent === current) break\n      current = parent\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n}\n",

    "content": "export function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {\n  let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout\n  return Promise.race([\n    promise.then((result) => {\n      clearTimeout(timeout)\n      return result\n    }),\n    new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {\n      timeout = setTimeout(() => {\n        reject(new Error(`Operation timed out after ${ms}ms`))\n      }, ms)\n    }),\n  ])\n}\n",

    "content": "import { Log } from \"./log\"\n\nexport namespace EventLoop {\n  export async function wait() {\n    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\n      const check = () => {\n        const active = [...(process as any)._getActiveHandles(), ...(process as any)._getActiveRequests()]\n        Log.Default.info(\"eventloop\", {\n          active,\n        })\n        if ((process as any)._getActiveHandles().length === 0 && (process as any)._getActiveRequests().length === 0) {\n          resolve()\n        } else {\n          setImmediate(check)\n        }\n      }\n      check()\n    })\n  }\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "src/util/diagnostic.ts",
    "content": "import { LSPClient } from \"../lsp/client\"\nimport type { Diagnostic } from \"vscode-languageserver-types\"\n\n/**\n * Type guard to check if diagnostics are in the new multi-server format\n */\nexport function isMultiServerFormat(\n  diagnostics: Diagnostic[] | Array<{ diagnostic: Diagnostic; serverID: string }>,\n): diagnostics is Array<{ diagnostic: Diagnostic; serverID: string }> {\n  return diagnostics.length > 0 && \"diagnostic\" in diagnostics[0]\n}\n\n/**\n * Sanitize server ID for safe display in UI\n */\nexport function sanitizeServerID(serverID: string): string {\n  if (typeof serverID !== \"string\") return \"Unknown\"\n\n  let result = serverID\n\n  // Handle special case: single tag like <typescript> -> typescript\n  const singleTagMatch = result.match(/^<(\\w+)>$/)\n  if (singleTagMatch) {\n    result = singleTagMatch[1]\n  } else {\n    // Remove HTML tags completely for other cases\n    result = result.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, \"\")\n  }\n\n  return result\n    .replace(/javascript:/gi, \"\") // Remove javascript protocol\n    .replace(/data:/gi, \"\") // Remove data protocol\n    .replace(/vbscript:/gi, \"\") // Remove vbscript protocol\n    .replace(/on\\w+=/gi, \"\") // Remove event handlers\n    .trim()\n    .substring(0, 100) // Limit length\n}\n\n/**\n * Group diagnostics by server ID for efficient processing\n * Optimized for large datasets using Map and batch operations\n */\nexport function groupDiagnosticsByServer(\n  diagnostics: Array<{ diagnostic: Diagnostic; serverID: string }>,\n): Record<string, Diagnostic[]> {\n  if (!Array.isArray(diagnostics) || diagnostics.length === 0) {\n    return {}\n  }\n\n  const grouped = new Map<string, Diagnostic[]>()\n\n  // Batch process for better performance\n  for (const item of diagnostics) {\n    if (!validateDiagnosticItem(item)) continue\n\n    const serverID = sanitizeServerID(item.serverID || \"Unknown\")\n    const existing = grouped.get(serverID)\n\n    if (existing) {\n      existing.push(item.diagnostic)\n    } else {\n      grouped.set(serverID, [item.diagnostic])\n    }\n  }\n\n",

    "content": "import { z } from \"zod\"\n\nexport function fn<T extends z.ZodType, Result>(schema: T, cb: (input: z.infer<T>) => Result) {\n  const result = (input: z.infer<T>) => {\n    const parsed = schema.parse(input)\n    return cb(parsed)\n  }\n  result.force = (input: z.infer<T>) => cb(input)\n  result.schema = schema\n  return result\n}\n",

    "id": "src/util/wildcard.ts",
    "content": "import { sortBy, pipe } from \"remeda\"\n\nexport namespace Wildcard {\n  export function match(str: string, pattern: string) {\n    const regex = new RegExp(\n      \"^\" +\n        pattern\n          .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, \"\\\\$&\") // escape special regex chars\n          .replace(/\\*/g, \".*\") // * becomes .*\n          .replace(/\\?/g, \".\") + // ? becomes .\n        \"$\",\n      \"s\", // s flag enables multiline matching\n    )\n    return regex.test(str)\n  }\n\n  export function all(input: string, patterns: Record<string, any>) {\n    const sorted = pipe(patterns, Object.entries, sortBy([([key]) => key.length, \"asc\"], [([key]) => key, \"asc\"]))\n    let result = undefined\n    for (const [pattern, value] of sorted) {\n      if (match(input, pattern)) {\n        result = value\n        continue\n      }\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export function allStructured(input: { head: string; tail: string[] }, patterns: Record<string, any>) {\n    const sorted = pipe(patterns, Object.entries, sortBy([([key]) => key.length, \"asc\"], [([key]) => key, \"asc\"]))\n    let result = undefined\n    for (const [pattern, value] of sorted) {\n      const parts = pattern.split(/\\s+/)\n      if (!match(input.head, parts[0])) continue\n      if (parts.length === 1 || matchSequence(input.tail, parts.slice(1))) {\n        result = value\n        continue\n      }\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n\n  function matchSequence(items: string[], patterns: string[]): boolean {\n    if (patterns.length === 0) return true\n    const [pattern, ...rest] = patterns\n    if (pattern === \"*\") return matchSequence(items, rest)\n    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {\n      if (match(items[i], pattern) && matchSequence(items.slice(i + 1), rest)) {\n        return true\n      }\n    }\n    return false\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "src/util/rpc.ts",
    "content": "export namespace Rpc {\n  type Definition = {\n    [method: string]: (input: any) => any\n  }\n\n  export function listen(rpc: Definition) {\n    onmessage = async (evt) => {\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(evt.data)\n      if (parsed.type === \"rpc.request\") {\n        const result = await rpc[parsed.method](parsed.input)\n        postMessage(JSON.stringify({ type: \"rpc.result\", result, id: parsed.id }))\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  export function client<T extends Definition>(target: {\n    postMessage: (data: string) => void | null\n    onmessage: ((this: Worker, ev: MessageEvent<any>) => any) | null\n  }) {\n    const pending = new Map<number, (result: any) => void>()\n    let id = 0\n    target.onmessage = async (evt) => {\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(evt.data)\n      if (parsed.type === \"rpc.result\") {\n        const resolve = pending.get(parsed.id)\n        if (resolve) {\n          resolve(parsed.result)\n          pending.delete(parsed.id)\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return {\n      call<Method extends keyof T>(method: Method, input: Parameters<T[Method]>[0]): Promise<ReturnType<T[Method]>> {\n        const requestId = id++\n        return new Promise((resolve) => {\n          pending.set(requestId, resolve)\n          target.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ type: \"rpc.request\", method, input, id: requestId }))\n        })\n      },\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "src/util/context.ts",
    "content": "import { AsyncLocalStorage } from \"async_hooks\"\n\nexport namespace Context {\n  export class NotFound extends Error {\n    constructor(public override readonly name: string) {\n      super(`No context found for ${name}`)\n    }\n  }\n\n  export function create<T>(name: string) {\n    const storage = new AsyncLocalStorage<T>()\n    return {\n      use() {\n        const result = storage.getStore()\n        if (!result) {\n          throw new NotFound(name)\n        }\n        return result\n      },\n      provide<R>(value: T, fn: () => R) {\n        return storage.run(value, fn)\n      },\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

    "content": "export namespace Lock {\n  const locks = new Map<\n    string,\n    {\n      readers: number\n      writer: boolean\n      waitingReaders: (() => void)[]\n      waitingWriters: (() => void)[]\n    }\n  >()\n\n  function get(key: string) {\n    if (!locks.has(key)) {\n      locks.set(key, {\n        readers: 0,\n        writer: false,\n        waitingReaders: [],\n        waitingWriters: [],\n      })\n    }\n    return locks.get(key)!\n  }\n\n  function process(key: string) {\n    const lock = locks.get(key)\n    if (!lock || lock.writer || lock.readers > 0) return\n\n    // Prioritize writers to prevent starvation\n    if (lock.waitingWriters.length > 0) {\n      const nextWriter = lock.waitingWriters.shift()!\n      nextWriter()\n      return\n    }\n\n    // Wake up all waiting readers\n    while (lock.waitingReaders.length > 0) {\n      const nextReader = lock.waitingReaders.shift()!\n      nextReader()\n    }\n\n    // Clean up empty locks\n    if (lock.readers === 0 && !lock.writer && lock.waitingReaders.length === 0 && lock.waitingWriters.length === 0) {\n      locks.delete(key)\n    }\n  }\n\n  export async function read(key: string): Promise<Disposable> {\n    const lock = get(key)\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) => {\n      if (!lock.writer && lock.waitingWriters.length === 0) {\n        lock.readers++\n        resolve({\n          [Symbol.dispose]: () => {\n            lock.readers--\n            process(key)\n          },\n        })\n      } else {\n        lock.waitingReaders.push(() => {\n          lock.readers++\n          resolve({\n            [Symbol.dispose]: () => {\n              lock.readers--\n              process(key)\n            },\n          })\n        })\n      }\n    })\n  }\n\n  export async function write(key: string): Promise<Disposable> {\n    const lock = get(key)\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) => {\n      if (!lock.writer && lock.readers === 0) {\n        lock.writer = true\n        resolve({\n          [Symbol.dispose]: () => {\n            lock.writer = false\n            process(key)\n          },",

    "content": "export namespace Locale {\n  export function titlecase(str: string) {\n    return str.replace(/\\b\\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())\n  }\n\n  export function time(input: number) {\n    const date = new Date(input)\n    return date.toLocaleTimeString()\n  }\n\n  export function number(num: number): string {\n    if (num >= 1000000) {\n      return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + \"M\"\n    } else if (num >= 1000) {\n      return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + \"K\"\n    }\n    return num.toString()\n  }\n\n  export function truncate(str: string, len: number): string {\n    if (str.length <= len) return str\n    return str.slice(0, len - 1) + \"…\"\n  }\n\n  export function truncateMiddle(str: string, maxLength: number = 35): string {\n    if (str.length <= maxLength) return str\n\n    const ellipsis = \"…\"\n    const keepStart = Math.ceil((maxLength - ellipsis.length) / 2)\n    const keepEnd = Math.floor((maxLength - ellipsis.length) / 2)\n\n    return str.slice(0, keepStart) + ellipsis + str.slice(-keepEnd)\n  }\n\n  export function pluralize(count: number, singular: string, plural: string): string {\n    const template = count === 1 ? singular : plural\n    return template.replace(\"{}\", count.toString())\n  }\n\n  export function stripMarkdown(str: string): string {\n    return str\n      .replace(/\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*/g, \"$1\") // Bold **text**\n      .replace(/\\*(.+?)\\*/g, \"$1\") // Italic *text*\n      .replace(/__(.+?)__/g, \"$1\") // Bold __text__\n      .replace(/_(.+?)_/g, \"$1\") // Italic _text_\n      .replace(/`(.+?)`/g, \"$1\") // Inline code `code`\n      .replace(/\\[(.+?)\\]\\(.+?\\)/g, \"$1\") // Links [text](url)\n      .replace(/^#+\\s+/gm, \"\") // Headers\n  }\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "src/util/keybind.ts",
    "content": "import { isDeepEqual } from \"remeda\"\n\nexport namespace Keybind {\n  export type Info = {\n    ctrl: boolean\n    meta: boolean\n    shift: boolean\n    leader: boolean\n    name: string\n  }\n\n  export function match(a: Info, b: Info): boolean {\n    return isDeepEqual(a, b)\n  }\n\n  export function toString(info: Info): string {\n    const parts: string[] = []\n\n    if (info.ctrl) parts.push(\"ctrl\")\n    if (info.meta) parts.push(\"alt\")\n    if (info.shift) parts.push(\"shift\")\n    if (info.name) {\n      if (info.name === \"delete\") parts.push(\"del\")\n      else parts.push(info.name)\n    }\n\n    let result = parts.join(\"+\")\n\n    if (info.leader) {\n      result = result ? `<leader> ${result}` : `<leader>`\n    }\n\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export function parse(key: string): Info[] {\n    if (key === \"none\") return []\n\n    return key.split(\",\").map((combo) => {\n      // Handle <leader> syntax by replacing with leader+\n      const normalized = combo.replace(/<leader>/g, \"leader+\")\n      const parts = normalized.toLowerCase().split(\"+\")\n      const info: Info = {\n        ctrl: false,\n        meta: false,\n        shift: false,\n        leader: false,\n        name: \"\",\n      }\n\n      for (const part of parts) {\n        switch (part) {\n          case \"ctrl\":\n            info.ctrl = true\n            break\n          case \"alt\":\n          case \"meta\":\n          case \"option\":\n            info.meta = true\n            break\n          case \"shift\":\n            info.shift = true\n            break\n          case \"leader\":\n            info.leader = true\n            break\n          case \"esc\":\n            info.name = \"escape\"\n            break\n          default:\n            info.name = part\n            break\n        }\n      }\n\n      return info\n    })\n  }\n}\n",

\"../project/instance\"\nimport { Flag } from \"../flag/flag\"\nimport { LSPInstaller } from \"./installer\"\n\nexport namespace LSPServer {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"lsp.server\" })\n  const downloadLocks = new Map<string, Promise<void>>()\n\n  async function downloadWithLock<T>(\n    id: string,\n    download: () => Promise<T>,\n  ): Promise<T | undefined> {\n    const existing = downloadLocks.get(id)\n    if (existing) {\n      await existing\n      return undefined // Already downloaded by another caller\n    }\n\n    const promise = download().finally(() => downloadLocks.delete(id))\n    downloadLocks.set(id, promise as Promise<void>)\n    return promise\n  }\n\n  export interface Handle {\n    process: ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams\n    initialization?: Record<string, any>\n  }\n\n  type RootFunction = (file: string) => Promise<string | undefined>\n\n  const NearestRoot = (includePatterns: string[], excludePatterns?: string[]): path.dirname(file),\n          stop: Instance.directory,\n        })\n        const excluded = await excludedFiles.next()\n        await excludedFiles.return()\n        if (excluded.value) return undefined\n      }\n      const files = Filesystem.up({\n        targets: includePatterns,\n        start: path.dirname(file),\n        stop: Instance.directory,\n      })\n      const first = await files.next()\n      await files.return()\n      if (!first.value) return Instance.directory\n      return path.dirname(first.value)\n    }\n  }\n\n  export interface Info {\n    i",

\".exe\" : \"\"))\n        log.info(`installed ruby-lsp`, {\n          bin,\n        })\n      }\n      return {\n        process: spawn(bin!, [\"--stdio\"], {\n          cwd: root,\n        }),\n      }\n    },\n  }\n\n  export const Pyright: Info = {\n    id: \"pyright\",\n    extensions: [\".py\", \".pyi\"],\n    root: NearestRoot([\n      \"pyproject.toml\",\n      \"setup.py\",\n      \"setup.cfg\",\n      \"requirements.txt\",\n      \"Pipfile\",\n      \"pyrightconfig.json\",\n    ]),\n    async spawn(root) {\n      try {\n        const js = await LSPInstaller.installNPMPackage({\n          packageName: \"pyright\",\n          entryPoint: \"pyright/dist/pyright-langserver.js\",\n          binaryName: \"pyright-langserver\",\n        })\n\n        const initialization: Record<string, string> = {}\n\n        const potentialVenvPaths = [\n          process.env[\"VIRTUAL_ENV\"],\n          path.join(root, \".venv\"),\n          path.join(root, \"venv\"),\n        ].filter((p): p is string => p !== undefined)\n\n        for (const venvPath of potentialVenvPaths) {\n          const isWindows = process.platform === \"win32\"\n          const potentialPythonPath = isWindows\n            ? path.join(venvPath, \"Scripts\", \"python.exe\")\n            : path.join(venvPath, \"bin\", \"python\")\n          if (await Bun.file(potentialPythonPath).exists()) {\n            initialization[\"pythonPath\"] ",

    "content": "\", \"--tool-path\", Global.Path.bin],\n          stdout: \"pipe\",\n          stderr: \"pipe\",\n          stdin: \"pipe\",\n        })\n        const exit = await proc.exited\n        if (exit !== 0) {\n          log.error(\"Failed to install csharp-ls\")\n          return\n        }\n\n        bin = path.join(Global.Path.bin, \"csharp-ls\" + (process.platform === \"win32\" ? \".exe\" : \"\"))\n        log.info(`installed csharp-ls`, { bin })\n      }\n\n      return {\n        process: spawn(bin, {\n          cwd: root,\n        }),\n      }\n    },\n  }\n\n  export const RustAnalyzer: Info = {\n    id: \"rust\",\n    root: async (root) => {\n      const crateRoot = await NearestRoot([\"Cargo.toml\", \"Cargo.lock\"])(root)\n      if (crateRoot === undefined) {\n        return undefined\n      }\n      let currentDir = crateRoot\n\n      while (currentDir !== path.dirname(currentDir)) {\n        // Stop at filesystem root\n        const cargoTomlPath = path.join(currentDir, \"Cargo.toml\")\n        try {\n          const cargoTomlContent = await Bun.file(cargoTomlPath).text()\n          if (cargoTomlContent.includes(\"[workspace]\")) {\n            return currentDir\n          }\n        } catch (err) {\n          // File doesn't exist or can't be read, continue searching up\n        }\n\n        const parentDir = path.dirname(currentDir)\n        if (parentDir === currentDir) break // Reached filesystem root\n        currentDir = parentDir\n\n        // Stop if we've gone above the app root\n        if (!currentDir.startsWith(Instance.worktree)) break\n      }\n\n      return crateRoot\n    },\n    extensions: [\".rs\"],\n    async spawn(root) {\n      const bin = Bun.which(\"rust-analyzer\")\n      if (!bin) {\n        log.info(\"rust-analyzer not found in path, please install it\")\n        return\n      }\n      return {\n        process: spawn(bin, {\n          cwd: root,\n        }),\n      }\n    },\n  }\n\n  export const Clangd: Info = {\n    id: \"clangd\",\n    root: NearestRoot([\n      \"compile_commands.json\",\n      \"compile_flags.txt\",\n      \".clangd\",\n     ",

path.join(launcherDir, jarFileName)\n      if (!(await fs.exists(launcherJar))) {\n        log.error(\n          `Failed to locate the JDTLS launcher module in the installed directory: ${distPath}.`,\n        )\n        return\n      }\n      const configFile = path.join(\n        distPath,\n        (() => {\n          switch (process.platform) {\n            case \"darwin\":\n     return \"config_linux\"\n          }\n        })(),\n      )\n      const dataDir = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), \"opencode-jdtls-data\"))\n      return {\n        process: spawn(\n     "content": "     await fs.rm(installDir, { force: true, recursive: true })\n        }\n\n        await fs.mkdir(installDir, { recursive: true })\n        await $`unzip -o -q ${zipPath} -d ${installDir}`.quiet().nothrow()\n        await fs.rm(zipPath, { force: true })\n\n        bin = path.join(\n          installDir,\n          \"server\",\n          \"bin\",\n          \"kotlin-language-server\" + (process.platform === \"win32\" ? \".bat\" : \"\"),\n        )\n\n        if (!(await Bun.file(bin).exists())) {\n          log.error(\"Failed to extract kotlin-language-server binary\")\n          return\n        }\n\n        if (process.platform !== \"win32\") {\n          await $`chmod +x ${bin}`.nothrow()\n        }\n\n        log.info(`installed kotlin-language-server`, { bin })\n      }\n\n      return {\n        process: spawn(bin, {\n          cwd: root,\n        }),\n      }\n    },\n  }\n\n  export const Bash: Info = {\n    id: \"bash\",\n    root: async () => Instance.directory,\n    extensions: [\".sh\", \".bash\"],\n    async spawn(root) {\n      try {\n        const js = await LSPInstaller.installNPMPackage({\n          packageName: \"bash-language-server\",\n          entryPoint: \"bash-language-server/out/cli.js\",\n          binaryName: \"bash-language-server\",\n        })\n\n        const proc = spawn(BunProc.which(), [\"run\", js, \"start\"], {\n          cwd: root,\n          env: {\n            ...process.env,\n            BUN_BE_BUN: \"1\",\n          },\n        })\n\n        return {\n          process: proc,\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        log.error(\"Failed to install Bash language server\", { error: err })\n        return\n      }\n    },\n  }\n\n  export const YAML: Info = {\n    id: \"yaml\",\n    root: async () => Instance.directory,\n    extensions: [\".yaml\", \".yml\"],\n    async spawn(root) {\n      try {\n        const js = await LSPInstaller.installNPMPackage({\n          packageName: \"yaml-language-server\",\n          entryPoint: \"yaml-language-server/out/server/src/server.js\",\n          binaryName: \"yaml-language-server\",\n        })\n\n        con",

    "content": "import { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { LSPClient } from \"./client\"\nimport path from \"path\"\nimport { LSPServer } from \"./server\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { spawn } from \"child_process\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\n\nimport { formatDiagnosticsWithServers as formatDiagnosticsWithServersUtil } from \"../util/diagnostic\"\nexport namespace LSP {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"lsp\" })\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Updated: Bus.event(\"lsp.updated\", z.object({})),\n  }\n\n  export const Range = z\n    .object({\n      start: z.object({\n        line: z.number(),\n        character: z.number(),\n      }),\n      end: z.object({\n        line: z.number(),\n        character: z.number(),\n      }),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"Range\",\n    })\n  export type Range = z.infer<typeof Range>\n\n  export const Symbol = z\n    .object({\n      name: z.string(),\n      kind: z.number(),\n      location: z.object({\n        uri: z.string(),\n        range: Range,\n      }),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"Symbol\",\n    })\n  export type Symbol = z.infer<typeof Symbol>\n\n  export const DocumentSymbol = z\n    .object({\n      name: z.string(),\n      detail: z.string().optional(),\n      kind: z.number(),\n      range: Range,\n      selectionRange: Range,\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"DocumentSymbol\",\n    })\n  export type DocumentSymbol = z.infer<typeof DocumentSymbol>\n\n  const state = Instance.state(\n    async () => {\n      const clients: LSPClient.Info[] = []\n      const servers: Record<string, LSPServer.Info> = {}\n      for (const server of Object.values(LSPServer)) {\n        servers[server.id] = server\n      }\n      const cfg = await Config.get()\n      for (const [name, item] of Object.entries(cfg.lsp ?? {})) {\n        const existing = servers[name]\n        if (item.disabled) {\n          log.info(`LSP server ${name} is disabled`)\n          delete servers[name]\n          continue\n        }\n        servers[name] = {\n  ",

    "id": "src/lsp/index.ts [chunk 2/2]",
    "content": " const clients = await state().then((x) => x.clients)\n    const tasks = clients.map((x) => input(x))\n    return Promise.all(tasks)\n  }\n\n  export namespace Diagnostic {\n    export function pretty(diagnostic: LSPClient.Diagnostic) {\n      const severityMap = {\n        1: \"ERROR\",\n        2: \"WARN\",\n        3: \"INFO\",\n        4: \"HINT\",\n      }\n\n      const severity = severityMap[diagnostic.severity || 1]\n      const line = diagnostic.range.start.line + 1\n      const col = diagnostic.range.start.character + 1\n\n      return `${severity} [${line}:${col}] ${diagnostic.message}`\n    }\n\n    export function prettyWithServer(diagnostic: LSPClient.Diagnostic, serverID: string) {\n      const sanitizedServerID = serverID\n        .replace(/[\\x00-\\x1F\\x7F]/g, \"\") // Remove control characters\n        .replace(/[\\r\\n]/g, \"\") // Remove newlines\n        .replace(/[\\[\\]]/g, \"\") // Remove square brackets\n        .replace(/[{}|\\\\]/g, \"\") // Remove other potentially problematic chars\n        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, \"_\") // Replace other unsafe chars with underscore\n        .substring(0, 50) // Limit length\n        .trim() || \"Unknown\"\n      \n      return `${pretty(diagnostic)} [${sanitizedServerID}]`\n    }\n\n    export function formatDiagnosticsWithServers(\n      diagnostics: Array<{ diagnostic: LSPClient.Diagnostic; serverID: string }>,\n    ): string {\n      return formatDiagnosticsWithServersUtil(diagnostics)\n    }\n  }\n}\n",
