```json
    "content": "import path from \"path\"\nimport { createMessageConnection, StreamMessageReader, StreamMessageWriter } from \"vscode-jsonrpc/node\"\nimport type { Diagnostic as VSCodeDiagnostic } from \"vscode-languageserver-types\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { LANGUAGE_EXTENSIONS } from \"./language\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\nimport type { LSPServer } from \"./server\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"../util/error\"\nimport { withTimeout } from \"../util/timeout\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\n\nexport namespace LSPClient {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"lsp.client\" })\n\n  export type Info = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof create>>>\n\n  export type Diagnostic = VSCodeDiagnostic\n\n  export const InitializeError = NamedError.create(\n    \"LSPInitializeError\",\n    z.object({\n      serverID: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Diagnostics: Bus.event(\n      \"lsp.client.diagnostics\",\n      z.object({\n        serverID: z.string(),\n        path: z.string(),\n      }),\n    ),\n  }\n\n  export async function create(input: { serverID: string; server: LSPServer.Handle; root: string }) {\n    const l = log.clone().tag(\"serverID\", input.serverID)\n    l.info(\"starting client\")\n\n    const connection = createMessageConnection(\n      new StreamMessageReader(input.server.process.stdout as any),\n      new StreamMessageWriter(input.server.process.stdin as any),\n    )\n\n    const diagnostics = new Map<string, Diagnostic[]>()\n    connection.onNotification(\"textDocument/publishDiagnostics\", (params) => {\n      const path = new URL(params.uri).pathname\n      l.info(\"textDocument/publishDiagnostics\", {\n        path,\n      })\n      const exists = diagnostics.has(path)\n      diagnostics.set(path, params.diagnostics)\n      if (!exists && input.serverID === \"typescript\") return\n      Bus.publish(Event.Diagnostics, { path, serverID: input.serverID })\n    })\n    connection.onRequest(\"window/workDoneProgress/create\", (params) => {\n      l.info(\"window/workDon",

    "content": "import path from \"path\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { Global } from \"../global\"\nimport { Flag } from \"../flag/flag\"\nimport { BunProc } from \"../bun\"\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\n\nexport namespace LSPInstaller {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"lsp.installer\" })\n\n  const downloadLocks = new Map<string, Promise<void>>()\n\n  async function downloadWithLock<T>(\n    id: string,\n    download: () => Promise<T>,\n  ): Promise<T | undefined> {\n    const existing = downloadLocks.get(id)\n    if (existing) {\n      await existing\n      return undefined\n    }\n\n    const promise = download().finally(() => downloadLocks.delete(id))\n    downloadLocks.set(id, promise as Promise<void>)\n    return promise\n  }\n\n  export interface NPMPackageOptions {\n    packageName: string\n    entryPoint: string\n    binaryName?: string\n  }\n\n  export async function installNPMPackage(options: NPMPackageOptions): Promise<string> {\n    if (options.binaryName) {\n      const bin = Bun.which(options.binaryName)\n      if (bin) return bin\n    }\n\n    const js = path.join(Global.Path.bin, \"node_modules\", ...options.entryPoint.split(\"/\"))\n\n    if (!(await Bun.file(js).exists())) {\n      if (Flag.OPENCODE_DISABLE_LSP_DOWNLOAD) {\n        throw new Error(`LSP download disabled: ${options.packageName}`)\n      }\n\n      log.info(`installing ${options.packageName}`)\n\n      const result = await downloadWithLock(options.packageName, async () => {\n        await Bun.spawn([BunProc.which(), \"install\", options.packageName], {\n          cwd: Global.Path.bin,\n          env: {\n            ...process.env,\n            BUN_BE_BUN: \"1\",\n          },\n          stdout: \"pipe\",\n          stderr: \"pipe\",\n          stdin: \"pipe\",\n        }).exited\n      })\n\n      if (result === undefined && !(await Bun.file(js).exists())) {\n        throw new Error(`LSP download completed but binary not found: ${js}`)\n      }\n\n      log.info(`installed ${options.packageName}`, { path: js })\n    }\n\n    return js\n  }\n\n  export interface GitHubReleas",

    "content": "import { spawn } from \"bun\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"../util/error\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\n\nconst SUPPORTED_IDES = [\n  { name: \"Windsurf\" as const, cmd: \"windsurf\" },\n  { name: \"Visual Studio Code\" as const, cmd: \"code\" },\n  { name: \"Cursor\" as const, cmd: \"cursor\" },\n  { name: \"VSCodium\" as const, cmd: \"codium\" },\n]\n\nexport namespace Ide {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"ide\" })\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Installed: Bus.event(\n      \"ide.installed\",\n      z.object({\n        ide: z.string(),\n      }),\n    ),\n  }\n\n  export const AlreadyInstalledError = NamedError.create(\"AlreadyInstalledError\", z.object({}))\n\n  export const InstallFailedError = NamedError.create(\n    \"InstallFailedError\",\n    z.object({\n      stderr: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n\n  export function ide() {\n    if (process.env[\"TERM_PROGRAM\"] === \"vscode\") {\n      const v = process.env[\"GIT_ASKPASS\"]\n      for (const ide of SUPPORTED_IDES) {\n        if (v?.includes(ide.name)) return ide.name\n      }\n    }\n    return \"unknown\"\n  }\n\n  export function alreadyInstalled() {\n    return process.env[\"OPENCODE_CALLER\"] === \"vscode\"\n  }\n\n  export async function install(ide: (typeof SUPPORTED_IDES)[number][\"name\"]) {\n    const cmd = SUPPORTED_IDES.find((i) => i.name === ide)?.cmd\n    if (!cmd) throw new Error(`Unknown IDE: ${ide}`)\n\n    const p = spawn([cmd, \"--install-extension\", \"sst-dev.opencode\"], {\n      stdout: \"pipe\",\n      stderr: \"pipe\",\n    })\n    await p.exited\n    const stdout = await new Response(p.stdout).text()\n    const stderr = await new Response(p.stderr).text()\n\n    log.info(\"installed\", {\n      ide,\n      stdout,\n      stderr,\n    })\n\n    if (p.exitCode !== 0) {\n      throw new InstallFailedError({ stderr })\n    }\n    if (stdout.includes(\"already installed\")) {\n      throw new AlreadyInstalledError({})\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "examples/plugin-sidebar-context/build-babel.ts",
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n\nimport { transformAsync } from \"@babel/core\"\nimport * as fs from \"fs\"\nimport * as path from \"path\"\nimport { fileURLToPath } from \"url\"\n\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(__filename)\n\n// Load babel presets from node_modules\nconst solidPreset = require(path.join(__dirname, \"../../node_modules/babel-preset-solid\"))\nconst tsPreset = require(path.join(__dirname, \"../../node_modules/@babel/preset-typescript\"))\n\nconsole.log(\"Building plugin with Babel + SolidJS preset...\")\n\nconst inputFile = path.join(__dirname, \"index.tsx\")\nconst outputFile = path.join(__dirname, \"dist/index.js\")\n\n// Ensure dist directory exists\nfs.mkdirSync(path.join(__dirname, \"dist\"), { recursive: true })\n\n// Read the file content\nconst fileContent = await fs.promises.readFile(inputFile, \"utf-8\")\n\n// Transform with Babel using babel-preset-solid (same config as @opentui/solid uses)\nconst result = await transformAsync(fileContent, {\n  filename: inputFile,\n  presets: [\n    [\n      solidPreset,\n      {\n        moduleName: \"@opentui/solid\",\n        generate: \"universal\",\n      },\n    ],\n    [tsPreset],\n  ],\n})\n\nif (!result || typeof result !== \"object\" || !(\"code\" in result) || !result.code) {\n  console.error(\"Build failed: no code generated\")\n  process.exit(1)\n}\n\n// Write output\nfs.writeFileSync(outputFile, result.code as string, \"utf-8\")\n\nconsole.log(\"✓ Plugin built successfully to\", outputFile)\n",

    "id": "examples/plugin-sidebar-context/index.tsx [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Context Panel Plugin - Using Plugin UI Canvas\n *\n * This plugin uses ONLY the approved Plugin UI Canvas components.\n * This ensures it will work correctly in the TUI renderer context.\n */\n\n/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */\n\nimport { createSignal, onMount, onCleanup, For } from \"../../src/plugin-ui\"\n\nexport const ContextPanelPlugin = async () => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (_input: any, output: any) => {\n      // Register a panel that will appear in the sidebar\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"context-panel\",\n          label: \"Context\",\n          icon: \"📊\",\n          area: \"left\",\n          position: \"top\",\n          collapsible: true,\n        },\n      ]\n\n      // Subscribe to session updates so we can refresh when context changes\n      output.subscriptions = {\n        events: [\"session.updated\", \"context.updated\"],\n        session: true,\n      }\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n      if (input.componentId === \"context-panel\") {\n        const { client, sessionID, messages, sync } = input.context\n\n        // Component that fetches and displays context info\n        const ContextPanel = () => {\n          console.log(\"[ContextPanel] Initialized with sessionID:\", sessionID)\n\n          const [context, setContext] = createSignal({\n            tokens: 0,\n            tokenLimit: 200000,\n            systemTokens: 0,\n            assistantTokens: 0,\n            userTokens: 0,\n            toolTokens: 0,\n            percentage: 0,\n            cost: 0,\n          })\n\n          const calculateContext = () => {\n            try {\n              // Calculate context from messages (like old sidebar does)\n              const msgs = messages()\n              if (!msgs || msgs.length === 0) {\n                setContext({\n                  tokens: 0,\n                  tokenLimit: 200000,\n                  systemTokens: 0,\n                  assistantTokens: 0,\n                  userTokens: 0,\n                  toolTokens: 0,\n  ",

  {
    "id": "examples/plugin-jsx-component/index.tsx",
    "content": "/**\n * JSX Component Plugin Example for OpenCode\n *\n * Demonstrates how to export actual JSX/Solid.js components from plugins\n * instead of just text strings. This allows:\n * - Full Solid.js reactivity with createSignal, createMemo, etc.\n * - Mouse and keyboard event handlers (onMouseUp, onClick, etc.)\n * - Colors and theming with theme context\n * - Complex visual components (progress bars, icons, layouts)\n */\n\nimport type { Plugin } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\nimport type { WidgetDefinition } from \"../../src/ui/types\"\nimport { createSignal, Show, For } from \"solid-js\"\nimport { TextAttributes } from \"@opentui/core\"\n\n// This plugin exports actual JSX components that will be rendered in the TUI\nexport const JSXComponentPlugin = async (ctx: any) => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (\n      _input: { platform: \"tui\" | \"desktop\"; version: string },\n      output: {\n        widgets?: WidgetDefinition[]\n      },\n    ) => {\n      output.widgets = [\n        {\n          id: \"click-counter\",\n          label: \"Click Counter Widget\",\n          sidebarPosition: \"top\",\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"colored-stars\",\n          label: \"Colored Stars Widget\",\n          sidebarPosition: \"top\",\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (\n      input: {\n        componentId: string\n        context: Record<string, any>\n      },\n      output: {\n        content?: string\n        component?: any\n        type?: \"text\" | \"markdown\" | \"ansi\" | \"html\" | \"component\"\n        error?: string\n      },\n    ) => {\n      const { componentId, context } = input\n\n      // Example 1: Interactive click counter with state\n      if (componentId === \"click-counter\") {\n        const [count, setCount] = createSignal(0)\n\n        output.component = (\n          <box flexDirection=\"column\" gap={1}>\n            <text attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>Click Counter Demo</text>\n            <text\n              fg=\"#00FF00\"\n              onMouseUp={() => {\n                setCount(count() + 1)\n              }}",
    "embedding": [

    "content": "/**\n * Sidebar Tabs Plugin\n *\n * Complete implementation of sidebar tabs (Tools, Todos, Files) as a plugin\n */\n\n/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */\n\nimport { createSignal, createMemo, For, Show, onMount, TextAttributes } from \"../../src/plugin-ui\"\n\ntype TabType = \"files\" | \"todos\" | \"tools\"\n\nexport const SidebarTabsPlugin = async () => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"sidebar-tabs\",\n          label: \"Tabs\",\n          area: \"left\",\n          position: \"middle\",\n          collapsible: false,\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n      if (input.componentId === \"sidebar-tabs\") {\n        const {\n          client,\n          sessionID,\n          theme,\n          renderer,\n          sdk,\n          toast,\n          dialog,\n          navigate,\n          sync,\n          session,\n          todo,\n          toolsUsed,\n          projectFavorites,\n          globalFavorites,\n          setProjectFavorites,\n          setGlobalFavorites,\n          uiExtensions,\n        } = input.context\n\n        const SidebarTabs = () => {\n          const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = createSignal<TabType>(\"tools\")\n          const [selectedFiles, setSelectedFiles] = createSignal<Set<string>>(new Set())\n          const [committedFiles, setCommittedFiles] = createSignal<Set<string>>(new Set())\n\n          const getFavoriteLevel = (toolId: string): \"none\" | \"project\" | \"global\" => {\n            if (globalFavorites().has(toolId)) return \"global\"\n            if (projectFavorites().has(toolId)) return \"project\"\n            return \"none\"\n          }\n\n          const cycleFavorite = async (toolId: string) => {\n            try {\n              const response = await fetch(`${sdk.url}/favorite-tools/cycle`, {\n                method: \"POST\",\n                headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n                body: JSON.stringify({ toolId }),\n              })\n\n              c",

    "id": "src/cli/bootstrap.ts",
    "content": "import { InstanceBootstrap } from \"../project/bootstrap\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\n\nexport async function bootstrap<T>(directory: string, cb: () => Promise<T>) {\n  return Instance.provide({\n    directory,\n    init: InstanceBootstrap,\n    fn: async () => {\n      try {\n        const result = await cb()\n        return result\n      } finally {\n        await Instance.dispose()\n      }\n    },\n  })\n}\n",

    "content": "data) return true\n            const serverIds = new Set(Object.values(LSPServer).map((s) => s.id))\n\n            return Object.entries(data).every(([id, config]) => {\n     "content": " not exist`,\n                  },\n                  { cause: error },\n                )\n              }\n              throw new InvalidError({ path: configFilepath, message: errMsg }, { cause: error })\n            })\n        ).trim()\n        // escape newlines/quotes, strip outer quotes\n        text = text.replace(match, JSON.stringify(fileContent).slice(1, -1))\n      }\n    }\n\n    const errors: JsoncParseError[] = []\n    const data = parseJsonc(text, errors, { allowTrailingComma: true })\n    if (errors.length) {\n      const lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n      const errorDetails = errors\n        .map((e) => {\n          const beforeOffset = text.substring(0, e.offset).split(\"\\n\")\n          const line = beforeOffset.length\n          const column = beforeOffset[beforeOffset.length - 1].length + 1\n          const problemLine = lines[line - 1]\n\n          const error = `${printParseErrorCode(e.error)} at line ${line}, column ${column}`\n          if (!problemLine) return error\n\n          return `${error}\\n   Line ${line}: ${problemLine}\\n${\"\".padStart(column + 9)}^`\n        })\n        .join(\"\\n\")\n\n      throw new JsonError({\n        path: configFilepath,\n        message: `\\n--- JSONC Input ---\\n${text}\\n--- Errors ---\\n${errorDetails}\\n--- End ---`,\n      })\n    }\n\n    const parsed = Info.safeParse(data)\n    if (parsed.success) {\n      if (!parsed.data.$schema) {\n        parsed.data.$schema = \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\"\n        await Bun.write(configFilepath, JSON.stringify(parsed.data, null, 2))\n      }\n      const data = parsed.data\n      if (data.plugin) {\n        for (let i = 0; i < data.plugin.length; i++) {\n          const plugin = data.plugin[i]\n          try {\n            data.plugin[i] = import.meta.resolve!(plugin, configFilepath)\n          } catch (err) {}\n        }\n      }\n      return data\n    }\n\n    throw new InvalidError({\n      path: configFilepath,\n      issues: parsed.error.issues,\n    })\n  }\n  export const JsonError = NamedError.create(\n    \"ConfigJsonEr",

    "content": "/**\n * Minimal Test Plugin - No Canvas components\n */\n\n// CRITICAL: Import JSX runtime for OpenTUI\n/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */\n\nexport const MinimalPlugin = async () => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (_input: any, output: any) => {\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"test-minimal\",\n          label: \"Test\",\n          icon: \"🧪\",\n          area: \"left\",\n          position: \"top\",\n          collapsible: true,\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n      if (input.componentId === \"test-minimal\") {\n        const TestPanel = () => {\n          return <text fg=\"#00ff00\">✓ Minimal plugin works!</text>\n        }\n\n        output.component = TestPanel\n        output.type = \"component\"\n      }\n    },\n  }\n}\n\nexport default MinimalPlugin\n",

    "content": "import { simpleGit } from \"simple-git\"\nimport { Branch } from \"./branch\"\nimport { Worktree } from \"./worktree\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { UI } from \"../cli/ui\"\n\nexport namespace Parallel {\n  export type Config = {\n    enabled: boolean\n    existingBranch?: string\n    prompt: string\n    workspace: string\n  }\n\n  export type Result = {\n    worktreePath: string\n    branchName: string\n    originalBranch: string\n    repoPath: string\n    cleanup: () => Promise<void>\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate that the given path is a git repository\n   */\n  export async function validateGitRepo(repoPath: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    try {\n      await git.status()\n      return true\n    } catch {\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Setup parallel mode: create worktree and branch\n   */\n  export async function setup(config: Config): Promise<Result> {\n    const { workspace, existingBranch, prompt } = config\n\n    // Validate git repository\n    const isGitRepo = await validateGitRepo(workspace)\n    if (!isGitRepo) {\n      throw new Error(\"Current directory is not a git repository\")\n    }\n\n    // Get original branch for later reference\n    const originalBranch = await Branch.getCurrentBranch(workspace)\n\n    // Determine branch name and strategy\n    const branchName = existingBranch || Branch.generateName(prompt)\n    const isNewBranch = !existingBranch\n\n    // Validate existing branch if specified\n    if (existingBranch) {\n      await Branch.validate(existingBranch, workspace)\n    }\n\n    // Create worktree\n    Log.Default.info(\"parallel:setup:start\", {\n      branchName,\n      isNewBranch,\n      originalBranch,\n    })\n\n    const worktreePath = await Worktree.create(workspace, branchName, isNewBranch)\n\n    Log.Default.info(\"parallel:setup:complete\", {\n      branchName,\n      worktreePath,\n    })\n\n    // Create     "content": "       }),\n        validator(\n          \"param\",\n          z.object({\n            id: z.string().meta({ description: \"Session ID\" }),\n          }),\n        ),\n        validator(\n          \"query\",\n          z.object({\n            limit: z.coerce\n              .number()\n              .optional()\n              .meta({ description: \"Maximum number of messages to return\" }),\n            offset: z.coerce\n              .number()\n              .optional()\n              .meta({ description: \"Number of messages to skip\" }),\n          }),\n        ),\n        async (c) => {\n          const { id } = c.req.valid(\"param\")\n          const { limit, offset } = c.req.valid(\"query\")\n          const messages = await Session.messages({ sessionID: id, limit, offset })\n          return c.json(messages)\n        },\n      )\n      .get(\n        \"/session/:id/message/recent\",\n        describeRoute({\n          description: \"Get recent messages for a session (optimized for faster loading)\",\n          operationId: \"session.messages.recent\",\n          responses: {\n            200: {\n              description: \"List of recent messages\",\n              content: {\n                \"application/json\": {\n                  schema: resolver(MessageV2.WithParts.array()),\n                },\n              },\n            },\n            ...errors(400, 404),\n          },\n        }),\n        validator(\n          \"param\",\n          z.object({\n            id: z.string().meta({ description: \"Session ID\" }),\n          }),\n        ),\n        validator(\n          \"query\",\n          z.object({\n            count: z.coerce\n              .number()\n              .default(50)\n              .meta({ description: \"Number of recent messages to return\" }),\n          }),\n        ),\n        async (c) => {\n          const { id } = c.req.valid(\"param\")\n          const { count } = c.req.valid(\"query\")\n          const messages = await Session.messagesRecent({ sessionID: id, count })\n          return c.json(messages)\n        },\n      )\n ",

z.string().meta({ description: \"Service name for the log entry\" }),\n            level: z.enum([\"debug\", \"info\", \"error\", \"warn\"]).meta({ description: \"Log level\" }),\n            message: z.string().meta({ description: \"Log message\" }),\n            extra: z\n              .record(z.string(), z.any())\n              .optional()\n              .meta({ description: \"Additional metadata for the log entry\" }),\n          }),\n        ),\n        async (c) => {\n          const { service, level, message, extra } = c.req.valid(\"json\")\n          const logger = Log.create({ service })\n\n          switch (level) {\n            case \"debug\":\n              logger.debug(message, extra)\n              break\n            case \"info\":\n              logger.info(message, extra)\n              break\n            case \"error\":\n              logger.error(message, extra)\n              break\n            case \"warn\":\n              logger.warn(message, extra)\n     "id": "src/server/tui.ts",
    "content": "import { Hono, type Context } from \"hono\"\nimport { describeRoute, resolver, validator } from \"hono-openapi\"\nimport { z } from \"zod\"\nimport { AsyncQueue } from \"../util/queue\"\n\nconst TuiRequest = z.object({\n  path: z.string(),\n  body: z.any(),\n})\n\ntype TuiRequest = z.infer<typeof TuiRequest>\n\nconst request = new AsyncQueue<TuiRequest>()\nconst response = new AsyncQueue<any>()\n\nexport async function callTui(ctx: Context) {\n  const body = await ctx.req.json()\n  request.push({\n    path: ctx.req.path,\n    body,\n  })\n  return response.next()\n}\n\nexport const TuiRoute = new Hono()\n  .get(\n    \"/next\",\n    describeRoute({\n      description: \"Get the next TUI request from the queue\",\n      operationId: \"tui.control.next\",\n      responses: {\n        200: {\n          description: \"Next TUI request\",\n          content: {\n            \"application/json\": {\n              schema: resolver(TuiRequest),\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    async (c) => {\n      const req = await request.next()\n      return c.json(req)\n    },\n  )\n  .post(\n    \"/response\",\n    describeRoute({\n      description: \"Submit a response to the TUI request queue\",\n      operationId: \"tui.control.response\",\n      responses: {\n        200: {\n          description: \"Response submitted successfully\",\n          content: {\n            \"application/json\": {\n              schema: resolver(z.boolean()),\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    validator(\"json\", z.any()),\n    async (c) => {\n      const body = c.req.valid(\"json\")\n      response.push(body)\n      return c.json(true)\n    },\n  )\n",

    "id": "src/server/project.ts",
    "content": "import { Hono } from \"hono\"\nimport { describeRoute } from \"hono-openapi\"\nimport { resolver } from \"hono-openapi\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { Project } from \"../project/project\"\n\nexport const ProjectRoute = new Hono()\n  .get(\n    \"/\",\n    describeRoute({\n      description: \"List all projects\",\n      operationId: \"project.list\",\n      responses: {\n        200: {\n          description: \"List of projects\",\n          content: {\n            \"application/json\": {\n              schema: resolver(Project.Info.array()),\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    async (c) => {\n      const projects = await Project.list()\n      return c.json(projects)\n    },\n  )\n  .get(\n    \"/current\",\n    describeRoute({\n      description: \"Get the current project\",\n      operationId: \"project.current\",\n      responses: {\n        200: {\n          description: \"Current project\",\n          content: {\n            \"application/json\": {\n              schema: resolver(Project.Info),\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    async (c) => {\n      return c.json(Instance.project)\n    },\n  )\n",

async function track() {\n    if (Instance.project.vcs !== \"git\") return\n    const cfg = await Config.get()\n    if (cfg.snapshot === false) return\n    const git = gitdir()\n    if (await fs.mkdir(git, { recursive: true })) {\n      await $`git init`\n        .env({\n          ...process.env,\n          GIT_DIR: git,\n          GIT_WORK_TREE: Instance.worktree,\n        })\n        .quiet()\n        .nothrow()\n      log.info(\"initialized\")\n    }\n    await $`git --git-dir ${git} add .`.quiet().cwd(Instance.directory).nothrow()\n    const hash = await $`git --git-dir ${git} write-tree`.quiet().cwd(Instance.directory).nothrow().text()\n    log.info(\"tracking\", { hash, cwd: Instance.directory, git })\n    return hash.trim()\n  }\n\n  export const Patch = z.object({\n    hash: z.string(),\n    files: z.string().array(),\n  })\n  export type Patch = z.infer<typeof Patch>\n\n  export async function patch(hash: string): Promise<Patch> {\n    const git = gitdir()\n    await $`git --git-dir ${git} add .`.quiet().cwd(Instance.directory).nothrow()\n    const result = await $`git --git-dir ${git} diff --name-only ${hash} -- .`.quiet().cwd(Instance.directory).nothrow()\n\n    // If git diff fails, return empty patch\n    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {\n      log.warn(\"failed to get diff\", { hash, exitCode: result.exitCode })\n      return { hash, files: [] }\n    }\n\n    const files = result.text()\n    return {\n      hash,\n      files: files\n        .trim()\n        .split(\"\\n\")\n        .map((x) => x.trim())\n     "id": "src/config/markdown.ts",
    "content": "import { NamedError } from \"@/util/error\"\nimport matter from \"gray-matter\"\nimport { z } from \"zod\"\n\nexport namespace ConfigMarkdown {\n  export const FILE_REGEX = /(?<![\\w`])@(\\.?[^\\s`,.]*(?:\\.[^\\s`,.]+)*)/g\n  export const SHELL_REGEX = /!`([^`]+)`/g\n\n  export function files(template: string) {\n    return Array.from(template.matchAll(FILE_REGEX))\n  }\n\n  export function shell(template: string) {\n    return Array.from(template.matchAll(SHELL_REGEX))\n  }\n\n  export async function parse(filePath: string) {\n    const template = await Bun.file(filePath).text()\n\n    try {\n      const md = matter(template)\n      return md\n    } catch (err) {\n      throw new FrontmatterError(\n        {\n          path: filePath,\n          message: `Failed to parse YAML frontmatter: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,\n        },\n        { cause: err },\n      )\n    }\n  }\n\n  export const FrontmatterError = NamedError.create(\n    \"ConfigFrontmatterError\",\n    z.object({\n      path: z.string(),\n      message: z.string(),\n    }),\n  )\n}\n",

  {
    "id": "src/cli/error.ts",
    "content": "import { ConfigMarkdown } from \"@/config/markdown\"\nimport { Config } from \"../config/config\"\nimport { MCP } from \"../mcp\"\nimport { UI } from \"./ui\"\n\nexport function FormatError(input: unknown) {\n  if (MCP.Failed.isInstance(input))\n    return `MCP server \"${input.data.name}\" failed. Note, opencode does not support MCP authentication yet.`\n  if (Config.JsonError.isInstance(input)) {\n    return (\n      `Config file at ${input.data.path} is not valid JSON(C)` +\n      (input.data.message ? `: ${input.data.message}` : \"\")\n    )\n  }\n  if (Config.ConfigDirectoryTypoError.isInstance(input)) {\n    return `Directory \"${input.data.dir}\" in ${input.data.path} is not valid. Use \"${input.data.suggestion}\" instead. This is a common typo.`\n  }\n  if (ConfigMarkdown.FrontmatterError.isInstance(input)) {\n    return `Failed to parse frontmatter in ${input.data.path}:\\n${input.data.message}`\n  }\n  if (Config.InvalidError.isInstance(input))\n    return [\n      `Config file at ${input.data.path} is invalid` +\n        (input.data.message ? `: ${input.data.message}` : \"\"),\n      ...(input.data.issues?.map((issue) => \"↳ \" + issue.message + \" \" + issue.path.join(\".\")) ??\n        []),\n    ].join(\"\\n\")\n\n  if (UI.CancelledError.isInstance(input)) return \"\"\n}\n",

    "content": "import { Bus } from \"@/bus\"\nimport { Config } from \"@/config/config\"\nimport { Flag } from \"@/flag/flag\"\nimport { Installation } from \"@/installation\"\n\nexport async function upgrade() {\n  const config = await Config.global()\n  if (config.autoupdate === false || Flag.OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE) return\n  const latest = await Installation.latest().catch(() => {})\n  if (!latest) return\n  if (Installation.VERSION === latest) return\n  const method = await Installation.method()\n  if (method === \"unknown\") return\n  await Installation.upgrade(method, latest)\n    .then(() => Bus.publish(Installation.Event.Updated, { version: latest }))\n    .catch(() => {})\n}\n",

    "content": "/**\n * Subagents Plugin\n *\n * Displays child sessions (subagents) with their status and provides navigation\n */\n\n/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */\n\nimport { createSignal, onMount, onCleanup, For, Show } from \"../../src/plugin-ui\"\n\nexport const SubagentsPlugin = async () => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (_input: any, output: any) => {\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"subagents-panel\",\n          label: \"Subagents\",\n          icon: \"🤖\",\n          area: \"left\",\n          position: \"bottom\",\n          collapsible: true,\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (input: any, output: any) => {\n      if (input.componentId === \"subagents-panel\") {\n        const { sessionID, theme, renderer, navigate, sdk } = input.context\n\n        const SubagentsPanel = () => {\n          const [childSessions, setChildSessions] = createSignal<any[]>([])\n\n          const loadChildSessions = async () => {\n            try {\n              const response = await fetch(`${sdk.url}/session/${sessionID}/children`)\n              if (response.ok) {\n                const children = await response.json()\n                setChildSessions(children || [])\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              console.error(\"[SubagentsPanel] Failed to load child sessions:\", error)\n            }\n          }\n\n          onMount(() => {\n            loadChildSessions()\n            // Poll for updates every 2 seconds\n            const interval = setInterval(loadChildSessions, 2000)\n            onCleanup(() => clearInterval(interval))\n          })\n\n          return (\n            <Show\n              when={childSessions().length > 0}\n              fallback={\n                <text fg={theme.textMuted} marginTop={1}>\n                  No active subagents\n                </text>\n              }\n            >\n              <box flexDirection=\"column\" gap={0} marginTop={1}>\n                <For each={childSessions()}>\n                  {(child) => {\n                    const stat",

    "content": "import { simpleGit } from \"simple-git\"\nimport { tmpdir } from \"os\"\nimport path from \"path\"\n\nexport namespace Worktree {\n  export type Info = {\n    path: string\n    branch: string\n    head: string\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate a worktree path in the system temp directory\n   */\n  export function generatePath(branchName: string): string {\n    return path.join(tmpdir(), `opencode-worktree-${branchName}`)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a new git worktree\n   */\n  export async function create(\n    repoPath: string,\n    branchName: string,\n    isNewBranch: boolean,\n  ): Promise<string> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    const worktreePath = generatePath(branchName)\n\n    try {\n      if (isNewBranch) {\n        // Create new branch and worktree\n        await git.raw([\"worktree\", \"add\", \"-b\", branchName, worktreePath])\n      } else {\n        // Use existing branch\n        await git.raw([\"worktree\", \"add\", worktreePath, branchName])\n      }\n      return worktreePath\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error) {\n        if (error.message.includes(\"already exists\")) {\n          throw new Error(\n            `Worktree already exists at ${worktreePath}. Clean it up with: git worktree remove ${worktreePath}`,\n          )\n        }\n        throw new Error(`Failed to create worktree: ${error.message}`)\n      }\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Remove a git worktree\n   */\n  export async function remove(repoPath: string, worktreePath: string): Promise<void> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    try {\n      await git.raw([\"worktree\", \"remove\", worktreePath, \"--force\"])\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error) {\n        throw new Error(`Failed to remove worktree: ${error.message}`)\n      }\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List all git worktrees\n   */\n  export async function list(repoPath: string): Promise<Info[]> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    try {\n      const output = await git.raw([\"worktree\", \"list\", \"--porcelain\"])\n      return parseWork",

    "id": "src/parallel/branch.ts",
    "content": "import { simpleGit } from \"simple-git\"\n\nexport namespace Branch {\n  /**\n   * Generate a branch name from a prompt string\n   * Format: {sanitized-prompt}-{timestamp}\n   */\n  export function generateName(prompt: string): string {\n    const sanitized = prompt\n      .slice(0, 50)\n      .toLowerCase()\n      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, \"-\")\n      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, \"\")\n      .replace(/-+/g, \"-\")\n\n    const timestamp = Date.now()\n    return `${sanitized || \"opencode\"}-${timestamp}`\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if a branch exists locally\n   */\n  export async function exists(branchName: string, repoPath: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    try {\n      const branches = await git.branchLocal()\n      return branches.all.includes(branchName)\n    } catch {\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the current branch name\n   */\n  export async function getCurrentBranch(repoPath: string): Promise<string> {\n    const git = simpleGit(repoPath)\n    const branch = await git.branch()\n    return branch.current\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate that a branch exists, throw error if not\n   */\n  export async function validate(branchName: string, repoPath: string): Promise<void> {\n    const branchExists = await exists(branchName, repoPath)\n    if (!branchExists) {\n      throw new Error(`Branch \"${branchName}\" does not exist`)\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

    "id": "examples/plugin-ui-demo/index.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Example UI Plugin for OpenCode\n *\n * Demonstrates how to:\n * - Register widgets in the sidebar\n * - Register panels\n * - Register keybinds\n * - Render dynamic content\n */\n\nimport type { Plugin } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\nimport type {\n  WidgetDefinition,\n  PanelDefinition,\n  KeybindDefinition,\n  StatusItemDefinition,\n  CommandDefinition,\n} from \"../../src/ui/types\"\n\nexport const ExampleUIPlugin: Plugin = async (_ctx) => {\n  // Track some simple state\n  let counter = 0\n  let lastSessionId: string | undefined\n\n  return {\n    // Register UI extensions\n    \"ui.register\": async (\n      input: { platform: \"tui\" | \"desktop\"; version: string },\n      output: {\n        widgets?: WidgetDefinition[]\n        panels?: PanelDefinition[]\n        keybinds?: KeybindDefinition[]\n        statusItems?: StatusItemDefinition[]\n        commands?: CommandDefinition[]\n      },\n    ) => {\n      // Register a widget in the sidebar\n      output.widgets = [\n        {\n          id: \"example-counter-widget\",\n          label: \"Counter Widget\",\n          position: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n          size: { width: 100, height: 50 },\n        },\n      ]\n\n      // Register a panel\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"example-info-panel\",\n          label: \"Example Info\",\n          area: \"right\",\n          collapsible: true,\n        },\n      ]\n\n      // Register a keybind\n      output.keybinds = [\n        {\n          id: \"example-increment\",\n          keys: \"ctrl+shift+i\",\n          command: \"example.increment\",\n          when: undefined,\n        },\n      ]\n\n      // Register status items\n      output.statusItems = [\n        {\n          id: \"example-status\",\n          priority: 100,\n          alignment: \"right\",\n        },\n      ]\n\n      // Register commands\n      output.commands = [\n        {\n          id: \"example.increment\",\n          label: \"Increment Counter\",\n          description: \"Increments the example plugin counter\",\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    // Render UI component content\n    ",

    "content": "import z from \"zod\"\nimport type { ZodType } from \"zod\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\n\nexport namespace Bus {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"bus\" })\n  type Subscription = (event: any) => void\n\n  const state = Instance.state(() => {\n    const subscriptions = new Map<any, Subscription[]>()\n\n    return {\n      subscriptions,\n    }\n  })\n\n  export type EventDefinition = ReturnType<typeof event>\n\n  const registry = new Map<string, EventDefinition>()\n\n  export function event<Type extends string, Properties extends ZodType>(type: Type, properties: Properties) {\n    const result = {\n      type,\n      properties,\n    }\n    registry.set(type, result)\n    return result\n  }\n\n  export function payloads() {\n    return z.discriminatedUnion(\n      \"type\",\n      registry\n        .entries()\n        .map(([type, def]) => {\n          return z\n            .object({\n              type: z.literal(type),\n              properties: def.properties,\n            })\n            .meta({\n              ref: \"Event\" + \".\" + def.type,\n            })\n        })\n        .toArray() as any,\n    )\n  }\n\n  export async function publish<Definition extends EventDefinition>(\n    def: Definition,\n    properties: z.output<Definition[\"properties\"]>,\n  ) {\n    const payload = {\n      type: def.type,\n      properties,\n    }\n    log.info(\"publishing\", {\n      type: def.type,\n    })\n    const pending = []\n    for (const key of [def.type, \"*\"]) {\n      const match = state().subscriptions.get(key)\n      for (const sub of match ?? []) {\n        pending.push(sub(payload))\n      }\n    }\n    return Promise.all(pending)\n  }\n\n  export function subscribe<Definition extends EventDefinition>(\n    def: Definition,\n    callback: (event: { type: Definition[\"type\"]; properties: z.infer<Definition[\"properties\"]> }) => void,\n  ) {\n    return raw(def.type, callback)\n  }\n\n  export function once<Definition extends EventDefinition>(\n    def: Definition,\n    callback: (event: {\n      ",

    "content": "import { describe, test, expect } from \"bun:test\"\nimport { Keybind } from \"../src/util/keybind\"\n\ndescribe(\"Keybind.toString\", () => {\n  test(\"should convert simple key to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: false, meta: false, shift: false, leader: false, name: \"f\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"f\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert ctrl modifier to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: true, meta: false, shift: false, leader: false, name: \"x\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"ctrl+x\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert leader key to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: false, meta: false, shift: false, leader: true, name: \"f\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"<leader> f\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert multiple modifiers to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: true, meta: true, shift: false, leader: false, name: \"g\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"ctrl+alt+g\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert all modifiers to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: true, meta: true, shift: true, leader: true, name: \"h\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"<leader> ctrl+alt+shift+h\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert shift modifier to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = {\n      ctrl: false,\n      meta: false,\n      shift: true,\n      leader: false,\n      name: \"return\",\n    }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"shift+return\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert function key to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = { ctrl: false, meta: false, shift: false, leader: false, name: \"f2\" }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"f2\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should convert special key to string\", () => {\n    const info: Keybind.Info = {\n      ctrl: false,\n      meta: false,\n      shift: false,\n      leader: false,\n      name: \"pgup\",\n    }\n    expect(Keybind.toString(info)).toBe(\"pgup\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should handle empty name\", () => {\n     "id": "test/keybind.test.ts [chunk 2/2]",
    "content": "eta: false,\n        shift: false,\n        leader: false,\n        name: \"pgup\",\n      },\n    ])\n  })\n\n  test(\"should handle function keys\", () => {\n    const result = Keybind.parse(\"f2\")\n    expect(result).toEqual([\n      {\n        ctrl: false,\n        meta: false,\n        shift: false,\n        leader: false,\n        name: \"f2\",\n      },\n    ])\n  })\n\n  test(\"should handle complex multi-modifier combination\", () => {\n    const result = Keybind.parse(\"ctrl+alt+g\")\n    expect(result).toEqual([\n      {\n        ctrl: true,\n        meta: true,\n        shift: false,\n        leader: false,\n        name: \"g\",\n      },\n    ])\n  })\n\n  test(\"should be case insensitive\", () => {\n    const result = Keybind.parse(\"CTRL+X\")\n    expect(result).toEqual([\n      {\n        ctrl: true,\n        meta: false,\n        shift: false,\n        leader: false,\n        name: \"x\",\n      },\n    ])\n  })\n})\n",

    "id": "test/session/session.test.ts",
    "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\"\nimport path from \"path\"\nimport { Session } from \"../../src/session\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../../src/bus\"\nimport { Log } from \"../../src/util/log\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../../src/project/instance\"\n\nconst projectRoot = path.join(__dirname, \"../..\")\nLog.init({ print: false })\n\ndescribe(\"session.started event\", () => {\n  test(\"should emit session.started event when session is created\", async () => {\n    await Instance.provide({\n      directory: projectRoot,\n      fn: async () => {\n        let eventReceived = false\n        let receivedInfo: Session.Info | undefined\n\n        const unsub = Bus.subscribe(Session.Event.Created, (event) => {\n          eventReceived = true\n          receivedInfo = event.properties.info as Session.Info\n        })\n\n        const session = await Session.create({})\n\n        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100))\n\n        unsub()\n\n        expect(eventReceived).toBe(true)\n        expect(receivedInfo).toBeDefined()\n        expect(receivedInfo?.id).toBe(session.id)\n        expect(receivedInfo?.projectID).toBe(session.projectID)\n        expect(receivedInfo?.directory).toBe(session.directory)\n        expect(receivedInfo?.title).toBe(session.title)\n\n        await Session.remove(session.id)\n      },\n    })\n  })\n\n  test(\"session.started event should be emitted before session.updated\", async () => {\n    await Instance.provide({\n      directory: projectRoot,\n      fn: async () => {\n        const events: string[] = []\n\n        const unsubStarted = Bus.subscribe(Session.Event.Created, () => {\n          events.push(\"started\")\n        })\n\n        const unsubUpdated = Bus.subscribe(Session.Event.Updated, () => {\n          events.push(\"updated\")\n        })\n\n        const session = await Session.create({})\n\n        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100))\n\n        unsubStarted()\n        unsubUpdated()\n\n        expect(events).toContain(\"started\")\n        expect(events).toContain(\"",

  {
    "id": "test/session/retry.test.ts",
    "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\"\nimport { SessionRetry } from \"../../src/session/retry\"\nimport { MessageV2 } from \"../../src/session/message-v2\"\n\nfunction apiError(headers?: Record<string, string>): MessageV2.APIError {\n  return new MessageV2.APIError({\n    message: \"boom\",\n    isRetryable: true,\n    responseHeaders: headers,\n  }).toObject() as MessageV2.APIError\n}\n\ndescribe(\"session.retry.getRetryDelayInMs\", () => {\n  test(\"doubles delay on each attempt when headers missing\", () => {\n    const error = apiError()\n    const delays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, index + 1))\n    expect(delays).toStrictEqual([2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 32000, 64000, 128000])\n  })\n\n  test(\"prefers retry-after-ms when shorter than exponential\", () => {\n    const error = apiError({ \"retry-after-ms\": \"1500\" })\n    expect(SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, 4)).toBe(1500)\n  })\n\n  test(\"uses retry-after seconds when reasonable\", () => {\n    const error = apiError({ \"retry-after\": \"30\" })\n    expect(SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, 3)).toBe(30000)\n  })\n\n  test(\"falls back to exponential when server delay is long\", () => {\n    const error = apiError({ \"retry-after\": \"120\" })\n    expect(SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, 2)).toBe(4000)\n  })\n\n  test(\"accepts http-date retry-after values\", () => {\n    const date = new Date(Date.now() + 20000).toUTCString()\n    const error = apiError({ \"retry-after\": date })\n    const delay = SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, 1)\n    expect(delay).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(19000)\n    expect(delay).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20000)\n  })\n\n  test(\"ignores invalid retry hints\", () => {\n    const error = apiError({ \"retry-after\": \"not-a-number\" })\n    expect(SessionRetry.getRetryDelayInMs(error, 1)).toBe(2000)\n  })\n})\n",

    "id": "test/bun.test.ts",
    "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\"\nimport fs from \"fs/promises\"\nimport path from \"path\"\n\ndescribe(\"BunProc registry configuration\", () => {\n  test(\"should not contain hardcoded registry parameters\", async () => {\n    // Read the bun/index.ts file\n    const bunIndexPath = path.join(__dirname, \"../src/bun/index.ts\")\n    const content = await fs.readFile(bunIndexPath, \"utf-8\")\n\n    // Verify that no hardcoded registry is present\n    expect(content).not.toContain(\"--registry=\")\n    expect(content).not.toContain(\"hasNpmRcConfig\")\n    expect(content).not.toContain(\"NpmRc\")\n  })\n\n  test(\"should use Bun's default registry resolution\", async () => {\n    // Read the bun/index.ts file\n    const bunIndexPath = path.join(__dirname, \"../src/bun/index.ts\")\n    const content = await fs.readFile(bunIndexPath, \"utf-8\")\n\n    // Verify that it uses Bun's default resolution\n     "id": "examples/plugin-sidebar-ui/index.ts",
    "content": "/**\n * Sidebar UI Plugin for OpenCode\n *\n * Provides the core sidebar UI components:\n * - Server status widget (top)\n * - Context bar widget (top)\n * - Main tabbed interface panel (inline/bottom)\n */\n\nimport type { Plugin } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\nimport type { WidgetDefinition, PanelDefinition } from \"../../src/ui/types\"\n\nexport const SidebarUIPlugin = async (_ctx: any) => {\n  let activeTab: \"tools\" | \"todos\" | \"files\" = \"tools\"\n\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (\n      _input: { platform: \"tui\" | \"desktop\"; version: string },\n      output: {\n        widgets?: WidgetDefinition[]\n        panels?: PanelDefinition[]\n      },\n    ) => {\n      output.widgets = [\n        {\n          id: \"server-status\",\n          label: \"Server Status\",\n          sidebarPosition: \"top\",\n        },\n        {\n          id: \"context-bar\",\n          label: \"Context\",\n          sidebarPosition: \"top\",\n        },\n      ]\n\n      output.panels = [\n        {\n          id: \"main-tabs\",\n          label: \"Main Tabs\",\n          area: \"left\",\n          position: \"bottom\",\n        },\n      ]\n    },\n\n    \"ui.render\": async (\n      input: {\n        componentId: string\n        context: Record<string, any>\n      },\n      output: {\n        content?: string\n        type?: \"text\" | \"markdown\" | \"ansi\" | \"html\"\n        props?: Record<string, any>\n        hidden?: boolean\n        error?: string\n      },\n    ) => {\n      const { componentId, context } = input\n\n      if (componentId === \"server-status\") {\n        const port = context.serverUrl?.split(\":\").pop() || \"unknown\"\n        const status = context.serverStatus || \"connected\"\n        const statusIcon = status === \"connected\" ? \"●\" : \"○\"\n\n        output.content = `${statusIcon} server:${port}`\n        output.type = \"text\"\n      } else if (componentId === \"context-bar\") {\n        const tokens = context.tokens || 0\n        const tokenLimit = context.tokenLimit || 0\n        const percentage = context.percentage || 0\n        const cost = context.cost || \"$",

    "content": "import path from \"path\"\nimport { $ } from \"bun\"\nimport z from \"zod\"\nimport { NamedError } from \"../util/error\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\n\ndeclare global {\n  const OPENCODE_VERSION: string\n  const OPENCODE_CHANNEL: string\n}\n\nexport namespace Installation {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"installation\" })\n\n  export type Method = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof method>>\n\n  export const Event = {\n    Updated: Bus.event(\n      \"installation.updated\",\n      z.object({\n        version: z.string(),\n      }),\n    ),\n  }\n\n  export const Info = z\n    .object({\n      version: z.string(),\n      latest: z.string(),\n    })\n    .meta({\n      ref: \"InstallationInfo\",\n    })\n  export type Info = z.infer<typeof Info>\n\n  export async function info() {\n    return {\n      version: VERSION,\n      latest: await latest(),\n    }\n  }\n\n  export function isPreview() {\n    return CHANNEL !== \"latest\"\n  }\n\n  export function isLocal() {\n    return CHANNEL === \"local\"\n  }\n\n  export async function method() {\n    if (process.execPath.includes(path.join(\".opencode\", \"bin\"))) return \"curl\"\n    if (process.execPath.includes(path.join(\".local\", \"bin\"))) return \"curl\"\n    const exec = process.execPath.toLowerCase()\n\n    const checks = [\n      {\n        name: \"npm\" as const,\n        command: () => $`npm list -g --depth=0`.throws(false).text(),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"yarn\" as const,\n        command: () => $`yarn global list`.throws(false).text(),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"pnpm\" as const,\n        command: () => $`pnpm list -g --depth=0`.throws(false).text(),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"bun\" as const,\n        command: () => $`bun pm ls -g`.throws(false).text(),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"brew\" as const,\n        command: () => $`brew list --formula opencode`.throws(false).text(),\n      },\n    ]\n\n    checks.sort((a, b) => {\n      const aMatches = exec.includes(a.name)\n      const bMatches = exec.includes(b.name)\n      if (aMatches && !bMatches) return ",

UISubscriptions,\n} from \"./types\"\nimport { Plugin } from \"../plugin\"\nimport { Instance } from \"../project/instance\"\nimport { Log } from \"../util/log\"\nimport { Bus } from \"../bus\"\nimport { Server } from \"../server/server\"\nimport { createOpencodeClient } from \"@opencode-ai/sdk\"\n\nexport namespace UIRegistry {\n  const log = Log.create({ service: \"ui-registry\" })\n\n  interface UIExtension {\n    pluginId: string\n    plugin: any // Store reference to plugin for event handling\n    sidebars: SidebarDefinition[]\n    panels: PanelDefinition[]\n    tabs: TabDefinition[]\n    widgets: WidgetDefinition[]\n    keybinds: KeybindDefinition[]\n    statusItems: StatusItemDefinition[]\n    commands: CommandDefinition[]\n    subscriptions?: UISubscriptions\n  }\n\n  const state = Instance.state(async () => {\n    const extensions: UIExtension[] = []\n    const appFetch = Server.App().fetch as any\n    const client = createOpencodeClient({\n      baseUrl: \"http://localhost:4096\",\n      fetch: appFetch,\n    })\n\n    const plugins = await Plugin.list()\n    for (const plugin of plugins) {\n      const uiRegister = (plugin as any)[\"ui.register\"] as UIHooks[\"ui.register\"]\n      if (!uiRegister) continue\n\n      const output: {\n        sidebars?: SidebarDefinition[]\n        panels?: PanelDefinition[]\n        tabs?: TabDefinition[]\n        widgets?: WidgetDefinition[]\n        keybinds?: KeybindDefinition[]\n        statusItems?: StatusItemDefinition[]\n        commands?: CommandDefinition[]\n        subscriptions?: UISubscriptions\n      } = {}\n\n      try {\n        await uiRegister(\n          {\n            platform: \"tui\",\n            version: \"1.0.0\",\n            client,\n          },\n          output,\n        )\n\n        extensions.push({\n          pluginId: \"unknown\", // TODO: get plugin ID from plugin system\n          plugin, // Store plugin refe",

    "id": "src/ui/types.ts",
    "content": "// UI Component Definitions\nexport interface SidebarDefinition {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  icon?: string\n  position: \"left\" | \"right\"\n  defaultOpen?: boolean\n  keybind?: string\n}\n\nexport interface TabDefinition {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  icon?: string\n  parent: string\n  badge?: () => Promise<number>\n}\n\nexport interface PanelDefinition {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  icon?: string\n  area: \"top\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\" | \"right\"\n  position?: \"top\" | \"bottom\" // Where in the sidebar to render\n  collapsible?: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface WidgetDefinition {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  sidebarPosition?: \"top\" | \"bottom\" | \"inline\" // Where in sidebar to render\n  position?: { x: number; y: number } // For floating widgets\n  size?: { width: number; height: number }\n}\n\nexport interface KeybindDefinition {\n  id: string\n  keys: string\n  command: string\n  when?: string\n}\n\nexport interface StatusItemDefinition {\n  id: string\n  priority: number\n  alignment: \"left\" | \"right\"\n}\n\nexport interface CommandDefinition {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  description?: string\n}\n\n// Subscription configuration for UI plugins\nexport interface UISubscriptions {\n  /**\n   * Bus events to subscribe to (e.g., [\"session.updated\", \"todo.updated\"])\n   */\n  events?: string[]\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to session data changes\n   */\n  session?: boolean\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to sync data updates\n   */\n  sync?: boolean\n}\n\n// UI Plugin Hook Extensions\nexport interface UIHooks {\n  /**\n   * Register UI extensions (sidebars, tabs, panels, keybinds)\n   * Plugins declare what data/events they need via subscriptions\n   */\n  \"ui.register\"?: (\n    input: {\n      platform: \"tui\" | \"desktop\"\n      version: string\n      client: any // OpencodeClient - plugins get SDK access\n    },\n    output: {\n      sidebars?: SidebarDefinition[]\n      panels?: PanelDefinition[]\n      tabs?: TabDefinition[]\n      widgets?: WidgetDefinition[]\n      keybinds?: KeybindDefinition[]\n      statusItems?: StatusItemDefinition[]\n      comma",

    "content": "import { z } from \"zod\"\n\nexport const SidebarSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  label: z.string(),\n  icon: z.string().optional(),\n  position: z.enum([\"left\", \"right\"]),\n  defaultOpen: z.boolean().optional(),\n  keybind: z.string().optional(),\n})\n\nexport const TabSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  label: z.string(),\n  icon: z.string().optional(),\n  parent: z.string(),\n})\n\nexport const PanelSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  label: z.string(),\n  icon: z.string().optional(),\n  area: z.enum([\"top\", \"bottom\", \"left\", \"right\"]),\n  position: z.enum([\"top\", \"bottom\"]).optional(),\n  collapsible: z.boolean().optional(),\n})\n\nexport const WidgetSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  label: z.string(),\n  sidebarPosition: z.enum([\"top\", \"bottom\", \"inline\"]).optional(),\n  position: z\n    .object({\n      x: z.number(),\n      y: z.number(),\n    })\n    .optional(),\n  size: z\n    .object({\n      width: z.number(),\n      height: z.number(),\n    })\n    .optional(),\n})\n\nexport const KeybindSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  keys: z.string(),\n  command: z.string(),\n  when: z.string().optional(),\n})\n\nexport const StatusItemSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  priority: z.number(),\n  alignment: z.enum([\"left\", \"right\"]),\n})\n\nexport const CommandSchema = z.object({\n  id: z.string(),\n  label: z.string(),\n  description: z.string().optional(),\n})\n\nexport const UIExtensionsSchema = z.object({\n  sidebars: z.array(SidebarSchema),\n  tabs: z.array(TabSchema),\n  panels: z.array(PanelSchema),\n  widgets: z.array(WidgetSchema),\n  keybinds: z.array(KeybindSchema),\n  statusItems: z.array(StatusItemSchema),\n  commands: z.array(CommandSchema),\n})\n\nexport const UIRenderRequestSchema = z.object({\n  componentId: z.string(),\n  context: z.record(z.string(), z.any()).optional(),\n})\n\nexport const UIRenderResponseSchema = z.object({\n  content: z.string(),\n  type: z.enum([\"text\", \"markdown\", \"ansi\", \"html\"]),\n  error: z.string().optional(),\n})\n",

    "content": "},\n  })\n  await Instance.provide({\n    directory: tmp.path,\n    fn: async () => {\n      const config = await Config.get()\n      expect(config.agent?.[\"test\"]).toEqual({\n        name: \"test\",\n        model: \"test/model\",\n        prompt: \"Test agent prompt\",\n      })\n    },\n  })\n})\n\ntest(\"updates config and writes to file\", async () => {\n  await using tmp = await tmpdir()\n  await Instance.provide({\n    directory: tmp.path,\n    fn: async () => {\n      const newConfig = { model: \"updated/model\" }\n      await Config.update(newConfig as any)\n\n      const writtenConfig = JSON.parse(await Bun.file(path.join(tmp.path, \"config.json\")).text())\n      expect(writtenConfig.model).toBe(\"updated/model\")\n    },\n  })\n})\n\ntest(\"gets config directories\", async () => {\n  await using tmp = await tmpdir()\n  await Instance.provide({\n    directory: tmp.path,\n    fn: async () => {\n      const dirs = await Config.directories()\n      expect(dirs.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)\n    },\n  })\n})\n\ntest(\"resolves scoped npm plugins in config\", async () => {\n  await using tmp = await tmpdir({\n    init: async (dir) => {\n      const pluginDir = path.join(dir, \"node_modules\", \"@scope\", \"plugin\")\n      await fs.mkdir(pluginDir, { recursive: true })\n\n      await Bun.write(\n        path.join(dir, \"package.json\"),\n        JSON.stringify({ name: \"config-fixture\", version: \"1.0.0\", type: \"module\" }, null, 2),\n      )\n\n      await Bun.write(\n        path.join(pluginDir, \"package.json\"),\n        JSON.stringify(\n          {\n            name: \"@scope/plugin\",\n            version: \"1.0.0\",\n            type: \"module\",\n            main: \"./index.js\",\n          },\n          null,\n          2,\n        ),\n      )\n\n      await Bun.write(path.join(pluginDir, \"index.js\"), \"export default {}\\n\")\n\n      await Bun.write(\n        path.join(dir, \"opencode.json\"),\n        JSON.stringify(\n          { $schema: \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\", plugin: [\"@scope/plugin\"] },\n          null,\n          2,\n        ),\n      )\n    },\n",

    "id": "test/config/markdown.test.ts",
    "content": "import { expect, test } from \"bun:test\"\nimport { ConfigMarkdown } from \"../../src/config/markdown\"\n\nconst template = `This is a @valid/path/to/a/file and it should also match at\nthe beginning of a line:\n\n@another-valid/path/to/a/file\n\nbut this is not:\n\n   - Adds a \"Co-authored-by:\" footer which clarifies which AI agent\n     helped create this commit, using an appropriate \\`noreply@...\\`\n     or \\`noreply@anthropic.com\\` email address.\n\nWe also need to deal with files followed by @commas, ones\nwith @file-extensions.md, even @multiple.extensions.bak,\nhidden directorys like @.config/ or files like @.bashrc\nand ones at the end of a sentence like @foo.md.\n\nAlso shouldn't forget @/absolute/paths.txt with and @/without/extensions,\nas well as @~/home-files and @~/paths/under/home.txt.\n\nIf the reference is \\`@quoted/in/backticks\\` then it shouldn't match at all.`\n\nconst matches = ConfigMarkdown.files(template)\n\ntest(\"should extract exactly 12 file references\", () => {\n  expect(matches.length).toBe(12)\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract valid/path/to/a/file\", () => {\n  expect(matches[0][1]).toBe(\"valid/path/to/a/file\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract another-valid/path/to/a/file\", () => {\n  expect(matches[1][1]).toBe(\"another-valid/path/to/a/file\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract paths ignoring comma after\", () => {\n  expect(matches[2][1]).toBe(\"commas\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract a path with a file extension and comma after\", () => {\n  expect(matches[3][1]).toBe(\"file-extensions.md\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract a path with multiple dots and comma after\", () => {\n  expect(matches[4][1]).toBe(\"multiple.extensions.bak\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract hidden directory\", () => {\n  expect(matches[5][1]).toBe(\".config/\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract hidden file\", () => {\n  expect(matches[6][1]).toBe(\".bashrc\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract a file ignoring period at end of sentence\", () => {\n  expect(matches[7][1]).toBe(\"foo.md\")\n})\n\ntest(\"should extract an absolute path with an extension\", () => {\n  expect(matches[8][1]).toB",

    "id": "examples/plugin-steering-questions/index.tsx [chunk 1/2]",
    "content": "/**\n * Steering Questions Plugin\n *\n * Allows the model to ask interactive steering questions within the message list.\n * Users can select from multiple choice options, provide text input, or both.\n *\n * This enables the model to gather specific requirements before proceeding with implementation.\n *\n * ## Usage in Message Stream\n *\n * The model can display a steering widget by including special text in its response:\n *\n * \`\`\`\n * <steering-question id=\"architecture-choice\">\n * {\n *   \"title\": \"Architecture Decisions\",\n *   \"description\": \"Help me understand your preferences:\",\n *   \"questions\": [\n *     {\n *       \"id\": \"framework\",\n *       \"label\": \"Frontend Framework\",\n *       \"type\": \"single-choice\",\n *       \"options\": [\"React\", \"Vue\", \"Svelte\", \"Vanilla JS\"]\n *     },\n *     {\n *       \"id\": \"styling\",\n *       \"label\": \"Styling Approach\",\n *       \"type\": \"multi-choice\",\n *       \"options\": [\"CSS Modules\", \"Tailwind\", \"Styled Components\", \"SCSS\"]\n *     },\n *     {\n *       \"id\": \"notes\",\n *       \"label\": \"Additional Requirements\",\n *       \"type\": \"text\",\n *       \"placeholder\": \"Any specific requirements or constraints?\"\n *     }\n *   ]\n * }\n * </steering-question>\n * \`\`\`\n */\n\n/** @jsxImportSource @opentui/solid */\n\nimport { createSignal, For, Show, createMemo } from \"../../src/plugin-ui\"\nimport { TextAttributes } from \"../../src/plugin-ui\"\n\nexport interface SteeringQuestion {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  type: \"single-choice\" | \"multi-choice\" | \"text\"\n  options?: string[]\n  placeholder?: string\n  required?: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface SteeringQuestionConfig {\n  title: string\n  description?: string\n  questions: SteeringQuestion[]\n  submitLabel?: string\n}\n\nexport interface SteeringAnswer {\n  questionId: string\n  answer: string | string[]\n}\n\nexport const SteeringQuestionsPlugin = async () => {\n  return {\n    \"ui.register\": async (_input: any, output: any) => {\n      // This plugin doesn't register sidebar widgets, it embeds in message list\n      output.mes",
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Quick script to move the latest screenshot here

# Get the most recent screenshot from Desktop
LATEST=$(ls -t ~/Desktop/Screenshot*.png 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
    echo "No screenshots found on Desktop"
    exit 1
fi

# Get just the filename
FILENAME=$(basename "$LATEST")

# Move it here
mv "$LATEST" "$(dirname "$0")/$FILENAME"

echo "✅ Moved: $FILENAME"
echo "📁 Location: .screenshots/$FILENAME"
echo ""
echo "Tell the AI: 'check .screenshots/$FILENAME'"
```

# .screenshots/drop.sh

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Simple drag-and-drop screenshot handler

echo ""
echo "📸 Screenshot Drop Tool"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo ""
echo "👉 Drag screenshot here and press Enter:"
echo ""
read -r filepath

# Clean the path (remove backslashes, quotes, etc)
filepath=$(echo "$filepath" | sed 's/\\//g' | sed "s/'//g" | sed 's/"//g' | xargs)

if [ -z "$filepath" ]; then
    echo "❌ No file provided"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$filepath" ]; then
    echo "❌ File not found: $filepath"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if it's an image
if ! file "$filepath" | grep -q "image"; then
    echo "⚠️  Warning: This doesn't look like an image file"
fi

# Generate new filename
ext="${filepath##*.}"
timestamp=$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)
newname="screenshot-${timestamp}.${ext}"

# Get the script directory
scriptdir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

# Copy file
cp "$filepath" "$scriptdir/$newname"

echo ""
echo "✅ Saved: $newname"
echo "📁 Location: .screenshots/$newname"
echo ""
echo "💬 Tell the AI:"
echo "   check .screenshots/$newname"
echo ""
echo "📋 Or just paste this:"
echo "   .screenshots/$newname"
echo ""

```

```html
    <div class="container">
        <h1>📸 Screenshot Dropzone</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Drop your screenshots here for OpenCode AI</p>
        
        <div class="dropzone" id="dropzone">
            <div class="dropzone-icon">🖼️</div>
            <div class="dropzone-text">Drop image here</div>
            <div class="dropzone-hint">or click to browse</div>
        </div>
        
        <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept="image/*" style="display: none;">
        
        <div id="preview">
            <img id="previewImg" src="" alt="Preview">
            <div class="info">
                <div class="info-title">✅ Saved to:</div>
                <div class="info-content" id="savePath"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="info">
                <div class="info-title">💬 Tell the AI:</div>
                <div class="info-content" id="aiCommand"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="success" id="success">
            <span class="success-icon">✨</span>
            <span>Image saved successfully!</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
        const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');
        const preview = document.getElementById('preview');
        const previewImg = document.getElementById('previewImg');
        const savePath = document.getElementById('savePath');
        const aiCommand = document.getElementById('aiCommand');
        const success = document.getElementById('success');
        
        // Click to browse
        dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
        
        // Prevent default drag behaviors
        ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
            dropzone.addEventListener(eventName, preventDefaults, false);
            document.body.addEventListener(eventName, preventDefaults, false);
        });
        
        function preventDefaults(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
        }
        
        // Highlight drop zone when dragging over it
        ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(eventName => {
            dropzone.addEventListener(eventName, () => {
                dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
            });
        });
        
        ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
            dropzone.addEventListener(eventName, () => {
                dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
            });
        });
        
        // Handle dropped files
        dropzone.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
        fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            if (e.target.files.length) {
                handleFiles(e.target.files);
            }
        });
        
        function handleDrop(e) {
            const dt = e.dataTransfer;
            const files = dt.files;
            handleFiles(files);
        }
        
        async function handleFiles(files) {
            if (files.length === 0) return;
            
            const file = files[0];
            if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
                alert('Please drop an image file');
                return;
            }
            
            // Generate filename
            const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, -5);
            const extension = file.name.split('.').pop();
            const filename = `screenshot-${timestamp}.${extension}`;
            
            // Show preview
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = (e) => {
                previewImg.src = e.target.result;
                preview.style.display = 'block';
                savePath.textContent = `.screenshots/${filename}`;
                aiCommand.textContent = `check .screenshots/${filename}`;
                
                // Save the file
                saveFile(file, filename);
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }
        
        async function saveFile(file, filename) {
            // Create a download link to save the file
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            
            // Show success message
            success.style.display = 'block';
            setTimeout(() => {
                success.style.display = 'none';
            }, 3000);
            
            // Show instructions
            alert(`📁 File will be downloaded as: ${filename}\n\n✅ Move it to:\n.screenshots/\n\n💬 Then tell the AI:\n"check .screenshots/${filename}"`);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

# .screenshots/dropzone.ts

```ts
#!/usr/bin/env bun
import { Tui, Box, Text } from "@opentui/core"
import fs from "fs"
import path from "path"

const SCREENSHOTS_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), ".screenshots")

const tui = new Tui({
  title: "Screenshot Dropzone",
})

let status = "Drop a file here..."
let lastFile = ""

tui.root.append(
  Box.create({
    width: "100%",
    height: "100%",
    flexDirection: "column",
    justifyContent: "center",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 2,
  }).append(
    Text.create({
      content: "📸 Screenshot Dropzone",
      bold: true,
      fontSize: 2,
    }),
    Text.create({
      content: "Drag a file into this terminal window",
      color: { r: 150, g: 150, b: 150, a: 255 },
    }),
    Box.create({
      width: 60,
      height: 10,
      border: "rounded",
      borderColor: { r: 102, g: 126, b: 234, a: 255 },
      justifyContent: "center",
      alignItems: "center",
      marginTop: 2,
    }).append(
      Text.create({
        content: status,
        color: { r: 102, g: 126, b: 234, a: 255 },
      })
    ),
    lastFile ? Box.create({
      marginTop: 2,
      flexDirection: "column",
      gap: 1,
    }).append(
      Text.create({
        content: `✅ Saved: ${lastFile}`,
        color: { r: 40, g: 167, b: 69, a: 255 },
      }),
      Text.create({
        content: `💬 Tell AI: check .screenshots/${lastFile}`,
        color: { r: 102, g: 126, b: 234, a: 255 },
      })
    ) : null,
    Box.create({
      marginTop: 2,
    }).append(
      Text.create({
        content: "Press q to quit",
        color: { r: 150, g: 150, b: 150, a: 255 },
      })
    )
  )
)

// Listen for stdin (this will receive the file path when dragged)
process.stdin.setRawMode(true)
process.stdin.on('data', (data) => {
  const key = data.toString()
  
  if (key === 'q' || key === '\u0003') {
    tui.stop()
    process.exit(0)
  }
  
  // Check if it's a file path (drag and drop typically includes full path)
  if (key.includes('/') && !key.includes('\n')) {
    handleFileDrop(key.trim())
  }
})

function handleFileDrop(filePath: string) {
  try {
    // Clean the path (remove quotes, etc)
    filePath = filePath.replace(/['"]/g, '').trim()
    
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      status = `❌ File not found: ${filePath}`
      return
    }
    
    const ext = path.extname(filePath)
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, -5)
    const newFilename = `screenshot-${timestamp}${ext}`
    const destPath = path.join(SCREENSHOTS_DIR, newFilename)
    
    // Copy file
    fs.copyFileSync(filePath, destPath)
    
    status = "✅ File saved!"
    lastFile = newFilename
    
    console.log(`\n✅ Saved: ${newFilename}`)
    console.log(`📁 Location: .screenshots/${newFilename}`)
    console.log(`💬 Tell AI: check .screenshots/${newFilename}\n`)
  } catch (err) {
    status = `❌ Error: ${err.message}`
  }
}

tui.run()
```

```md
# Screenshots Folder

Drop any screenshots here that you want to share with the AI.

Files in this folder are:
```

# .screenshots/server.js

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const PORT = 8765;
const UPLOAD_DIR = __dirname;

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'dropzone.html'), 'utf8')
  .replace('alert(`📁 File will be downloaded', 'uploadToServer(file, filename); return; alert(`📁 File will be downloaded');

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  // CORS headers
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(200);
    res.end();
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
    res.end(html + `
      <script>
        async function uploadToServer(file, filename) {
          const formData = new FormData();
          formData.append('file', file, filename);
          
          try {
            const response = await fetch('http://localhost:${PORT}/upload', {
              method: 'POST',
              body: formData
            });
            
            if (response.ok) {
              success.style.display = 'block';
              setTimeout(() => success.style.display = 'none', 3000);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            alert('Upload failed: ' + err.message);
          }
        }
      </script>
    `);
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/upload') {
    let body = [];
    req.on('data', chunk => body.push(chunk));
    req.on('end', () => {
      const buffer = Buffer.concat(body);
      const boundary = req.headers['content-type'].split('boundary=')[1];
      
      // Parse multipart form data
      const parts = buffer.toString('binary').split(`--${boundary}`);
      
      for (const part of parts) {
        if (part.includes('filename=')) {
          const filenameMatch = part.match(/filename="([^"]+)"/);
          if (!filenameMatch) continue;
          
          const filename = filenameMatch[1];
          const dataStart = part.indexOf('\r\n\r\n') + 4;
          const dataEnd = part.lastIndexOf('\r\n');
          const fileData = part.substring(dataStart, dataEnd);
          
          const filepath = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename);
          fs.writeFileSync(filepath, fileData, 'binary');
          
          console.log(`✅ Saved: ${filename}`);
          console.log(`📁 Location: .screenshots/${filename}`);
          console.log(`💬 Tell AI: "check .screenshots/${filename}"\n`);
          
          res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, filename }));
          return;
        }
      }
      
      res.writeHead(400);
      res.end('No file uploaded');
    });
    return;
  }

  res.writeHead(404);
  res.end('Not found');
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`\n🎯 Screenshot Dropzone Server`);
  console.log(`📡 Open: http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`📁 Saving to: ${UPLOAD_DIR}`);
  console.log(`\n👉 Drag images to the browser to save them!\n`);
});

```

# .screenshots/watch.sh

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-copy screenshots from Desktop to .screenshots folder

WATCH_DIR="$HOME/Desktop"
DEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

echo "👀 Watching for screenshots on Desktop..."
echo "📁 Will copy to: $DEST_DIR"
echo "Press Ctrl+C to stop"
echo ""

# Watch Desktop for new screenshots
fswatch -0 "$WATCH_DIR" | while read -d "" event; do
    # Check if it's a screenshot
    if [[ "$event" == *"Screenshot"*.png ]] || [[ "$event" == *"Screenshot"*.jpg ]]; then
        filename=$(basename "$event")
        
        # Wait a moment for file to be written
        sleep 0.5
        
        if [ -f "$event" ]; then
            # Copy to screenshots folder
            cp "$event" "$DEST_DIR/$filename"
            echo "✅ Copied: $filename"
            echo "💬 Tell AI: check .screenshots/$filename"
            echo ""
        fi
    fi
done
```
